title: Germany Greenfield Account Executive, Worldwide Public Sector Greenfield Sales, AWS WWPS Shared Serv (Betriebswirt/in (Fachschule) - Absatz/Marketing/Bachelor Professional in Wirtschaft)
employer: Amazon Web Services EMEA SARL Niederlassung Deutschland
description:
Would you like to own driving revenue and customer engagements for a leader in the Cloud Computing business? Would you like to be part of a team focused on increasing awareness and adoption of Amazon Web Services by engaging with Public Sector organizations in Germany who are reinventing their IT strategy by adopting cloud computing? Do you have the business savvy, sales experience, and technical background necessary to help further establish Amazon as a leading cloud platform provider?

As a Greenfield Account Executive within Amazon Web Services (AWS) Worldwide Public Sector (WWPS), you will build AWS adoption in net-new public sector accounts with limited or no existing AWS presence. You will own the full sales cycle, from prospecting through close, helping public sector organizations reinvent their IT strategy through cloud computing.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in full sales cycle, technology sales, sales engineering/consulting or equivalent business development
- Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent work experience
- Experience using sales CRM tools such as Salesforce
- Fluent in German and English with the ability to conduct sales and technical conversations with customers in both languages
- Experience developing and executing sales strategies, tactics, plans, processes, systems and programs
- Experience in generating new opportunities with strong focus on pipeline tracking and deal execution through entire sales cycle

Preferred qualifications

- AWS Associate level certification, or Bachelor's degree in business administration, finance, economics, computer science, data science, engineering, or other related field
- Experience with government procurement and contracting process
- Experience working with partners through account, product or program management and business development engagements
- Experience selling nascent products and services Ability to drive solutions to difficult problems
- Experience driving new business in greenfield accounts at the C-suite level or equivalent
- Experience in strategic thinking about business, enterprise software products, and new technology platforms and architectures or equivalent

This role requires building a sales function from the ground up, demanding creative problem-solving, tenacity, and the ability to develop novel approaches for reaching and engaging prospective customers. You will establish business and technical relationships with public sector organizations, driving adoption of AWS services that transform how they deliver services to citizens and communities.

You will engage customers face-to-face and via teleconference, interacting at the CXO level in strategic accounts. The ideal candidate possesses both business acumen to drive executive-level engagements and technical knowledge to interact effectively with software developers and architects.

This position requires working from the local office when not at customer sites.

Key job responsibilities
Sales Execution
• Prospect and qualify net-new public sector accounts with limited or no AWS presence
• Manage the full sales cycle from prospecting through close
• Meet or exceed quarterly revenue targets while maintaining robust pipeline coverage
• Maintain accurate sales forecasts and pipeline reporting in Salesforce

Customer Engagement
• Develop and execute territory plans to maximize market penetration
• Translate cloud and AI capabilities into mission-relevant use cases for public sector organizations
• Build relationships across customer organizations, including C-level executives, engineering, IT/operations, and procurement
• Conduct discovery calls to understand agency missions and technical challenges

Public Sector Expertise
• Navigate public sector procurement processes including RFPs, cooperative contracts, and federal/state/local contract vehicles
• Apply knowledge of public sector compliance requirements, certifications, and fiscal year buying cycles
• Structure deals that meet public sector regulatory, compliance, and grant-funded operating requirements

Collaboration
• Partner with solutions architects and internal stakeholders to accelerate deal velocity
• Collaborate with the partner ecosystem (systems integrators, resellers, distributors) to drive customer success and extend market reach
• Use data and insights to prioritize outreach and identify high-potential prospects

A day in the life
You will balance hunting new accounts with nurturing early-stage relationships. Working with a team of German AE's to grow the Public Sector Greenfield business. You will spend time on prospecting, researching accounts, sourcing contacts, and executing outbound campaigns to generate meetings. You will conduct discovery calls to understand agency missions and technical challenges, navigate complex procurement processes, and coordinate with Legal, Contracts, and partner teams. You will maintain your pipeline in Salesforce and forecast accurately. This role requires strategic thinking and tactical execution, with autonomy to innovate your approach to breaking into new accounts.

About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve.

title: Sr Tech Ops and Strategy Lead, AWS SMGS Ops Sales Ops - Global Sales (Betriebswirt/in (Fachschule) - Controlling/Bachelor Professional in Wirtschaft)
employer: Amazon Web Services EMEA SARL Niederlassung Deutschland
description:
AWS Global Sales Operations is the strategic operating function that provides insights, mechanisms, and objective recommendations enabling AWS Global Sales to scale, transform, and deliver long-term customer and business outcomes.
At AWS, we celebrate innovation, calculated risk-taking, and new ideas. We are builders who experiment, learn, simplify, and scale what works. It is still Day 1, and we are looking for curious, analytical, and action-oriented leaders to join our diverse teams of thinkers, problem solvers, and doers.

The GSCE Field Tech Operations Lead is the strategic advisor and operating partner to the GSCE Area Tech Leader across Germany, Switzerland, and Central and Eastern Europe. You will translate EMEA Tech strategy and GSCE business priorities into executable plans, scalable mechanisms, and measurable customer outcomes across Solutions Architecture, Customer Solutions Management, and strategic initiatives.

You will also own the area’s migration strategy and execution end to end, driving progress from opportunity identification through migration launch, modernization, and consumption realization with a large cross functional team across the Area.

This is a cross-functional, hands-on role working closely with Tech Leaders, Sales VP, Sales Strategy & Operations, Business Development, Professional Services, Partners, Finance, and EMEA and worldwide teams.

The ideal candidate will combine strategic judgement, analytical rigor, commercial awareness, and operational discipline to solve complex problems, influence senior stakeholders, and improve execution across the Area. Success in this role requires the ability to communicate effectively across technical and non-technical teams, business units, and geographies.

Key job responsibilities
• Strategic Partnership: Advise the GSCE Area Tech Leader on strategy, organizational performance, risks, priorities, and investment decisions.
• Strategy and Planning: Develop and execute the GSCE Tech operating plan, translating EMEA Tech strategy and GSCE business priorities into clear priorities, actions, and outcomes.
• Business Performance: Establish KPIs, lead business reviews, and provide decision oriented insights that improve performance, resource allocation, and execution.
• Sales and Tech Alignment: Align technical priorities and capacity with the Area business plan and identify gaps requiring leadership action.
• Migration and Modernization: Own the Area’s strategy and execution end to end, from opportunity identification and prioritization through migration, modernization, launch, consumption realization and drive execution across teams.
• Strategic Initiatives: Coordinate GenAI, customer adoption, and other Area Tech OP2 initiatives, recommending when to scale, redesign, simplify, or stop.
• Resource Planning: Provide data-backed recommendations on capacity, coverage, skills, and technical resource allocation.
• Customer Adoption: Track customer progression from technical engagement to production adoption and business outcomes, distinguishing activity from measurable impact.
• GSCE and EMEA Alignment: Act as the operational link between GSCE and EMEA Field Tech Operations, adopt common standards, escalate systemic blockers, and share scalable best practices.
• Cross-Functional Leadership: Influence, build alignment and drive execution across Sales, Business Development, Professional Services, Partners, Finance, technical teams, and worldwide organizations.

A day in the life
You will lead the Area Tech AI-enabled rhythm of business and work closely with the GSCE Area Tech Leader to identify where customer outcomes, technical capacity, or execution are off track. You’d also be partnering with Sales, Solutions Architects, Business Development, Professional Services, or Partners to prioritize key customers, remove blockers, and agree the actions needed to improve Area performance and accelerate migration, modernization, and GenAI adoption. The role moves regularly between strategic planning and hands-on execution. This may include developing decision-oriented insights for leadership, improving business review mechanisms, shaping resource allocation recommendations, or coordinating cross-functional initiatives across countries and teams. You will also connect GSCE with EMEA and worldwide stakeholders, share best practices, escalate systemic issues, and ensure common strategies and operating standards translate into effective Area execution. Throughout the day, you will bring clarity to complex problems, align leaders around the right priorities, and turn strategy into actions that deliver measurable customer and business outcomes.

You work at the interface of information technology, automation, and cybersecurity, playing a key role in the digital transformation of our warehousing processes and assets. - Ensure reliable operation of all IT/OT systems within the warehousing environment

- Coordinate with the international Digital Transformation Team to ensure that deployed tools align with the global strategy and HCB technology standards
- Support stakeholder management and ensure transparent communication

What makes you a good fit

- Bachelor's degree or higher in Engineering (e.g., Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Information Systems, Mechanical Engineering, Automation,  Mechatronics, or Industrial Engineering)
- At least 2 years of experience with Industrial IoT and Manufacturing 4.0 in an industrial environment (experience in the consumer goods industry is an advantage)
- Experience in managing capital investment projects
- Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills
- Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence stakeholders in the adoption of new digital tools
- Fluent German and English language skills, both written and spoken

Some perks of joining Henkel

- Flexible work scheme with flexible hours, hybrid and work from anywhere policies
- Diverse national and international growth opportunities
- Globally wellbeing standards with health and preventive care programs

- Employee Share Plan with voluntary investment and Henkel matching shares

- MEGA Preventive Health Insurance
- CareFlex Supplementary Care Insurance x
- Mobility offer: My Henkel Bike and Jobticket

At Henkel, we come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe the uniqueness of all our employees is the power in us. Become part of the team and bring your uniqueness to us! We welcome all applications across different genders, origins, cultures, religions, sexual orientations, generations and disabilities. title: Senior IT Datenschutzkoordinator (m/w/d) (Datenschutzbeauftragte/r)
description:
Unternehmensbeschreibung

Lass uns gemeinsam neue Wege gehen! Denn genau das tun wir bei der R+V, einem der größten Versicherer Deutschlands.

Willkommen im Ressort Operations und IT, in dem die R+V alle kundennahen Operations-Einheiten und die IT bündelt. Ziel ist es, Prozesse und technische Voraussetzungen so zu verbessern, dass die R+V Kundenanliegen schneller, effizienter und digitaler bearbeiten kann. Innovative Techno­logien und unsere vielfältige Systemlandschaft bieten Möglichkeiten für fachliche und persönliche Ent­wicklung.

Stellenbeschreibung

- Zentrale Anlaufstelle für alle Datenschutzfragen des IT-Ressorts; eigenständige Erstbewertung komplexer Sachverhalte und Übersetzung rechtlicher Vorgaben in konkrete Anforderungen an Architektur, Entwicklung und Betrieb.
- Datenschutzfachliche Begleitung von IT-Vorhaben über den gesamten Lebenszyklus – insbesondere bei Cloud-, SaaS-, KI- und GenAI-Lösungen – unter Anwendung von Privacy by Design und Privacy by Default.
- Koordination und Qualitätssicherung von Datenschutz-Risikobewertungen, Vor-DSFA/DSFA, Verarbeitungsverzeichnissen, Löschkonzepten sowie technischen und organisatorischen Maßnahmen.
- Datenschutzrechtlich-technische Bewertung von IT-Dienstleistern und Datenflüssen, einschließlich Auftragsverarbeitung, Unterauftragnehmern, Drittlandtransfers, Standardvertragsklauseln und Transfer Impact Assessments.
- Entwicklung IT-spezifischer Datenschutzstandards und Arbeitsanweisungen sowie Koordination von Betroffenenrechten und Datenschutzvorfällen; Schnittstelle zu Konzern-Datenschutz, Informationssicherheit, Architektur, Einkauf und IT-Verantwortlichen.

Qualifikationen

- Abgeschlossenes Studium oder eine vergleichbare berufliche Qualifikation in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, IT-Sicherheit, Datenschutz, Wirtschaftsrecht oder einem verwandten Bereich.
- Mehrjährige einschlägige Berufserfahrung im technischen und operativen Datenschutz sowie nachgewiesene Fachkunde durch eine qualifizierte Datenschutzweiterbildung oder Zertifizierung, z. B. GDDcert., CIPP/E, CIPM, CDPSE oder vergleichbar.
- Sehr gute, anwendungsfeste Kenntnisse der DSGVO und des einschlägigen Datenschutzrechts, insbesondere zu Privacy by Design/Default, DSFA, Auftragsverarbeitung, internationalen Datentransfers und automatisierten Entscheidungen; Kenntnisse des EU AI Act.
- Fundiertes Verständnis moderner IT-Architekturen und Datenflüsse, insbesondere Cloud- und SaaS-Modelle, KI/GenAI, APIs, IAM, Verschlüsselung, Protokollierung, Mandantentrennung sowie Aufbewahrungs- und Löschmechanismen.
- Ausgeprägte analytische, konzeptionelle und kommunikative Fähigkeiten sowie die Kompetenz, komplexe Sachverhalte eigenständig zu bewerten, adressatengerecht zu vermitteln und gegenüber internen Stakeholdern und Providern fachlich überzeugend zu vertreten.
- Sehr gute deutsche Sprachkenntnisse (mind. B2/C1 Level) in Wort und Schrift.

Zusätzliche Informationen

Homeoffice: Flexible Arbeitszeiten im Homeoffice und Büro. Mehr Infos zu unserem hybriden Arbeiten findest Du hier (https://www.ruv.de/karriere/blog/HomeOffice-bei-ruv) .

Arbeitszeiten: Standardmäßig 38h-Woche, Zeiterfassungssystem, Gleitzeit & Lebensarbeitszeitkonto.

Urlaub: 30 Tage Urlaub & zusätzliche arbeitsfreie Tage (24.12. und 31.12.).

Vergütung: 14 Monatsgehälter (inkl. Weihnachts- & Urlaubsgeld) oder Teilnahme am variablen Vergütungssystem, Sonderzahlungen, Mitarbeitertarife & Rabattaktionen.

Gesundheit: Betriebliche Altersvorsorge & Gesundheitsmanagement mit vielfältigen Angeboten. Unser hauseigenes Fitnessstudio und ein breites Netzwerk von Sportangeboten (Wellpass) stehen Dir zudem online und bundesweit zur Verfügung.

Mobilität: Jobticket, Jobrad/Fahrradleasing, verkehrsgünstige Lage mit überdachten Fahrradparkplätzen.

description:

- unbefristete Anstellung

- Wünschenswert sind praktische Erfahrungen im sozialpsychiatrischen Bereich

title: Sozialpädagogische Fachkraft (m/w/d) als Leitungsstellvertretung DRK Kita "WibiDU" (Erzieher/in)
employer: Deutsches Rotes Kreuz Ortsvere in Schwelm e.V.
description:
Sie sind bereit für ein neues Abenteuer?
Gehen Sie gemeinsam mit den Kindern und dem Team auf spannende Erlebnisreisen und erleben so die kleinen und großen Wunder, die den Beruf so einzigartig machen.
Für unsere 4-gruppige DRK Kindertageseinrichtung "WibiDU" in Ennepetal suchen wir ab sofort:

Erzieher*in (m/w/d) in Voll- oder Teilzeit als Leitungsstellvertretung
(Alternativberufe: Heilerziehungspfleger*in, Kindheitspädagoge*in oder vergleichbarer
Studienabschluss (Erziehungswissenschaften, Heilpädagogik, Soziale Arbeit), Gesundheits-
und Kinderkrankenpfleger*in, Heilpädagoge*in)

Der DRK Ortsverein Schwelm ist ein gemeinnütziger Arbeitgeber im Ennepe- Ruhr- Kreis im Bereich Rettungsdienst und Kindertageseinrichtungen mit derzeit 180 hauptamtlichen Mitarbeitern sowie einigen ehrenamtlichen Gliederungen.
Wir sind Teil der weltweiten Gemeinschaft von Menschen in der internationalen Rotkreuz- und Rothalbmondbewegung. Im Zeichen der Menschlichkeit setzen wir uns für das Leben, die Würde, die Gesundheit, das Wohlergehen und die Rechte aller Kinder und der am Entwicklungsprozess beteiligten Personen ein.
Unser Handeln ist bestimmt durch die sieben Grundsätze des Roten Kreuzes:
Menschlichkeit - Unparteilichkeit - Neutralität - Unabhängigkeit - Freiwilligkeit - Einheit - Universalität.
Die Werte, die sich aus den Grundsätzen ableiten lassen, begründen unsere Weltanschauung und bilden die Ziele unserer „tragenden“ und „praktischen“ Arbeit von Träger und Kindertageseinrichtungen vor Ort.

Unsere 2- 4gruppigen Kindertageseinrichtungen befinden sich in Schwelm und Ennepetal. Gemeinsam mit vielfältigen, motivierten und engagierten Teams spielen, lernen, lachen, streiten und vertragen sich hier täglich 380 Kinder aller Nationen und Religionen.
Das Ziel aller unserer Kita-Teams ist eine liebevolle und kompetente Betreuung zu schaffen sowie einen geborgenen, wertschätzenden und entwicklungsfördernden Erfahrungsraum, der jedem Kind (und Mitarbeitenden) individuell Möglichkeiten zu seiner Persönlichkeitsentfaltung bietet... Das Ziel, die Kinder zur Selbständigkeit zur ermutigen, sobald sie für den nächsten Schritt bereit sind, bildet einen roten Faden durch die Konzeption nach dem Situationsansatz.
Kinder, Team und Träger der Kita "WibiDU- Willkommen bist du!" suchen noch eine/n mutige/n Abenteurer*in, der/die mit Freude, Engagement und Elan verantwortungsvoll die kommenden Expeditionen begleitet und die Leitungskraft unterstützt.

IHRE AUFGABEN:
•    Planung, Organisation und Durchführung der didaktisch-methodischen Arbeit, Sicherstellung des Tagesablaufes der Gruppe und besonderer Aktivitäten im Sinne des Kibiz, der Bildungsvereinbarung NRW und nach den Grundsätzen des Deutschen Roten Kreuzes;
•    Umsetzung und Weiterentwicklung der pädagogischen Konzeption;
•    Bildungsdokumentation, Entwicklungsberichte und Förderpläne;
•    Eltern- und Öffentlichkeitsarbeit;
•    Pflegerische- und hauswirtschaftliche Aufgaben;

•    Sie arbeiten eng mit der Leitung zusammen und vertreten diese in Abwesenheit.

WAS SIE MITBRINGEN:
•    Eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als staatlich anerkannte/r Erzieherin, Heilerziehungspflegerin, Kindheitspädagogein (oder vergleichbare Qualifikation als Fachkraft nach der aktuellen Personalverordnung), mind. 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung;
•    Eine positive Haltung zu dem Leitbild und den Grundsätzen des DRKs;
•    Organisationstalent, Verantwortungsbewusstsein, ausgeprägte Kommunikations-, Führungs- und Teamkompetenzen, Sie sind Kooperations- und Konfliktfähig und können andere für gemeinsame Ziele begeistern, Freude an der Arbeit mit den Kindern und Familien, sind belastbar, flexibel und offen für Neues;

WIR BIETEN:
•    Eine interessante und vielseitige Tätigkeit, die Raum für neigungsorientiertes Arbeiten bereit hält;
•    Möglichkeit zu Fort- und Weiterbildungen (intern/ extern);
•    Vergütung in Anlehnung an TVÖD SuE mit betrieblicher Altersvorsorge, Jahressonderzahlung, 30 Tagen Urlaub (31 ab 2027), 2 Regenerationstagen, 2 Umwandlungstagen etc.;
•    Befristete Anstellung vorerst bis zum 31.12.2027 zur Vertretung mit der Option auf Übernahme oder Wechsel in eine Leitungsposition;
•    Engagierte Teams, Mitarbeiterfeste, Betriebsausflüge und bei Interesse Anbindung an die Rot-Kreuz-Gemeinschaft;

Wir wachsen und entwickeln uns – Dabei schätzen wir Vielfalt und wünschen uns Personen, die dazu beitragen, unabhängig der kulturellen oder sozialen Herkunft, Religion oder Weltanschauung. Außerdem richten wir uns ausdrücklich an alle Geschlechter. Bewerber*innen mit Schwerbehinderung werden bei gleicher Eignung besonders berücksichtigt.
Gerne sind wir auch bei dem Anerkennungsverfahren ausländischer Berufsabschlüsse behilflich.

Support regional IT financial management, including budgeting, forecasting, cost optimization, and validation of IT-related expenditures.

Show your expertise

- University degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Informatics, or a related field.

- Proven expertise in service-performance management, operational escalation management, problem management, and continuous service improvement.
- Experience leading and coordinating geographically distributed IT teams and managing external IT service providers.
- Strong understanding of enterprise IT services, operational governance, IT financial management, budgeting, forecasting, cost control, and invoice validation.
- Solid knowledge of IT service management frameworks, preferably ITIL, and broad exposure to workplace, infrastructure, connectivity, cloud, and business application services.

title: Erzieher / Heilerziehungspfleger (m/w/d) als Schulbegleitung für Kinder mit Behinderung (Heilerziehungspfleger/in)
employer: Caritasverband der Erzdiözese München und Freising e. V.
description:
Wir sind...

die Kontaktstelle für Menschen mit Behinderung in Fürstenfeldbruck, eine Anlaufstelle für Menschen mit geistiger und/oder körperlicher Behinderung, mit Lern- und Sinnesbehinderung, für Menschen mit Autismus, Menschen mit chronischer Erkrankung und für Eltern, Angehörige und Bezugspersonen aus dem Landkreis Fürstenfeldbruck. Unsere Aufgabe ist es, Berührungsängste und Vorurteile im Gemeinwesen abbauen zu helfen. Wir fordern das Miteinander von Menschen mit und ohne Behinderung. Weitere Informationen zu unserem Angebot finden Sie unter: https://www.caritas-kontaktstelle-fuerstenfeldbruck.de/de/schul--und-individualbegleitung

Informationen zur Stelle:

Stellenumfang: Teilzeit (24 Stunden)
Vertragsart: Befristet
Beginn: zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt
Stellen-ID: 36859
Eingruppierung: Caritas AVR Anlage 33, S08B bis S08B - zum AVR Rechner
Arbeitsort: Caritas Kontaktstelle für Menschen mit Behinderung, Schöngeisinger Straße 6, 82256 Fürstenfeldbruck

Sie sind verantwortlich für...

- ein oder mehrere Kinder, Jugendlichen oder jungen Erwachsenen mit (drohender) Beeinträchtigung
- die Bildung, Betreuung und Erziehung der Kinder im Rahmen des Bayerischen Bildungs- und Erziehungsplanes und des BayKiBiGs
- die Unterstützung bei pädagogischen Fragen sowie die Übernahme von herausfordernder Situationen für die ungelernten Hilfskräfte
- die Anleitung durch Gespräche und Beispiele im Einzelfall
- die bedürfnisorientierte Unterstützung von Kindern und Jugendlichen mit geistiger, und/ oder körperlicher oder seelischer Beeinträchtigung bei der Bewältigung ihres (Schul-) Alltags bzw. (Kindergarten-) Alltags
- die soziale Integration in den Klassenverbund bzw. in die Gruppe der Kindertagesstätte
- die partizipative Begleitung der Kinder auf ihrem Weg in ein selbstständiges und selbstbestimmtes Leben
- das Ermöglichen von Auszeiten, wenn nötig
- das Übernehmen von pflegerischen Tätigkeiten
- die partnerschaftliche Zusammenarbeit mit Eltern, Lehrern und pädagogischem Fachpersonal
- die Umsetzung unserer Qualitätsstandards zum Thema Kinderschutz

Wir freuen uns auf Sie, weil Sie...

- eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung zum/zur staatlich anerkannten Erzieher/-in oder Heilerziehungspfleger/-in oder einen vergleichbar anerkannten Abschluss nachweisen können
- eine gültige Fahrerlaubnis der Klasse B besitzen

Bei uns erwartet Sie...

- eine Tätigkeit in Teilzeit mit geregelten Arbeitszeiten von Montag - Freitag, Beginn der Tätigkeit in der Regel 07:45 Uhr
- eine attraktive AVR-Vergütung (angelehnt an den TVöD) mit regelmäßigen Gehaltserhöhungen durch Stufenaufstiege und Tariferhöhungen
- eine Jahressonderzahlung und ein zusätzliches Leistungsentgelt pro Jahr
- 30 Tage Jahresurlaub (bei einer 5-Tage-Woche) und bis zu maximal 2 Regenerationstagen pro Jahr
- zusätzlich 2 arbeitgeberfinanzierte dienstfreie Tage am 24.12. und 31.12. unter Berücksichtigung der Einsatzzeiten
- überdurchschnittliche Sozialleistungen wie arbeitgeberfinanzierte betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Krankenzusatzversicherung und Vermögenswirksame Leistungen
- die bezahlte Freistellung von der Tätigkeit in der Einrichtung zur persönlichen und beruflichen Weiterentwicklung für bis zu 5 Tagen für Fortbildungen/Zusatzqualifikationen und bis zu 3 Tagen zur Besinnung durch unser verbandseigenes Institut für Bildung und Entwicklung
- ein Zuschuss zur Nutzung des Deutschlandticket-Job (DB) und die Möglichkeit ein Business Bike zu leasen
- ein breites Angebot an Vergünstigungen bei Benefits.me
- Gesundheitsförderung durch betriebliches Gesundheitsmanagement
- ein sicherer Arbeitsplatz bei einem großen Träger mit vielfältigen Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten 
- eine verantwortungsvolle Aufgabe, bei der sich Familie und Beruf gut miteinander vereinbaren lassen 
- viel Raum für Kreativität, Gestaltung und Mitbestimmung 
- eine sinnstiftende Tätigkeit mit gesellschaftlichem Mehrwert
- weitere Arbeitgeber-Leistungen und Benefits, die Sie hier finden

Sie möchten uns kennenlernen? Wir freuen uns!

description:
To further strengthen our Operations & Supply Chain organization, we are looking for an experienced Head of Operational Excellence at Group level.

This high-impact role, reporting directly to the COO, offers a unique opportunity to design, build, and implement the Operational Excellence system from the start. You will operate within an international environment with multiple manufacturing sites.

In this initial phase, you will take the lead in developing and rolling out the foundation of our Operational Excellence framework, driving sustainable operational improvements throughout the organization.

Your mission

- In the first phase, your key responsibility will be to: - Design and establish the Group-wide Operational Excellence Production System
- Build the standards, tools and governance needed for sustainable implementation
- Create and roll out structured processes across Production, Logistics and Quality
- Set up performance management (KPI cascade, visual management, gap analysis)
- Develop and initiate the first wave of improvement projects and cost optimization pipeline
- Following this setup phase, you will: - Drive year-on-year efficiency improvements
- Scale and embed Lean & Six Sigma methodologies across all sites
- Act as a change leader, embedding mindset, behavior and capabilities

Your profile

- Master’s degree in engineering with strong analytical and statistical skills
- At least 3 years of leadership experience in a complex operations/manufacturing environment
- Strong track record in building and implementing Operational Excellence frameworks from the ground up
- Deep expertise in Lean / Six Sigma (Green/Black Belt preferred)
- Structured, hands-on and capable of turning concepts into execution
- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
- Willingness to travel across Europe (25–50%)
- Fluent in English and preferably German

Benefits

- **Work-life balance:** We offer flexible working hours in a hybrid work environment
- **Time off & flexibility:** With 30 days of vacation per year and flexible scheduling
- **Quick decision-making & autonomy:** You’ll benefit from quick decision-making and plenty of freedom to pursue your own ideas and creative solutions
- **Motivated team & international environment:** Work in a dedicated team with colleagues from different countries and cultures
- Individual management coaching: We support your personal and professional development through individual coaching
- **Exciting tasks:** Look forward to varied responsibilities in a sustainable and innovative company
- **Comprehensive benefits:** Enjoy advantages such as capital-forming benefits, TicketPlus, Hansefit and exclusive discounts

Your next step - get in touch!

We welcome your application, including details of your salary expectations and your earliest possible start date. For initial contact, please reach out to Roman Heizmann, Recruiting Manager.

title: Boltvezető-helyettes HUMANIC - Duna Plaza üzletbe (Verkaufsfahrer/in)
description:
RÓLUNK

A LEDER & SCHUH AG két értékesítési márkájával, a HUMANIC-kal és a SHOE4YOU-val Európa egyik legnagyobb cipőkereskedője. A vállalat kilenc országban (AT, DE, CZ, SK, HU, HU, SI, HR, RO, BG) mintegy 200 telephelyen mintegy 2000 embert foglalkoztat. A vállalat központja a stájer fővárosban, Grazban található. Nagy hangsúlyt fektetünk a hosszú távú munkakapcsolatok kiépítésére és a vállalaton belüli karrierépítésre.

A HUMANIC kilenc országban mintegy 140 üzletből álló hálózattal rendelkezik, amelyek közül tizennyolc üzlet Magyarországon található, az európai cipőipar úttörőjeként. Folyamatosan változó kollekcióinkkal a divat fővárosainak nemzetközi trendjeit azonnal elhozzuk üzleteinkbe és online boltunkba. Akár az elegáns és vonzó üzletek egyikében, akár az online shopban - a HUMANIC-nál a cipők iránti szenvedélyt megéljük. És ez már 1872 óta így van.

A SHOE4YOU a jó minőséget és a kedvező árat képviseli. A SHOE4YOU divatos női-, férfi- és gyermekcipő kínálatával a cipőpiac megkerülhetetlen szereplőjévé vált Ausztria-szerte, mintegy 70 üzletével és saját online áruházával.

- Boltvezető helyettesítése
- Ügyfélkiszolgálás és értékesítés.
- Üzleti célok elérésének biztosítása
- Üzletünk szabályainak betartatása
- Üzletünk rendjének és tisztaságának fenntartása.
- Üzlet napi működésének felügyelete                
- Üzletünkben lévő termékek rendszeres ellenőrzése.
- Raktárkezelés és készletgazdálkodás
- Kapcsolattartás a vevőkkel és partnerekkel
- Ügyfelek igényeinek kielégítése.

AZ ÖN PROFILJA

- Kedves, mosolygós, dinamikus, csapatban szívesen dolgozó munkatársakat keresünk, aki szívesen foglalkozik emberekkel és mindenekelőtt szereti a cipőket,
- több éves kereskedelmi tapasztalat,
- igényes munkavégzés,
- német nyelvtudás előny,
- középfokú végzettség, érettségi

AJÁNLATUNK

- Keresünk rugalmas munkatársat boltvezető helyettesi munkakörbe, Budapesten a Duna Plaza bevásárlóközpontban levő színvonalas cipőüzletünkbe teljes munkaidőben való foglalkoztatással.
- Változatos feladatok egy nemzetközi divatcégnél, amelynek székhelye Ausztriában található.
- Kedves, hozzáértő csapat, amely átfogó betanítást biztosít.

- versenyképes alapbér

- teljesítménytől függően 13. havi bér.

title: Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) (Arbeitsplanungsingenieur/in)
description:
Our Operations Team of OSI Food Solutions searches a Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) in either Toledo, Spain/ Bábolna, Hungary or Ostróda, Poland.

What your job includes

- Coordinating and analyzing the overall EU volume flow for assigned areas, ensuring smooth planning and alignment across sites
- Managing end-to-end volume planning, including demand adjustments, allocation, promotional volumes, and volume transfers between EU plants
- Working with planning tools (Excel, SAP, SAP IBP), preparing scenarios, monitoring deviations and supporting continuous improvement
- Collaborating closely with local EU sites, sales, supply chain, finance, and logistics partners to maintain accurate and efficient planning processes
- Supporting stock management, analyzing demand trends, production and delivery performance and contributing to corrective actions
- Preparing reports on planning adherence, stock trends and demand evolution
- Participating in planning projects and supporting the annual budget allocation process
- Engaging in SAP / SAP IBP implementation, helping shape systems and processes

What we expect from you

- Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Data Analysis, or a similar field
- Experience in a complex supply chain manufacturing environment and in a coordination role involving planning, stock management or forecasting
- Analytical mindset with confidence in building and maintaining data analysis structures
- Autonomy in decision-making
- Strong communication and presentation skills
- Proactive approach to process improvements and openness to change
- Experience with SAP is a significant advantage
- Very good English (written and verbal); additional local language skills are beneficial

What we offer you

We are a company with flat hierarchies, value-based corporate culture and a pronounced customer orientation in a special market. We know that the commitment of our employees is the basis of our success. We therefore support you by quickly giving you responsibility and developing you according to your talents.

Other benefits depending on the location

title: Swedish Speaking Automotive Warranty Assistant (Opel/Vauxhall)
description:
Swedish Speaking Automotive Warranty Assistant (Opel/Vauxhall)
Location: Budaörs, Budapest, Hungary

Concentrix, a global leader in Customer Service, work in partnership with the prestigious Opel/Vauxhall brand across Europe. We are currently recruiting for Warranty Assistants to join our team in Budaörs, Hungary. Located in state of the art facilities, our team of multilingual experts support a range of languages and assist the Opel/Vauxhall dealer network with the diagnosis and repair of vehicles.

What you can expect day to day:
. Handle warranty claims via phone and email.
. Fully investigating the request using Opel/Vauxhall systems, protocol and procedures.
. Escalating requests that cannot be resolved to other team members, and team leaders located both in the UK and Germany.
. Delivering service excellence by efficiently problem-solving and reacting in a professional, polite and clear manner.
. Accurately logging all Dealer contacts and following up on cases using Opel/Vauxhall database systems.
. Attending team and other meetings for review of issues, assignments, regular discussion.

What we're looking for:
. Automotive knowledge and experience preferred, gained either in a dealership, preferably Opel/Vauxhall, or with an OEM or OEM supplier business.
. Fluency in English & Swedish.
. Previous experience of handling warranty claims preferred.
. Excellent interpersonal skills, able to build constructive & effective relationships, using appropriate rapport,     diplomacy and tact.
. Ability to resolve queries to a high level remotely by telephone/email.
. Opel/Vauxhall product experience preferable.
. Good computer literacy - competent in the main Microsoft Office packages.
. Able to write clearly and succinctly in a variety of communication settings and styles.
. Time management skills, able to use time effectively and efficiently.
. Customer focus, dedicated to meeting the expectations and requirements of internal & external customers.

What can we offer you?
. Bright, modern, exciting place to work with excellent staff facilities
. Multicultural, multilingual environment.
. Excellent relocation package.
. Annual Reward & Recognition Ceremony.
. Professional development opportunities.

Relocating to Budaörs?

If you are relocating we'll help with travel costs, accommodation on arrival and salary advances to help get you settled.

Budaörs is a small city of around 30,000 people, situated at the southern edge of the Buda Hills less than 10km from Budapest. The city offers contemporary architecture, the picturesque old town, breath-taking natural surroundings and historic monuments. You can reach Budapest in a matter of minutes via road or public transport.

title: Erä- ja luonto opas tai muu luontomatkailualan ammattilainen
description:
**Etsin lisää luontomatkailualan ammattilaisia yhteistyöhön kanssani ja osaksi yritykseni Wild Adventures North kasvutarinaa.**

Wild Adventures North on erikoistunut järjestämään villejä seikkailuja suomalaiselle kohderyhmälle. Tarjoamme 10 vuoden kokemuksella autenttisen eräkokemuksen sen kaikessa karuudessaan ja kauneudessaan.

Elämyksiä suunnittelee ja toteuttaa yhteistyössä alan ammattilaisista koostuva tiimi. Toiminta-alueemme kattaa Suomen, Ruotsin ja Norjan upeimmat luontokohteet.

Meille luonnossa liikkuminen on enemmän kuin siirtymistä paikasta toiseen - se on oppimista oivaltamista a yhteyttä ympäröivään luontoon, Opetamme asiakkaalle kaiken, mitä hän tarvitsee - ja vähän enemmänkin.

Tarjontamme on omassa kategoriassaan Suomen laajin: valikoimaamme kuuluu jo 69 erilaista patikka- hiihto-, melonta-, juoksu-, lumikenkä- ja jäätikkövaellusta sekä selviytymiskoulutusta. Meidän kanssamme asiakas voi esimerkiksi:

- vaeltaa koko Suomen Lapin halki kaikkien 12 erämaan läpi

- nousta Suomen korkeimmalle tunturille - ja huiputtaa pikavaellustyylillä kaikki Suomen 33 yli 1000-metristä tunturia

- saavuttaa Suomen ja Ruotsin erämaisimmat pisteet meloa packraftilla niin sileässä vedessä kuin kuohuvissa koskissakin suorittaa Suomen vaativimman kaupallisen selviytymiskokeen, jossa hänet eksytetään helikopterilla viikoksi erämaahan ilman ruokaa, telttaa ja makuupussia - ja käydä ensin siihen valmistavan koulutuspolun

- vaeltaa Pohjois-Norjan jäätikköerämaassa köysistössä, jääraudat jalassa ja hakku kädessä


Yritykseni lähivuosien tavoitteena on laajentaa;

- toiminta uusiin maihin

title: Erä- ja luonto opas tai muu luontomatkailualan ammattilainen
description:
**Etsin lisää luontomatkailualan ammattilaisia yhteistyöhön kanssani ja osaksi yritykseni Wild Adventures North kasvutarinaa.**

Wild Adventures North on erikoistunut järjestämään villejä seikkailuja suomalaiselle kohderyhmälle. Tarjoamme 10 vuoden kokemuksella autenttisen eräkokemuksen sen kaikessa karuudessaan ja kauneudessaan.

Elämyksiä suunnittelee ja toteuttaa yhteistyössä alan ammattilaisista koostuva tiimi. Toiminta-alueemme kattaa Suomen, Ruotsin ja Norjan upeimmat luontokohteet.

Meille luonnossa liikkuminen on enemmän kuin siirtymistä paikasta toiseen - se on oppimista oivaltamista a yhteyttä ympäröivään luontoon, Opetamme asiakkaalle kaiken, mitä hän tarvitsee - ja vähän enemmänkin.

Tarjontamme on omassa kategoriassaan Suomen laajin: valikoimaamme kuuluu jo 69 erilaista patikka- hiihto-, melonta-, juoksu-, lumikenkä- ja jäätikkövaellusta sekä selviytymiskoulutusta. Meidän kanssamme asiakas voi esimerkiksi:

- vaeltaa koko Suomen Lapin halki kaikkien 12 erämaan läpi

- nousta Suomen korkeimmalle tunturille - ja huiputtaa pikavaellustyylillä kaikki Suomen 33 yli 1000-metristä tunturia

- saavuttaa Suomen ja Ruotsin erämaisimmat pisteet meloa packraftilla niin sileässä vedessä kuin kuohuvissa koskissakin suorittaa Suomen vaativimman kaupallisen selviytymiskokeen, jossa hänet eksytetään helikopterilla viikoksi erämaahan ilman ruokaa, telttaa ja makuupussia - ja käydä ensin siihen valmistavan koulutuspolun

- vaeltaa Pohjois-Norjan jäätikköerämaassa köysistössä, jääraudat jalassa ja hakku kädessä


Yritykseni lähivuosien tavoitteena on laajentaa;

- toiminta uusiin maihin

- markkinointi suomalaisille yrityksille ja lapsiperheille

- elämystarjonta uusiin lajeihin


Jos sinulla on kompetenssia ja ideaa tarttua johonkin näistä kolmesta tavoitteesta, saatat olla etsimäni ammattilainen.

Yhteistyö kanssani tarkoittaa sitä, että olemme yhdessä laatineet välillemme yhteistyösopimuksen, joka mm. määrittelee roolit, tehtävät, vastuun ja potin iaon. Olet yrittäjä, joka laskuttaa yritystäni palveluistaan.

Yhteistyössä kanssani on eri tasoja. Voit olla vieraileva opas, joka tekee yhden tai useamman yksittäisen keikan. Tai voit olla kiinteä osa brändini suojeluksessa toimivaa opastiimiä, joka suunnittelee, testaa ja toteuttaa uusia elämyksiä

Yhteistyö kanssani on kannattavaa, jos et halua rakentaa uutta luontomatkailubisnestä tyhjästä. Pääset hyötymään yritykseni 10 vuoden ajan rakennetusta laajasta asiakaspoolista, näkyvyydestä, vakiintuneesta markkina-asemasta, ryhmäkalustosta ja tiimin vertaistuesta.

title: Horticulture Worker
description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
Company: Laguna Nurseries Ltd Job Location: Laguna Channel Road Rush Co. Dublin K56 Y768 Total Number of Positions For This Job: 10 Hours per week: 39 As a horticultural worker at Laguna nurseries ltd you will perform tasks to cultivate, maintain, and harvest plants, crops, and trees. Planting and Propagation: Sowing seeds, planting bulbs, taking cuttings, grafting, or transplanting seedlings and plants. Crop Maintenance: Watering, fertilizing, pruning, weeding, and mulching to promote healthy growth. Pest and Disease Control: Monitoring plants for pests or diseases, applying pesticides or organic treatments, and removing affected plants. Soil Preparation: Testing and amending soil, tilling, and preparing beds for planting. Harvesting: Picking fruits, vegetables, flowers, or other crops at optimal times, ensuring quality and minimal damage. Equipment Operation: Using and maintaining tools like shovels, pruners, sprayers, or machinery such as tractors or mowers. Key Requirements: Physical Fitness: Ability to perform labour-intensive tasks like lifting, bending, and standing for long periods, often outdoors in varying weather. Plant Knowledge: Basic understanding of plant care, growth cycles, and identification; familiarity with common pests and diseases. Technical Skills: Proficiency with tools (e.g., pruners, shovels) and equipment (e.g., mowers, sprayers); ability to maintain and operate them safely. Attention to Detail: Precision in tasks like pruning, planting, or applying treatments to ensure plant health and quality. Safety Awareness: Knowledge of safe handling of chemicals (e.g., pesticides, fertilizers) and adherence to workplace safety protocols. Teamwork and Communication: Ability to work collaboratively, follow instructions. Adaptability: Flexibility to handle seasonal tasks or changing priorities, such as harvesting or preparing for weather shifts. Education/Training: Vocational training in horticulture, botany, or agriculture is preferred. Experience: Prior experience in gardening, farming, or landscaping is essential.

title: Access Control Compliance Officer
description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
JMG (EHS) SOLUTIONS LIMITED, located at 11 Ardbanager, Glaslough, Co Monaghan, H18 NW89, is looking to hire an Access Control Compliance Officer to join the team. Access Control Compliance Officer is responsible for ensuring that all access control compliance/governance processes, security procedures, and governance activities across the organisation comply with applicable legislation, customer contractual requirements, internal policies, and recognised regulatory and industry standards. Key Responsibilities Manage and oversee access control compliance/governance processes across multiple data centre facilities. Ensure that all employee, contractor, visitor, and third-party access complies with company policies, customer contractual requirements, and security procedures. Develop, review, implement, and maintain access control compliance/governance policies, procedures, and governance documentation. Conduct regular compliance reviews of access permissions, authorisations, and supporting records. Perform compliance monitoring activities and identify areas requiring corrective or preventive action. Carry out operational risk assessments relating to access control compliance/governance and security governance. Investigate access-related incidents, policy breaches, and security non-conformities, preparing detailed reports and recommending corrective actions. Maintain compliance with ISO 27001, GDPR, SOC 1, SOC 2, PCI-DSS, customer security requirements, and other applicable regulatory frameworks. Support internal, external, customer, and third-party audits by preparing documentation, compliance evidence, reports, and audit records. Analyse compliance data, audit findings, and operational trends to identify risks and opportunities for continuous improvement. Produce management reports, compliance dashboards, risk registers, and performance metrics for senior management. Work collaboratively with HR, Legal, Information Security, Facilities, Operations, and customer representatives to ensure effective compliance and governance. Maintain accurate compliance records and documentation in accordance with regulatory and contractual requirements. Support business continuity, operational resilience, and corporate risk management initiatives. Promote security awareness, regulatory compliance, and best practice across operational teams. Identify opportunities to improve compliance processes, governance controls, and operational efficiency. Requirements Third-level qualification or equivalent relevant experience in compliance, risk management or security governance. NEBOSH General Certificate or equivalent desirable. Good understanding of policies, procedures and regulatory requirements. Good organisational skills and attention to detail. Good analytical and problem-solving skills. Salary: 36.605 per year Hours of work: 39h per week Job Location: BROADCOM, BALLYCOOLIN BUSINESS PARK, BALLYCOOLIN ROAD DUBLIN 15, D15 E867

title: Sheet Metal Worker
description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
Job Title: Sheet Metal Worker Reports to: Structures Crew Leader Location: Atlantic Aviation Group, Shannon Airport, Shannon, Co Clare Apply: Email your up-to-date CV together with any supporting qualifications to careers@atlanticaviation.ie Atlantic Aviation Group With over 55 years of experience, Shannon based Atlantic Aviation Group (AAG) is one of Europe's leading independent aviation solution providers. The company has a strong reputation of providing customers with a complete range of solutions including; aircraft maintenance modifications, technical, engineering and design services, logistics and material solutions and international training and consultancy. This reputation is built on a proud history and tradition of superior craftsmanship, technical expertise and continuous training, which is supported by our flexible, open and partnership-based customer relationships. The company provides a range of aviation solutions including; Part 145 Aircraft Maintenance, CAMO & Technical Services, Part 21 Design Services and the EASA Part 147 Atlantic Aviation Institute which provides aviation training to airlines, MRO’s and companies around the world. Aircraft Sheet Metal Worker required to join the Structures Team in AAG. In this role you will be required to join the existing team in a busy Production environment. You will be expected to perform all types of repairs, assessments and modifications to Aircraft Structures and components. General Responsibility Accountable for the Safe, On-Time delivery of all Structural repairs. Repair, rework, install and fabricate the complex aircraft structural assemblies, both internal and external. Remove and disassemble defective parts of the aircraft Adhere to company procedures, maintaining Safety and Quality standards at all times, reporting any discrepancies to respective Manager/Team Leader, generating SMS reports as necessary Carry out all repairs and tasks using the relevant approved Repair Manuals, Drawings/Technical Instructions as provided by the OEM Maintain a safe, organized and clean work environment according to in house 5S principles, including proper usage of tooling Ensures relevant repair documentation is completed accurately and in a timely manner Working collaboratively with your Crew Leader, inspector and the Production team. Integration of our values and pillars as a constant way of operating including compliance with the organisational policies and procedures detailed in the Atlantic Aviation Group MOE and Supporting manuals. Candidate Requirements Candidates must have a minimum of 4 years’ experience in Aircraft Structures repair/modification. Heavy maintenance experience is an advantage but not essential. Must be proficient in the use of Aircraft manuals, Boeing Engine Atlantic Aviation Group is an equal opportunities employer. The people of Atlantic Aviation Group are the foundation of its success, and we believe that employing a diverse workforce is key to this success.

The Director, Global Service Delivery (f/m/d) - EMEA Based  is a senior leadership role within Global Engineering Services (GES), part of Siemens' Global Technologies & Infrastructure (GTI) organization. This role owns the end-to-end delivery of engineering support services across three global regions — Americas, EMEA, and APAC — serving approximately 17,000 software engineers worldwide. The Director is accountable for service quality, regional consistency, people leadership, and the ongoing transformation of the SD function.

Please send your CV in English.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Strategic Leadership

- Define and execute the global Service Delivery strategy aligned with GES and GTI priorities.- Set the vision, operating model (Follow-the-Sun), and performance standards for SD across all three regions.- Lead the annual planning cycle for SD: headcount, budget, initiatives, and OKRs.- Represent the SD function at GES leadership reviews, executive briefings, and cross-functional forums.- Drive continuous improvement in service delivery maturity, tooling, and process standardization.

Operational Excellence

- Own the end-to-end SLO/SLA framework for the SD function globally; ensure targets are met and reported.- Partner with the Global Operations Excellence (GOE) team to enforce standards, monitoring, and governance.- Ensure all regions are aligned on tooling, processes, CMDB accuracy, and asset management practices.- Oversee the successful delivery of global programmes (e.g., PCD migration, device refresh, CMDB clean-up…etc).- Identify operational risks and blockers across regions; escalate and resolve proactively.

People Leadership

- Directly lead three Regional SD Leads (Americas, EMEA, APAC) and maintain accountability for the full SD organization.- Build a high-performing, engaged, and geographically distributed team; develop regional leaders and successors.- Drive talent reviews, performance management, and calibration across the SD function.- Champion a culture of accountability, customer focus, and continuous improvement.

Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Engagement

- Serve as the primary SD point of contact for peer GTI functions.- Build and maintain strong relationships with key business stakeholders.- Collaborate with regional SD leads and managers to address customer escalations and service issues.- Provide regular operational reporting to the Senior Director, GES and GTI leadership.

Engineering Segments Engagement

- Own the customer relationship between GES and engineering segments globally; serve as the primary point of contact for segment leads regarding infrastructure, service quality, and engineering productivity.- Establish and maintain a regular engagement cadence with segment representatives to understand development pipeline needs, CI/CD tooling requirements, and environment pain points.- Proactively identify opportunities to improve developer productivity and engineering experience — including build performance, environment stability, tooling access, and onboarding friction.- Collaborate with SD Leads, GOE, and Architecture & Standards teams to translate segment feedback into actionable service improvements and capacity planning inputs.- Track and report on segments satisfaction, developer productivity trends, and GES contribution to engineering velocity — escalate where GES environment is a constraint on delivery.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE
Required

- Extensive relevant experience in infrastructure management, service delivery, or technology operations, with a significant portion of that time spent in senior leadership — managing global or multi-regional teams at scale.- Proven track record leading large, geographically distributed teams across multiple countries and regions.- Deep understanding of ITSM frameworks (ITIL) and IT governance practices (COBIT or equivalent).- Strong experience managing budgets, headcount planning, and resource allocation at a global scale.- Demonstrated ability to drive transformation programmes and change across complex organizations.- Experience operating in a matrixed, multinational corporate environment.- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; comfortable presenting to executive audiences.- Sound understanding of asset management practices, including CMDB governance, hardware lifecycle management, and software asset inventory at enterprise scale.- Demonstrable knowledge of data center operations and management, including RDC/colocation environments, capacity planning, and infrastructure governance.- Working knowledge of server and storage technologies, including enterprise server platforms, SAN/NAS storage, and backup/recovery frameworks.- Familiarity with vulnerability management processes, including risk prioritization, remediation tracking, and coordination with information security teams to ensure compliance.- Familiarity with software development practices and the software development lifecycle (SDLC); ability to engage credibly with engineering and development teams on environment and tooling requirements.- Working knowledge of CI/CD concepts and common pipeline patterns; exposure to CI/CD platforms, sufficient to understand engineering dependencies and environment requirements.- Understanding of developer workflow tooling and environment needs — including source control, build systems, artifact management, and test infrastructure — as they relate to GES infrastructure provisioning and support.

Preferred

- Background in software engineering, or large-scale enterprise Technology environments.- Hands-on or oversight experience with virtualization technologies (VMware ESXi, OpenStack, or equivalent platforms).- Experience with high-performance or grid computing environments — including job scheduling, compute cluster management, and distributed compute platforms.- Understanding of enterprise networking concepts, sufficient to oversee network-dependent service delivery.- Experience working with or transitioning to cloud-managed or hybrid infrastructure models.- Prior experience in a software engineering, DevOps, or platform engineering role — or significant direct collaboration with software development teams; comfort discussing CI/CD pipelines, build performance, and developer environment requirements.

EDUCATION
Degree — Required

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a closely related technical discipline.- Degrees in other disciplines will be considered where accompanied by strong relevant experience.

Advanced Education — Preferred

- Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering Management, or an MBA with a technology focus.

CERTIFICATIONS
IT Service Management & Governance — Preferred

- ITIL v4 Foundation — required; Managing Professional or Strategic Leader tracks highly valued.- COBIT 2019 Foundation or Practitioner — IT governance and control framework knowledge.- ISO 27001 Lead Implementer or Auditor — advantageous for security governance oversight.

Project & Programme Management — Advantageous

- PMP (Project Management Professional) — PMI.- PRINCE2 Practitioner or PRINCE2 Agile.

LOCATION & TRAVEL
This is a global role with flexibility on base location.
Regular international travel to regional sites and team face-to-face meetings is expected.

REPORTING STRUCTURE
Reports to: Senior Director, Global Engineering Services (GES)
Direct reports: Regional SD Leads — Americas, EMEA, APAC
Functional scope: Full global SD organization

Controllo tempi / contratti / spedizioni: presidio consegne, vincoli contrattuali, varianti ed extra. Valutazione e controllo costi: stime, consuntivi, supporto alla marginalità e gestione economica della commessa. Topografia e rilievi di cantiere: tracciamenti, verifiche quote/dimensioni e controllo esecutivo (in coordinamento con ufficio tecnico/DL dove previsto). description:
We're seeking a Finance Head (f/m/d) for Industrial Logistics within Digital Industries Automation Discrete Projects (DI AUT DP). In this role, you'll lead global financial management for our Industrial Logistics (IL) project business across Europe and Americas – as part of the global Finance function under our new ONE Tech Company structure.
This is your chance to shape financial operations throughout the complete project lifecycle – from bid calculations to project closure – while ensuring IFRS 15 compliance, financial performance analysis, and effective risk management. You’ll drive profitable growth, sustainable margin improvement, stable cash generation, and financial resilience through disciplined risk control across multiple countries. You'll work in a transformation environment with a clear focus on business growth, where your financial expertise directly contributes to our goals of speed, scale, and efficiency.
At Siemens, our Total Rewards approach is designed to inspire innovation, reward impact, and support your well-being at every stage of your career. From competitive pay and benefits to recognition and development opportunities, we help you thrive both personally and professionally.
You’ll make an impact by - Financial Leadership & Strategy: You lead global financial management and controlling for the Industrial Logistics project business, reporting to the Head of Finance of DI AUT DP. You drive growth and productivity initiatives to strengthen its competitive position. You govern the adoption of finance and controlling policies and guidelines based on the overall FIN strategy while ensuring compliance with all relevant financial regulations (external and internal).- Budget Planning, Forecasting & Financial Reporting: You coordinate budget planning and forecasting for the entire IL project business, ensuring IFRS-compliant accounting and timely preparation of financial closings as well as accurate books and records (monthly, quarterly, annual).- Performance Monitoring: You monitor and comment on financial performance (current development and outlook) incl. KPI analyses and performance reporting. You analyze, approve, review and forecast project revenues and costs, and ensure accurate profitability throughout the project lifecycle, as well as initiate early warnings to stakeholders when needed.- Project Finance & Risk Management: You identify and manage financial risks associated with the execution of projects, including currency, credit, and operational risks, ensuring proper risk assessment and provisioning in calculations and financial statements.- Operational Improvement & Innovation: You identify operational improvement potentials in controlling and financial processes, propose solutions and remedial measures, and drive productivity improvements through automation and innovation initiatives.- Collaboration & Transformation: You work with IL management, operational leadership, and central finance functions while supporting organizational transformation by challenging the current processes and collaborating across all stakeholder groups (e.g., FIN, P&O, EHS, GBS, SCM).- Team Leadership & Development: Finally, you manage and develop Finance and Controlling teams supporting the global IL project business. Traveling to its locations and project sites is necessary.

Your success is grounded in- Education: University degree or equivalent experience in Finance, Business Administration, Accounting, or related field - Experience and Skills:- Minimum 8-10 years in Finance, Controlling, and FP&A, preferably in international project business- Minimum 5 years leadership experience leading finance teams across multiple locations and building collaborative relationships - Proven expertise in IFRS 15 revenue recognition for long-term project contracts and commercial contract negotiations with OEM procurement organizations. Familiarity with project business models in automotive or comparable industrial environments is a strong differentiator.- Demonstrated hands-on experience in commercial contract negotiations with OEM procurement organizations, covering pricing structures, risk allocation, liability caps, and penalty/malus clauses. Ability to engage with customer purchasing teams and to represent Finance as a value-creating business partner in complex commercial discussions.- Strong knowledge of financial planning, budgeting, and controlling- Deep understanding of risk management, internal controls, compliance and audit requirements- Proficiency with ERP systems (SAP preferred) and advanced MS Office skills- Experience with organizational transformation and implementation of new business operations is beneficial

- Ways of Working:- Strategic vision meets financial excellence – combining big-picture thinking with process optimization and attention to detail- Collaborative influencer who builds trust across cultures and translates complex financial insights into clear, actionable messages- Proactive, adaptable, and able to thrive in evolving business environments - High integrity with commitment to Siemens Business Conduct Guidelines and compliance requirements
- Languages: Business proficiency in English; German language skills are a plus. Additional languages are highly welcome and beneficial for international collaboration.

title: Junior Structural Analyst
description:
Type: Full-time, permanent

Location: Vaasa, Finland/Trieste, Italy

Application deadline: 23.9.2026

Want to start your career in structural analysis and develop your FEM expertise through real engineering challenges? Wärtsilä is looking for a Junior Structural Analyst to join its Structural Analysis team!

**What will you be doing?**

As a Junior Structural Analyst, you will work with structural calculations and FEM analyses that support Wärtsiläs product and technology development. Your work will focus especially on cylinder heads and valve mechanisms, fuel systems, and gas systems. You will perform and evaluate FEM analyses, prepare technical reports, and collaborate with designers and other specialists to turn analysis results into engineering decisions.

You will join an experienced Structural Analysis team where knowledge is actively shared. Your analyses and reports will be reviewed by experienced colleagues, giving you regular feedback and support. You are encouraged to ask questions, discuss different approaches, and learn from specialists working with demanding structural analysis challenges.

You will start with clearly defined calculation assignments and take on increasingly complex analyses as your skills develop. Over time, you can deepen your expertise in different component areas and contribute to simulation method development and new ways of working. **What makes you a great fit?**

You may be taking your first steps in structural analysis or already have some relevant experience and want to deepen your FEM expertise. Most importantly, you have a solid foundation in mechanics and FEM and the motivation to develop into a structural analysis specialist.

You enjoy solving technical problems and working with others, but you are also comfortable taking ownership of your own assignments. You communicate your findings clearly, actively look for solutions, and know when to ask colleagues for input.

**We expect you to have:**

- A relevant Masters degree in Mechanical Engineering, Technical Mechanics, or a related engineering field

- A good understanding of mechanics and the fundamentals of FEM

- Practical experience with FEM through studies, projects, internships, or work

- Good communication skills in English

- A proactive approach to learning, problem-solving, and teamwork


**We consider as an asset:**

- Experience with Abaqus, Ansys, OptiStruct, Nastran, SimLab, HyperMesh, or similar simulation software

- Previous internship, summer job, or project experience related to structural analysis or mechanical engineering

- Interest in simulation method development, noise simulation, machine learning, digitalization, or other new analysis methods and tools

- Finnish or Swedish language skills


**Why join Wärtsilä?**

- Contribute to the development of Wärtsiläs marine technologies and solve engineering challenges shaped by an evolving industry.

- Work in an international R&D environment where structural analysis connects you with specialists across different engineering disciplines.

- Deepen your FEM expertise through real structural analysis challenges and gradually take on more demanding assignments.

- Learn alongside experienced specialists who review your work, share their expertise, and support your development.


**Practicalities:**

This is a permanent, full-time position, and you will be employed directly by Wärtsilä. The position can be based either in Vaasa, Finland, or Trieste, Italy, and follows Wärtsiläs hybrid working model. The starting date will be agreed upon with the selected candidate.

**Interested?**

Please submit your CV in PDF format in English or Finnish by September 23rd at the latest via aTalents application system here: https://emp.jobylon.com/applications/jobs/381526/create/. A motivation letter is optional, but with a role-specific motivation letter you can provide more information about your relevant skills and why this would be an interesting opportunity for you.

Please note that we are actively reviewing applications throughout the application period and processing them in the order they are received. Remember to use the application system, as we do not accept applications by email. We want to ensure that all applicants can participate in the process equally, and we will take individual accessibility needs into account where necessary.

You can familiarize yourself with Wärtsilä here: https://www.wartsila.com/. For more information about the recruitment process, please contact aTalents Managing Recruitment Consultant Roosa Lönnqvist (+358 50 421 0255, roosa.lonnqvist\[at\]atalent.fi).

**Company description**

_Wärtsilä is a global leader in innovative technologies and lifecycle solutions for the marine and energy markets. Through sustainable technology and data-driven innovation, Wärtsilä enables its customers to improve environmental and economic performance while accelerating the transition towards a more sustainable future. Operating in more than 70 countries and employing thousands of professionals worldwide, Wärtsilä is committed to shaping the decarbonization of the marine and energy industries through innovation, collaboration, and operational excellence._

title: Structural Analysis Expert
description:
Type: Full-time, permanent

Location: Vaasa, Finland/Trieste, Italy

Application deadline: 23.9.2026

Looking for new challenges within structural analysis that go beyond routine simulations? Join Wärtsilä to solve complex engineering problems and shape how they are analyzed.

**What will you be doing?**

As an Expert in Structural Analysis, you will solve demanding structural strength and durability challenges using FEM and numerical analysis. You will perform, evaluate, and report simulations related to dynamics, fatigue, stress, and structural strength, supporting product and technology development across cylinder heads and valve mechanisms, fuel systems, and gas systems.

Your assignments will range from focused structural calculations to complex investigations where you identify the root causes of technical challenges and determine how to move forward. You will work closely with designers, component experts, and other technical specialists, using simulation and measurement data to support engineering decisions and solve real product development challenges.

Beyond individual analysis assignments, you will contribute to developing simulation methods, processes, and new ways of working. You will share your findings and expertise within the Structural Analysis team, helping others apply new methods and learnings in their work. Depending on your expertise and interests, you may also contribute to areas such as noise simulation, machine learning, and digitalization.

**What makes you a great fit?**

You already have several years of professional experience in FEM and structural analysis, combined with a strong understanding of mechanics and numerical analysis. You are comfortable taking ownership of demanding simulation assignments, evaluating results critically, and communicating your findings and recommendations to designers and other technical specialists.

You enjoy getting to the root of complex technical problems and finding practical ways forward. You work independently when needed but value collaboration, actively seek input from others, and are equally willing to share your own expertise and learnings with the team.

**We expect you to have:**

- Professional experience in structural analysis and practical FEM simulations, preferably involving engine components or other mechanically demanding products

- An MSc or PhD degree in Mechanical Engineering, Technical Mechanics, or a related engineering field

- Experience with Abaqus, HyperMesh, SimLab, OptiStruct, or similar simulation software

- Good communication skills in English

- A proactive and solution-oriented approach, with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical teams


**We consider as an asset:**

- Experience or interest in machine learning, digitalization, or data analytics

- Experience or interest in numerical noise analysis or noise simulation development

- Experience with CFD or multiphysics simulations

- Experience developing simulation methods, processes, or analysis tools

- Finnish or Swedish language skills


**Why join Wärtsilä?**

- Solve varied structural analysis challenges, from focused simulations to complex investigations requiring deeper technical analysis.

- Shape simulation methods and ways of working, giving you opportunities to influence how structural analysis is developed and applied.

- Apply your expertise to engineering decisions that directly support the development of Wärtsiläs marine technologies.

- Collaborate across an international R&D environment where experienced specialists actively share methods, findings, and technical knowledge.

This is a permanent, full-time position, and you will be employed directly by Wärtsilä. The position can be based either in Vaasa, Finland, or Trieste, Italy, and follows Wärtsiläs hybrid working model. The starting date will be agreed upon with the selected candidate.

**Interested?**

Please submit your CV in PDF format in English or Finnish by September 23rd at the latest via aTalents application system here: https://emp.jobylon.com/applications/jobs/381516/create/. Please note that we are actively reviewing applications throughout the application period and processing them in the order they are received. Remember to use the application system, as we do not accept applications by email. We want to ensure that all applicants can participate in the process equally, and we will take individual accessibility needs into account where necessary.

_Wärtsilä is a global leader in innovative technologies and lifecycle solutions for the marine and energy markets. Through sustainable technology and data-driven innovation, Wärtsilä enables its customers to improve environmental and economic performance while accelerating the transition towards a more sustainable future. Operating in more than 70 countries and employing thousands of professionals worldwide, Wärtsilä is committed to shaping the decarbonization of the marine and energy industries through innovation, collaboration, and operational excellence._

Full time

* Esecuzione autonoma della messa in servizio di impianti di biogas e dei relativi componenti

description: Senti la necessità di aumentare le tue Competenze Linguistiche? Ti piacerebbe svolgere un percorso di formazione gratuito per imparare l' INGLESE partendo da zero? Questa potrebbe essere l'opportunità giusta per te! Gi Group SpA, Agenzia per il Lavoro Filiale di Thiene, organizza un corso di formazione GRATUITO di: Lingua Inglese Livello Base Di cosa si tratta? Il corso ha una durata di 40 ore. L'obiettivo è di acquisire le basi della lingua inglese per presentarsi, parlare della propria vita quotidiana, viaggiare e capire frasi semplici. Il corso è finanziato con fondi del PNRR nell'ambito del Programma GOL ed è rivolto a persone disoccupate domiciliate in Veneto. description: Grafton Office* è un team dedicato a valorizzare le esperienze, le competenze e il potenziale dei candidati in ambito Accounting, Sales, Marketing, HR, Legal, Purchasing and Office Management. Siamo un team di professionisti appassionati, lavoriamo per accompagnare i nostri candidati verso le mansioni ed i contesti aziendali più coerenti con le loro competenze e le loro aspettative. Per azienda cliente del settore tabacco cerchiamo : 1 Car Fleet Analyst Il Car Fleet Analyst è responsabile della gestione operativa e amministrativa della flotta aziendale, garantendo un servizio efficiente ai dipendenti e assicurando il rispetto delle policy aziendali. Collabora con i fornitori di fleet management, monitora i processi di assegnazione e manutenzione dei veicoli e supporta l'ottimizzazione dei costi e delle attività legate alla mobilità aziendale. Principali responsabilità Gestione della flotta aziendale: Gestire l'intero ciclo di vita dei veicoli aziendali: assegnazione, sostituzione, rinnovo e restituzione. Monitorare la composizione della flotta, garantendo l'allineamento con le policy aziendali. Coordinare le attività relative a manutenzione ordinaria e straordinaria, revisioni, pneumatici, assicurazioni e pratiche amministrative. Gestire eventuali anomalie, sinistri e richieste di assistenza in collaborazione con i fornitori. Gestione ordini e rapporti con i fornitori: Coordinare il processo di ordinazione dei veicoli e monitorarne lo stato di avanzamento. Interfacciarsi con società di noleggio e partner esterni. Verificare la correttezza della documentazione e delle condizioni contrattuali. Supportare le attività di budgeting, reporting e controllo dei costi della flotta. Supporto ai dipendenti: Fornire assistenza ai colleghi su tematiche relative alle auto aziendali e ai servizi connessi. Gestire richieste, segnalazioni e problematiche garantendo una risoluzione tempestiva ed efficace. Supportare i dipendenti nell'utilizzo dei portali e dei sistemi dedicati alla gestione della flotta. Reporting e analisi: Predisporre report periodici relativi a costi, utilizzo della flotta, consumi e KPI. Analizzare dati e trend al fine di identificare opportunità di miglioramento e ottimizzazione. Garantire l'aggiornamento e la qualità delle informazioni nei sistemi aziendali. Requisiti: Esperienza nella gestione di flotte aziendali o in ruoli analoghi. Conoscenza dei processi di fleet management e di mobilità aziendale. Familiarità con piattaforme e sistemi dedicati alla gestione delle flotte, come Ayvens, Arval, LeasePlan o equivalenti. Esperienza nella gestione di fornitori e contratti di noleggio a lungo termine. Conoscenza delle normative relative alla mobilità aziendale e ai fringe benefit. Buona conoscenza di Microsoft Excel e degli strumenti di reporting. description: Gi Pro Mechanics 4.0 è la specializzazione di Gi Group dedicata a valorizzare le esperienze, le competenze e il potenziale dei candidati in ambito meccanico, meccatronico ed elettromeccanico COLLABORA CON C.A.B.I.
