Progetta, realizza e mantiene in efficienza i prodotti durante l'intero ciclo di vita, gestendone anche l'integrazione con nuovi sistemi per il continuo ammodernamento. Cerchiamo la figura di MONTATORE/INSTALLATORE ELETTROMECCANICO La risorsa è il riferimento tecnico per l'assemblaggio, la revisione e la messa a punto di gruppi motore e propulsori, garantendo l'integrità funzionale del propulsore prima di qualsiasi installazione a bordo. Ti occuperai di: - Montare e collaudare parti di gruppi motore e propulsori nuovi, verificando tolleranze secondo le specifiche costruttive; - Allestire e installare gruppi meccanici ed elettromeccanici su imbarcazioni, coordinando l'integrazione con la struttura dello scafo; - Revisionare e riparare motori e propulsori usati: smontaggio, controllo dimensionale, sostituzione componenti critici, minimizzando i tempi di fermo; - Preparare e attrezzare componenti motoristici personalizzati, con o senza disegno tecnico, per rispondere a esigenze operative specifiche; - Integrare impianti idraulici e pneumatici a bordo, ottimizzando i sistemi fluidici e verificandone la tenuta e la funzionalità; - Diagnosi di guasti e anomalia, con conseguente manutenzione programmata, ordinaria e straordinaria, di motori e sistemi propulsivi, garantendo affidabilità e longevità nel ciclo di vita del mezzo; - Eseguire il collaudo funzionale dell'allestimento post-installazione, verificando la conformità alle specifiche tecniche e alle normative applicabili; - Redigere la documentazione tecnica degli interventi eseguiti; Must have: - Diploma ad indirizzo meccanico, meccatronico, aeronautico; - Esperienza minima di almeno 4 anni in ruoli analoghi di montaggio meccanico; - Ottima capacità di lettura del disegno meccanico; title: Finance Head (f/m/d) - Discrete Projects Industrial Logistics (Betriebswirt/in (Hochschule))
description:
We're seeking a Finance Head (f/m/d) for Industrial Logistics within Digital Industries Automation Discrete Projects (DI AUT DP). In this role, you'll lead global financial management for our Industrial Logistics (IL) project business across Europe and Americas – as part of the global Finance function under our new ONE Tech Company structure.
This is your chance to shape financial operations throughout the complete project lifecycle – from bid calculations to project closure – while ensuring IFRS 15 compliance, financial performance analysis, and effective risk management. You’ll drive profitable growth, sustainable margin improvement, stable cash generation, and financial resilience through disciplined risk control across multiple countries. You'll work in a transformation environment with a clear focus on business growth, where your financial expertise directly contributes to our goals of speed, scale, and efficiency.
At Siemens, our Total Rewards approach is designed to inspire innovation, reward impact, and support your well-being at every stage of your career. From competitive pay and benefits to recognition and development opportunities, we help you thrive both personally and professionally.
You’ll make an impact by - Financial Leadership & Strategy: You lead global financial management and controlling for the Industrial Logistics project business, reporting to the Head of Finance of DI AUT DP. You drive growth and productivity initiatives to strengthen its competitive position. You govern the adoption of finance and controlling policies and guidelines based on the overall FIN strategy while ensuring compliance with all relevant financial regulations (external and internal).- Budget Planning, Forecasting & Financial Reporting: You coordinate budget planning and forecasting for the entire IL project business, ensuring IFRS-compliant accounting and timely preparation of financial closings as well as accurate books and records (monthly, quarterly, annual).- Performance Monitoring: You monitor and comment on financial performance (current development and outlook) incl. KPI analyses and performance reporting. You analyze, approve, review and forecast project revenues and costs, and ensure accurate profitability throughout the project lifecycle, as well as initiate early warnings to stakeholders when needed.- Project Finance & Risk Management: You identify and manage financial risks associated with the execution of projects, including currency, credit, and operational risks, ensuring proper risk assessment and provisioning in calculations and financial statements.- Operational Improvement & Innovation: You identify operational improvement potentials in controlling and financial processes, propose solutions and remedial measures, and drive productivity improvements through automation and innovation initiatives.- Collaboration & Transformation: You work with IL management, operational leadership, and central finance functions while supporting organizational transformation by challenging the current processes and collaborating across all stakeholder groups (e.g., FIN, P&O, EHS, GBS, SCM).- Team Leadership & Development: Finally, you manage and develop Finance and Controlling teams supporting the global IL project business. Traveling to its locations and project sites is necessary.

Your success is grounded in- Education: University degree or equivalent experience in Finance, Business Administration, Accounting, or related field - Experience and Skills:- Minimum 8-10 years in Finance, Controlling, and FP&A, preferably in international project business- Minimum 5 years leadership experience leading finance teams across multiple locations and building collaborative relationships - Proven expertise in IFRS 15 revenue recognition for long-term project contracts and commercial contract negotiations with OEM procurement organizations. Familiarity with project business models in automotive or comparable industrial environments is a strong differentiator.- Demonstrated hands-on experience in commercial contract negotiations with OEM procurement organizations, covering pricing structures, risk allocation, liability caps, and penalty/malus clauses. Ability to engage with customer purchasing teams and to represent Finance as a value-creating business partner in complex commercial discussions.- Strong knowledge of financial planning, budgeting, and controlling- Deep understanding of risk management, internal controls, compliance and audit requirements- Proficiency with ERP systems (SAP preferred) and advanced MS Office skills- Experience with organizational transformation and implementation of new business operations is beneficial

- Ways of Working:- Strategic vision meets financial excellence – combining big-picture thinking with process optimization and attention to detail- Collaborative influencer who builds trust across cultures and translates complex financial insights into clear, actionable messages- Proactive, adaptable, and able to thrive in evolving business environments - High integrity with commitment to Siemens Business Conduct Guidelines and compliance requirements
- Languages: Business proficiency in English; German language skills are a plus. Additional languages are highly welcome and beneficial for international collaboration.

You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!
Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce. At Siemens, we are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that values your skills and provides equitable opportunities to progress. For us, competitiveness goes hand in hand with diverse teams and a shared sense of belonging. Our technology is powered by innovation, fueled by the diverse thinking and the unique merits of our people. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday, for everyone, together with us. As an equal opportunity employer (https://www.siemens.com/en-us/company/about/social-commitments/belonging/) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities.
About us.
We know that our business thrives only when our people thrive and unlock their full potential. That’s why you are always our top priority. Our global, diverse team is ready to support, challenge, and inspire you, helping you grow in countless ways. Together, we’ll embark on an exciting journey of discovery. Who knows where this path will lead? Join us and take an active role in shaping your future!

title: Junior Structural Analyst
description:
Type: Full-time, permanent

Location: Vaasa, Finland/Trieste, Italy

Application deadline: 23.9.2026

Want to start your career in structural analysis and develop your FEM expertise through real engineering challenges? Wärtsilä is looking for a Junior Structural Analyst to join its Structural Analysis team!

**What will you be doing?**

As a Junior Structural Analyst, you will work with structural calculations and FEM analyses that support Wärtsiläs product and technology development. Your work will focus especially on cylinder heads and valve mechanisms, fuel systems, and gas systems. You will perform and evaluate FEM analyses, prepare technical reports, and collaborate with designers and other specialists to turn analysis results into engineering decisions.

You will join an experienced Structural Analysis team where knowledge is actively shared. Your analyses and reports will be reviewed by experienced colleagues, giving you regular feedback and support. You are encouraged to ask questions, discuss different approaches, and learn from specialists working with demanding structural analysis challenges.

You will start with clearly defined calculation assignments and take on increasingly complex analyses as your skills develop. Over time, you can deepen your expertise in different component areas and contribute to simulation method development and new ways of working. **What makes you a great fit?**

You may be taking your first steps in structural analysis or already have some relevant experience and want to deepen your FEM expertise. Most importantly, you have a solid foundation in mechanics and FEM and the motivation to develop into a structural analysis specialist.

You enjoy solving technical problems and working with others, but you are also comfortable taking ownership of your own assignments. You communicate your findings clearly, actively look for solutions, and know when to ask colleagues for input.

**We expect you to have:**

- A relevant Masters degree in Mechanical Engineering, Technical Mechanics, or a related engineering field

- A good understanding of mechanics and the fundamentals of FEM

- Practical experience with FEM through studies, projects, internships, or work

- Good communication skills in English

- A proactive approach to learning, problem-solving, and teamwork


**We consider as an asset:**

- Experience with Abaqus, Ansys, OptiStruct, Nastran, SimLab, HyperMesh, or similar simulation software

- Previous internship, summer job, or project experience related to structural analysis or mechanical engineering

- Interest in simulation method development, noise simulation, machine learning, digitalization, or other new analysis methods and tools

- Finnish or Swedish language skills


**Why join Wärtsilä?**

- Contribute to the development of Wärtsiläs marine technologies and solve engineering challenges shaped by an evolving industry.

- Work in an international R&D environment where structural analysis connects you with specialists across different engineering disciplines.

- Deepen your FEM expertise through real structural analysis challenges and gradually take on more demanding assignments.

- Learn alongside experienced specialists who review your work, share their expertise, and support your development.


**Practicalities:**

This is a permanent, full-time position, and you will be employed directly by Wärtsilä. The position can be based either in Vaasa, Finland, or Trieste, Italy, and follows Wärtsiläs hybrid working model. The starting date will be agreed upon with the selected candidate.

**Interested?**

Please submit your CV in PDF format in English or Finnish by September 23rd at the latest via aTalents application system here: https://emp.jobylon.com/applications/jobs/381526/create/. A motivation letter is optional, but with a role-specific motivation letter you can provide more information about your relevant skills and why this would be an interesting opportunity for you.

Please note that we are actively reviewing applications throughout the application period and processing them in the order they are received. Remember to use the application system, as we do not accept applications by email. We want to ensure that all applicants can participate in the process equally, and we will take individual accessibility needs into account where necessary.

You can familiarize yourself with Wärtsilä here: https://www.wartsila.com/. For more information about the recruitment process, please contact aTalents Managing Recruitment Consultant Roosa Lönnqvist (+358 50 421 0255, roosa.lonnqvist\[at\]atalent.fi).

**Company description**

_Wärtsilä is a global leader in innovative technologies and lifecycle solutions for the marine and energy markets. Through sustainable technology and data-driven innovation, Wärtsilä enables its customers to improve environmental and economic performance while accelerating the transition towards a more sustainable future. Operating in more than 70 countries and employing thousands of professionals worldwide, Wärtsilä is committed to shaping the decarbonization of the marine and energy industries through innovation, collaboration, and operational excellence._

title: Structural Analysis Expert
description:
Type: Full-time, permanent

Location: Vaasa, Finland/Trieste, Italy

Application deadline: 23.9.2026

Looking for new challenges within structural analysis that go beyond routine simulations? Join Wärtsilä to solve complex engineering problems and shape how they are analyzed.

**What will you be doing?**

As an Expert in Structural Analysis, you will solve demanding structural strength and durability challenges using FEM and numerical analysis. You will perform, evaluate, and report simulations related to dynamics, fatigue, stress, and structural strength, supporting product and technology development across cylinder heads and valve mechanisms, fuel systems, and gas systems.

Your assignments will range from focused structural calculations to complex investigations where you identify the root causes of technical challenges and determine how to move forward. You will work closely with designers, component experts, and other technical specialists, using simulation and measurement data to support engineering decisions and solve real product development challenges.

Beyond individual analysis assignments, you will contribute to developing simulation methods, processes, and new ways of working. You will share your findings and expertise within the Structural Analysis team, helping others apply new methods and learnings in their work. Depending on your expertise and interests, you may also contribute to areas such as noise simulation, machine learning, and digitalization.

**What makes you a great fit?**

You already have several years of professional experience in FEM and structural analysis, combined with a strong understanding of mechanics and numerical analysis. You are comfortable taking ownership of demanding simulation assignments, evaluating results critically, and communicating your findings and recommendations to designers and other technical specialists.

You enjoy getting to the root of complex technical problems and finding practical ways forward. You work independently when needed but value collaboration, actively seek input from others, and are equally willing to share your own expertise and learnings with the team.

**We expect you to have:**

- Professional experience in structural analysis and practical FEM simulations, preferably involving engine components or other mechanically demanding products

- An MSc or PhD degree in Mechanical Engineering, Technical Mechanics, or a related engineering field

- Experience with Abaqus, HyperMesh, SimLab, OptiStruct, or similar simulation software

- Good communication skills in English

- A proactive and solution-oriented approach, with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical teams


**We consider as an asset:**

- Experience or interest in machine learning, digitalization, or data analytics

title: COC Master 500GT-3000GT or more than 3000GT (STCW II/2) (Kapitän/in)
description:
The MV Louise Michel is a former French Navy boat we’ve customized to perform search and rescue. Measuring 30 meters in length and capable of up to 28 knots, she was bought with proceeds from the sale of Banksy artwork - who then decorated her with a fire extinguisher. She is operated and crewed by a team of international activist rescue professionals.

- Main responsibilities: handling the ship, overview, control of the vessel and crew safety
- You have the final responsibility for all nautical and technical decisions concerning the operation as well as related crew intructions
- responsible for the ship’s administration (bunkering, crew-lists, customs clearance, detailed operational documentation, daily reports and statistics).
- shiphandling in harbour and during SAR-operations. Together with the officers you will familiarise the crew on the bridge and introduce them to the watch system.
- You will provide the crew with trainings and drills in emergency situations (e.g. what to do in case of fire, POB, ingress of water, unwanted visitors).
- You will work closely with the Head of operations during SAR operations, double checking all decisions against crew and ship safety as well as stability (and guest safety in case of guest already on board).
- You will work closely with the officers and chief engineer

Required:

-EC/EEA-Citizen Passport valid for at least 6 months

-Covid certificate with EU QR code needed, latest vaccine or recovery certificate no older than 180 days or a booster (other nationalities can be transferred to EU certificate)

-Seafarer Medical Certificate (fitness for sea service) according STCW I/9 (Deck Service)

-Proficiency in basic safety (STCW VI/1)

-Proficiency in survival craft and rescue boats other than fast rescue boats (STCW VI/2-1)

-Proficiency in Advanced fire fighting (STCW VI/3)

-Medical First Aid (STCW VI/4-1)

-Medical Care (STCW VI/4-2)

-GMDSS Radio Operator GOC (STCW IV/2)

-COC Master 500GT-3000GT or more than 3000GT (STCW II/2)

-German Endorsement for COC Master Course

-Seafarer's book or the German Seafarer's ID Card

-Excellent and fluent English language skills

-Confidence in decision-making, strong team leading skills, and the ability to cooperate well within a team of volunteers with various levels of nautical experience and skill.

Desired:

- Previous SAR experience
- Italian, French and Arabic language skills

title: Mystery Shopper in Latvia
description:
Mystery Shopper in Latvia

Work tasks: WHAT OUR MYSTERY SHOPPERS DO
Mystery shoppers do not need to be customer service experts, as their personal opinion is not the deciding factor. However, they must be able to assess customer interactions and the service process objectively. We measure how closely employees’ customer service aligns with their company’s service standards and expectations, enabling businesses to identify development needs and provide targeted training. At the same time, we are confident that our mystery shoppers gradually become customer service professionals themselves. We believe this experience increases their value in the job market, especially in customer-facing roles, as we continuously train and guide our mystery shoppers. Our mystery shoppers are welcome to include “Trendline Mystery Shopper” on their CV. For many employers, this demonstrates a solid understanding of customer service processes. WHAT A TRENDLINE MYSTERY SHOPPER DOES NOT DO Trendline mystery shoppers do not provoke or deliberately challenge employees with difficult or misleading questions. Our mystery shoppers visit service providers, banks, retail stores, and sales organizations. The objective is for the mystery shopper to behave like an ordinary customer. This means they do not ask unusual questions that a typical customer would not ask and do not attempt to provoke employees in any way. Mystery shopping visits are conducted according to scenarios provided by Trendline. After each visit, the mystery shopper submits a detailed report through the Trendline online platform.

We offer: https://trendline.lt
Over 25 years of experience in developing customer service and sales organizations. We operate in Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania. Our services include: mystery shopping, training, customer satisfaction surveys and feedback questionnaires, development of customer service standards, production of training videos, and internal audit tools for managers. We provide our clients with a comprehensive solution—from defining customer service standards and principles to employee training and measuring implementation and performance.

Other requirements: WHAT QUALITIES WE LOOK FOR A mystery shopper should be responsible, friendly, honest,
reliable, and willing to follow instructions carefully while maintaining a professional approach. Before applying for assignments, our mystery shoppers can review the available projects, including the scenario, evaluation questionnaire, job description, and compensation. Once an assignment is confirmed, they are free to complete the mystery shopping visit at any convenient time within the specified timeframe. After completing the visit, the mystery shopper submits a concise evaluation report through the mystery shopper module of our online platform. Our mystery shoppers always have access to our dedicated Mystery Shopper Support Service, which provides ongoing assistance to help them complete assignments to a high standard. Upon request, we also offer additional training, as well as technical and practical support. With more than 25 years of experience in training and customer service development, Trendline knows how to focus on what matters most and provides high-quality training for all mystery shoppers.

Option to work from home: Yes

description:

Gesucht wird für einen gehobenen 2-Personen-Privathaushalt in einem stilvollen kleinen Familienschloss in Liechtenstein eine erfahrene und engagierte **Hausdame / Gouvernante (m/w/d).** Die private Residenz umfasst rund 15 Zimmer sowie ein parkähnliches Grundstück. Sie arbeiten in einem gepflegten, repräsentativen Umfeld gemeinsam mit weiteren Mitarbeitenden des Hauses und übernehmen eine verantwortungsvolle Position mit hoher Eigenständigkeit.

Ihre Aufgaben

- Verantwortungsvolle Führung und Organisation des gehobenen Privathaushalts
- Sicherstellung einer tadellosen Sauberkeit, Ordnung und gepflegten Atmosphäre im gesamten Haus
- Reinigung und Pflege hochwertiger Oberflächen, Materialien und Einrichtungen
- Fachgerechte Wäschepflege, einschließlich Waschen, Bügeln, Falten und Versorgen anspruchsvoller Textilien
- Sicherer und sorgfältiger Umgang mit hochwertigen Stoffen, Antiquitäten, Kunstgegenständen und wertvollem Inventar
- Vorbereitung und Zubereitung kleiner Mahlzeiten, insbesondere des Frühstücks

- Unterstützung bei Empfängen, Einladungen und besonderen Anlässen
- Koordination und Abstimmung mit den weiteren Mitarbeitenden des Hauses
- Konsequente Einhaltung und Kontrolle der geltenden Hygiene- und Qualitätsstandards

Ihr Profil

- Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung als Hausdame, Gouvernante oder in einer vergleichbaren Position in einem gehobenen Privathaushalt
- Fundierte Vorkenntnisse aus der 4- oder 5-Sterne-Hotellerie
- Ausgeprägte Gastgeberqualität, Serviceorientierung und ein sicheres, kultiviertes Auftreten

- Selbstständige, strukturierte und gewissenhafte Arbeitsweise
- Hohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein, Diskretion und Loyalität
- Flexibilität und Freude an der Arbeit in einem privaten, exklusiven Umfeld

- Gepflegte Erscheinung und ausgezeichnete Umgangsformen
- Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Arbeitszeiten am Wochenende
- Ausgezeichneter Leumund

Geboten wird

- Eine verantwortungsvolle und langfristig ausgerichtete Position in einem außergewöhnlichen privaten Umfeld
- Ein wertschätzendes Arbeitsklima in einem professionell geführten Haushalt
- Zusammenarbeit mit weiteren erfahrenen Mitarbeitenden in Haus und Garten
- Eine vielseitige, anspruchsvolle Tätigkeit mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch

Jei dirbote Wolt ar Bolt pristatymo platformose, Jūsų patirtis yra puiki. Jums bus apmokėtas PSD, VSD, turėsite apmokamas atostogas. Nebijosite pajamų deklaracijos, nes mokesčiai yra sumokami už Jus.

title: Kokybės kontrolės ir kalibravimo inžinierius (-ė)
description:
Plečiame komandą ir ieškome atsakingo bei techniškai smalsaus specialisto, kuris prisijungtų prie mūsų laboratorijos komandos ir būtų atsakingas už komponentų kokybės kontrolę bei matavimo prietaisų kalibravimą.
Patirtis radiacinės saugos srityje nėra būtina – suteiksime visus reikalingus mokymus. Mums svarbiausia jūsų techninis mąstymas, kruopštumas ir noras mokytis.

Jūsų kasdienės atsakomybės:
• Įeitinė kontrolė (IQC): komponentų vizualinis, geometrinis ir funkcinis vertinimas pagal techninę dokumentaciją.
• Prietaisų kalibravimas: matavimo prietaisų tikrinimas, kalibravimas ir atitikties norminiams reikalavimams nustatymas.
• Dokumentacijos valdymas: kalibravimo protokolų rengimas ir kokybės įrašų priežiūra vadovaujantis ISO/IEC 17025 standarto principais.
• Neatitikčių valdymas: aptiktų komponentų ar gamybos broko fiksavimas, analizė ir konstruktyvus bendradarbiavimas su komanda ieškant sprendimų.

Mes jums siūlome:
• Aiškią investiciją į jūsų profesinį tobulėjimą: įgysite retą ir paklausią kvalifikaciją metrologijos bei radiacinės saugos srityse.
• Sertifikuotus mokymus: įmonės lėšomis apmokamus specializuotus mokymus darbui su jonizuojančiosios spinduliuotės šaltiniais ir profesionalius metrologo kursus ateityje.
• Lankstų darbo grafiką, leidžiantį geriau suderinti darbą su asmeniniu gyvenimu.
• Turėsite konkrečią profesinio augimo kryptį į metrologijos, kokybės ar produktų testavimo sritis.
• Fiziškai nesunkų (daugiausia sėdimą), tačiau intelektualiai dinamišką ir atsakingą darbą šiuolaikiškoje laboratorijoje.
• Atlyginimas: 2500-3000 € Bruto (prieš mokesčius). Konkretus atlyginimas derinamas su pasirinktu kandidatu, atsižvelgiant į jo turimas bazines technines kompetencijas.
• Profesionali, draugiška ir įvairiapusė komanda.
• Įdarbinimas ir socialinės garantijos atitinkamai su teisės aktais.
• 3 mėnesių bandomasis laikotarpis.

title: Mystery Shopper in Lithuania
description:
Mystery Shopper in Lithuania

Work tasks: WHAT OUR MYSTERY SHOPPERS DO
Mystery shoppers do not need to be customer service experts, as their personal opinion is not the deciding factor. However, they must be able to assess customer interactions and the service process objectively. We measure how closely employees’ customer service aligns with their company’s service standards and expectations, enabling businesses to identify development needs and provide targeted training. At the same time, we are confident that our mystery shoppers gradually become customer service professionals themselves. We believe this experience increases their value in the job market, especially in customer-facing roles, as we continuously train and guide our mystery shoppers. Our mystery shoppers are welcome to include “Trendline Mystery Shopper” on their CV. For many employers, this demonstrates a solid understanding of customer service processes. WHAT A TRENDLINE MYSTERY SHOPPER DOES NOT DO Trendline mystery shoppers do not provoke or deliberately challenge employees with difficult or misleading questions. Our mystery shoppers visit service providers, banks, retail stores, and sales organizations. The objective is for the mystery shopper to behave like an ordinary customer. This means they do not ask unusual questions that a typical customer would not ask and do not attempt to provoke employees in any way. Mystery shopping visits are conducted according to scenarios provided by Trendline. After each visit, the mystery shopper submits a detailed report through the Trendline online platform.

We offer: https://trendline.lt
Over 25 years of experience in developing customer service and sales organizations. We operate in Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania. Our services include: mystery shopping, training, customer satisfaction surveys and feedback questionnaires, development of customer service standards, production of training videos, and internal audit tools for managers. We provide our clients with a comprehensive solution—from defining customer service standards and principles to employee training and measuring implementation and performance.

Other requirements: WHAT QUALITIES WE LOOK FOR
A mystery shopper should be responsible, friendly, honest, reliable, and willing to follow instructions carefully while maintaining a professional approach. Before applying for assignments, our mystery shoppers can review the available projects, including the scenario, evaluation questionnaire, job description, and compensation. Once an assignment is confirmed, they are free to complete the mystery shopping visit at any convenient time within the specified timeframe. After completing the visit, the mystery shopper submits a concise evaluation report through the mystery shopper module of our online platform. Our mystery shoppers always have access to our dedicated Mystery Shopper Support Service, which provides ongoing assistance to help them complete assignments to a high standard. Upon request, we also offer additional training, as well as technical and practical support. With more than 25 years of experience in training and customer service development, Trendline knows how to focus on what matters most and provides high-quality training for all mystery shoppers.

Option to work from home: Yes

title: Head of ICT and Security Risk Management Department (m/f) – CDI
description:
Title:  Head of ICT and Security Risk Management Department – CDI

Department:  ICT AND SECURITY RISK DEPARTMENT

Description:

The Risk Management Department is responsible for the risk control function of the Bank, encompassing both Financial Risk and Operational Risk matters.
The Risk Management Department monitors existing and emerging risks, assess them and report them to the Senior Management of the Bank. It supports the business in managing their risks, providing guidance to promote risk awareness continuously.

We are seeking an experienced Head of ICT & Security Risk Management on a permanent role to lead our digital operational resilience strategy and ensure full compliance with the EU Digital Operational Resilience Act (DORA) and relevant regulatory requirements.

Your main tasks will be to:

• Be responsible for establishing and maintaining and governing a comprehensive ICT risk management framework
• Protect the Bank against cyber threats, operational disruptions, and third-party risks while enabling business growth and innovation.
• Manage and enhance the Bank's ICT risk management strategy and digital operational resilience framework in compliance with DORA regulations;
• Provide expert advisory and regular reporting to the Executive Committee and the Board of Directors on ICT Risk appetite, tolerance levels, and evolving regulatory expectations;
• Develop, maintain and enforce comprehensive ICT risk policies, procedures, and governance structures across the organization;
• Conduct and manage the Digital Operational Resilience testing program, including vulnerability management, and Threat-Led Penetration Testing and comprehensive ICT risk assessments covering all systems, applications, and third-party services whenever applicable;
• Implement continuous monitoring and threat intelligence programs to identify emerging risks;
• Develop and maintain Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for ICT risk management purpose;
• Foster collaboration across IT, Risk, Compliance, and operating units;
• Provide training and awareness programs to enhance ICT risk culture across the organization.
• Lead and manage the ICT and Security Risk Management team, while supervising the department's objectives and operational alignment.

Job requirements:

• Relevant experience in information security and ICT risk management;
• Educational background in Computer Science, IT or Information Security
• Professional certifications such as CISM, CRISC, CISSP, or CISA are highly desirable.
• Comprehensive knowledge of ICT risk management methodologies and frameworks as well as cybersecurity frameworks, industry standards and regulations (e.g. ISO27001, NIST, DORA);
• Knowledge of cybersecurity technologies including SIEM, DLP, endpoint protection, and threat intelligence;
• Proactively support business and IT teams for assessing security and ICT Risk;
• Participate in ICT and security projects;
• Adopting a growth mind-set, promoting a culture of security;
• Excellent team player with proactive and autonomous work ethics;
• Strong analytical skills with attention to details;
• Awareness of professional ethics, risk and compliance;
• Fluent in English

Please be aware that in accordance with the law of July 23, 2016, the selected candidate will be requested to provide a criminal record (section 3)

If you are interested in this position and meet the job requirements, please apply by clicking on our Nomura Recruitment Gateway.

Your team

The Pictet Group is one of the world's leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people.

Operations provide secure and efficient processing of Pictet's banking transactions and investment funds. Our teams ensure all activities follow regulations and manage risks.
By developing and maintaining a modern, robust infrastructure, we guarantee reliable, high-quality services for Pictet wealth management, asset management and real estate clients.

Your role

• Understand how double taxation treaties work and apply them in practice.
• Analyze the recoverable amount's potential derived from incomes.

• Manage the entire tax recovery process:
o Prepare tax reclaim requests.
o Complete and gather the relevant documentation in a timely manner, following up on the process until acceptance on the sub-custodian or tax administration side.
o Respond to external requests for information from sub-custodians and tax administrations.
o Reconcile and credit the tax recoverable amounts refunded.
• Collaborate with the Business Process Manager  (BPM) of the service, as well as the IT department, to implement legal and process changes into the tax system tool.
• Ensure all data is up to date in the tax tool to avoid production errors.
• Work in close collaboration with the different teams of the Tax department.
• Handle inquiries and address country-specific tax questions from internal counterparties.
• Analyze potential changes/opportunities in new markets.
• Report to management with recurrent and accurate Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and Key Risk Indicators (KRIs).

Your profile

Requested experience:

• Master's degree in Finance or Economics.
• Minimum 3 years' experience in the tax department of an audit/tax firm or the back-office department of a bank.
• Very good MS Office skills (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
• Good knowledge of banking systems (e.g., Avaloq).

Soft skills:

• Ability to cope with stress and work in a consistently changing environment.
• Strong team spirit, analytical skills, and results-driven mindset.
• Excellent communication and problem-solving skills.
• Proactive, autonomous, and able to work both independently and as part of a team.

Language skills:

• Fluent in French and English.

Senior Financial Analyst, EU Operations FP&A

Description

The right financial and business decisions have made Amazon what it is today. As a Senior Financial Analyst, you'll help us optimize our finances so that we can enhance our customer experience even more and navigate the fast-changing business environment. This role is an opportunity to act as the key finance leader and get really involved with shaping our business. You'll influence others and use insights to show senior stakeholders ways that we can move forward with our business ambitions.

• Build financial models to drive business decisions and make judgement calls on challenges using your understanding of Amazon's cost structure

Your typical day involves consolidating weekly or monthly financials for Cost-to-Serve initiatives, connecting with initiative owners to gather updates and validate data accuracy. You'll prepare insightful analyses for Management Business Reviews (MBRs) and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), focusing on trends and performance metrics. Our team uniquely bridges Operations Finance and Stores organizations, owning Cost-to-Serve strategies and cost allocations that span multiple business units. We are the only team within Operations Finance that creates this valuable connection between these two critical organizations.
Our mission centers on providing financial clarity, driving cost efficiency, and enabling data-driven decision making across the business. We take pride in our ability to influence strategic decisions through robust financial analysis and cross-functional partnerships. By joining our team, you'll have the opportunity to make a significant impact while gaining exposure to multiple aspects of the business.

• Bachelor's degree or above

• Experience working with Excel, reporting tools, and large-scale data mining tools, such as Power BI, Python, SQL, or Tableau

Réaliser des missions de consultance en architecture auprès des clients, afin de les accompagner dans la définition de leurs trajectoires cloud, l'évaluation des choix techniques et la conception de solutions adaptées à leurs enjeux métier et techniques. Supporter, concevoir et faire émerger de nouveaux services autour de ses domaines de compétence (cloud public, cloud native, architecture, automatisation, plateforme), en participant à la définition des standards, des briques techniques, de la documentation et du positionnement de ces services dans le catalogue de l'entreprise. title: (Senior) Risk Manager (Betriebswirt/in (Hochschule))
employer: Commerz Real AG Commerz Real Düsseldorf
description:
Willkommen im Team als

(Senior) Risk Manager

Das Unternehmen:

Die Commerz Real Fundmanagement S.à r.l. (“CRFM“) ist ein Spezialist für die Verwaltung von Alternativen Investmentfonds. Die CRFM trägt hierdurch zum Profil der Commerz Real AG und ihren Konzerngesellschaften (“Commerz Real Gruppe“) als integrierter Investmentdienstleister bei. Die CRFM arrangiert Alternative Investmentfonds, insbesondere für Immobilien, Infrastrukturprojekte, Anlagen zur Erzeugung erneuerbarer Energien sowie Großmobilien (wie z.B.: Flugzeuge, Schiffe und Schienenfahrzeuge). Die CRFM ist eine Tochtergesellschaft der Commerz Real AG, die ihrerseits eine Tochter der Commerzbank Aktiengesellschaft, Deutschland, ist.

Aufgabe:

- Als (Senior) Risk Manager Anlageprodukte und Teil des Risk Management Teams bist Du verantwortlich für die Risikoanalyse, Bewertung und Überwachung von (komplexen) Neu- und Bestandsgeschäften unter Beachtung von wirtschaftlichen, rechtlichen und steuerlichen Rahmenbedingungen hinsichtlich aller relevanten Risikoarten (u.a. Adressausfall-, Objektwertänderungs-, Marktpreis-, Liquiditätsrisiken, spezielle Risiken im Bereich Infrastructure wie z.B. Betriebs- und Projektentwicklungsrisiken, etc.)
- Dabei stellst Du die kompetenzgerechte Genehmigung bzw. Erstellung von Genehmigungsvorlagen für An- und Verkaufstransaktionen der AIF/Spezial-AIF sicher
- Zu Deinen Aufgaben gehört auch die Mitarbeit bei der Strukturierung und Steuerung von AIF/Spezial-AIF zur haftungsmäßigen und wirtschaftlichen Optimierung
- Ebenso verantwortest Du die regelmäßige risikotechnische Überwachung der AIF/Spezial-AIF im Wertschöpfungsprozess inkl. Überwachung der vertraglichen Finanzierungsgestaltung und des Liquiditätsmanagements
- Du unterstützt die Marktbereiche bei Vertragsverhandlungen im Neu- und Bestandsgeschäft sowie bei der Entwicklung von neuen Produkten als Mitglied in Dealteams und/oder Projektgruppen
- Die Leitung von bzw. Mitarbeit in bereichsinternen Projekten zur Optimierung / Digitalisierung der Risikoorganisation, hier insbesondere zur (Weiter-)Entwicklung von gesetzeskonformen Prozessen, Regularien und Risikotools gehört ebenfalls zu Deinen Aufgaben
- Du bringst Deine Expertise und Unterstützung bei übergreifenden Projekten sowie im Rahmen der Digitalisierungsstrategie ein. Dabei übernimmst Du auch die Leitung von übergreifenden Projekten
- Du übernimmst Coaching / Weiterbildungsaufgaben im Risikomanagement sowie die Ausbildung von Nachwuchskräften

Profil:

- Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes (auch berufsintegriertes) Studium mit der Fachrichtung Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder Rechtswissenschaften, idealerweise im Schwerpunkt Risikomanagement

description:
Description:

Business Intelligence Engineer, SCOT - Automated Inventory Management
Job ID: 10529667 | Amazon Europe Core Sarl

Description

The Supply Chain Optimization Technologies (SCOT) organization owns Amazon's global inventory management systems: we decide what, when, where, and how much we should buy to meet Amazon's business goals and to make our customers happy. We do this for millions of items, for hundreds of product lines worth billions of dollars of inventory world-wide. We foster new game-changing ideas, creating ever more intelligent and self-learning systems to maximize the efficiency of Amazon's inventory investment and placement decisions.
The Automated Inventory Management team within SCOT seeks an experienced and motivated Business Intelligence Engineer to develop analytical models and tools to automate the auditing of the SCOT systems. Such tools may include algorithms, metric bridges, dashboards, processes and workflow systems.

The successful candidate will have strong quantitative data mining and modeling skills and be comfortable working on new and sometimes ambiguous problems from concept through to execution. They will have strong communication and leadership skills, will be able to collaborate with other teams (e.g. software development, business owners, product managers) and to present findings to senior audiences to drive business improvements. As well we expect this candidate to raise the bar on any of the following categories: Data Warehousing, Data Architecture, Performant Self Service Toolsets and Data analytics. Candidate might be willing to work with the others BIEs in order to solve organizational problems at scale and setting the grounds of a healthy data products offer while delivering what is required by business.

Key job responsibilities

• Performing complex analysis to understand the behavior of automated inventory management systems, identify the root cause of system / process issues and provide insight on potential solutions.
• Building audits (analytical products) to identify trend breaks or defects at scale for millions of products and multiple Marketplaces globally
• Assessing the end-to-end suite of audits and identifying opportunities for enhancements and simplification, working with other audit owners
• Creating new solutions to automate the business process of identifying and resolving defects (e.g. through metric dashboards and automated alarms, self service dashboard, Single source of truth tables... )
• Supporting the improvement of the automated audit workflow system: integrating new audits and providing input on the future developments/roadmap
• Developing dashboards and insight products
• Fostering culture of continuous engineering improvement through blueprints, mentoring, feedback, and metrics

Basic Qualifications

• Experience in analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc.
• Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
• Experience with one or more industry analytics visualization tools (e.g. Excel, Tableau, QuickSight, MicroStrategy, PowerBI) and statistical methods (e.g. t-test, Chi-squared)
• Experience with scripting language (e.g., Python, Java, or R)
• Experience with SQL
• Experience in the data/BI space

Preferred Qualifications

• Master's degree, or Advanced technical degree
• Knowledge of data modeling and data pipeline design
• Experience with statistical analysis, co-relation analysis

Das Unternehmen:

Wir schaffen nachhaltige Lebenswelten, die begeistern. Wer in eine stabile und nachhaltige Zukunft investieren will, kommt an realen Werten nicht vorbei. Bei der Commerz Real, einem Unternehmen der Commerzbank Gruppe, stehen diese bereits seit 50 Jahren im Mittelpunkt. Ob Immobilien, Solarparks, Leitungsnetze oder Produktionsanlagen: Wir konzentrieren uns auf attraktive Sachwertinvestments, die wir mit rund 780 Mitarbeitenden im In- und Ausland für unsere Kund*innen optimal strukturieren.

Die Commerz Real Fundmanagement S.à r.l. (“CRFM“) ist ein Spezialist für die Verwaltung von Alternativen Investmentfonds. Die CRFM trägt hierdurch zum Profil der Commerz Real AG und ihren Konzerngesellschaften (“Commerz Real Gruppe“) als integrierter Investmentdienstleister bei. Die CRFM arrangiert Alternative Investmentfonds, insbesondere für Immobilien, Infrastrukturprojekte, Anlagen zur Erzeugung erneuerbarer Energien sowie Großmobilien (wie z.B.: Flugzeuge, Schiffe und Schienenfahrzeuge). Die CRFM ist eine Tochtergesellschaft der Commerz Real AG, die ihrerseits eine Tochter der Commerzbank Aktiengesellschaft, Deutschland, ist.

Aufgabe:

- Du begleitest das Team bei der Strukturierung und dem Erwerb von Immobilien, nachhaltigen Infrastrukturprojekten sowie Equity oder Private Debt Investmentprodukten
- Du erstellst Reportings von Fonds und SPVs nach LUX GAAP oder IFRS
- Als Ansprechpartner übernimmst du die Koordination und Steuerung von externen und internen Dienstleistern (z.B. Wirtschaftsprüfer, Rechts- und Steuerberater, Zentralverwalter, Buchhalter)
- Du überprüfst Steuererklärungen und Steueranmeldungen
- Du verantwortest das Liquiditätsmanagement in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Finanzdienstleistungsteam
- Du arbeitest bei der laufenden Verbesserung der Qualität und Effizienz im Bereich Finance mit und Du bist aktiv eingebunden in unsere Projekte betreffend Technologie und Prozessoptimierung

Profil:

- Du verfügst über mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Bereich Accounting (je nach Erfahrung und Kenntnissen erfolgt die Eingruppierung auf eine Junior- oder Senior- Position)
- Du kennst die einschlägigen Gesetze, Verordnungen, Vorschriften und Richtlinien (AIFM-Richtlinie, AIFM-VO, ESMA-Leitlinien, Luxemburger Gesetze)
- Du bist geübt im Umgang mit MS Office, insbesondere MS Excel und MS PowerPoint
- Du zeichnest Dich durch hohe Teamfähigkeit, Kommunikationsstärke sowie sicheres Auftreten aus

Job Description & Summary
Meet your future team
Join the Central Data Office (CDO), the team responsible for implementing the Firm's Data Strategy, supporting users, fostering the adoption of Data Management best practices, and enabling data that is Trusted, Ready to use and Protected. In this role, you will be part of the Data Governance Operations team, working closely with the Data Governance Unit Leader, Data Owners, Data Stewards, and other stakeholders across the firm.
What your role will look like
As a Data Governance Analyst Associate, you will contribute to the firm's data transformation by helping strengthen Data Governance practices across the organisation. You will support the effective use, protection, quality, and management of data while ensuring Data Governance processes and activities are followed consistently.
• Support the Data Governance Unit Leader and the Data Governance Operations team with Data Governance analysis.
• Ensure the efficient follow-up of requests related to data use across the firm and contribute to the evolution of this activity.
• Oversee data issue management activities and data requirements, including Data Subject requests in collaboration with the Data Protection Office.
• Contribute to the analysis of Data Procedures and assess their impact on Data Governance rules and processes.
• Support the management of the community of Data Owners and Data Stewards and help maintain engagement across stakeholders.
• Perform Data Retention implementation campaigns, including database storage analysis to identify areas with the greatest impact.
• Maintain Data Governance documentation, guidelines and templates, while coordinating meetings, organising logistics, and maintaining accurate records as part of the audit trail.
Your growth and opportunities
You will build practical experience in Data Governance, Data Management practices, and data regulations while contributing to the implementation of the Firm's Data Strategy. The role provides exposure to multiple business domains and stakeholder groups across the firm, helping you broaden your understanding of how data supports decision-making and governance.
The skills you bring
• Master's degree in IT, Data Management, Business Management or Sciences.
• Working knowledge of business analysis and the ability to structure large amounts of information within a process framework.
• Keen to acquire knowledge of Data Management practices (DMBOK), Data Regulation rules (GDPR, RoPA and EU data regulations), and business domains.
• Basic knowledge of Data Architecture, data modelling and database design is considered valuable for the role.

Ways of working
• Analyse information in a structured way and use data and facts to support informed decisions.
• Collaborate effectively with colleagues and stakeholders to achieve shared objectives and build trust.
• You act with integrity, handle confidential information with care, and uphold high ethical standards in every situation.
Additional skills that would support your success
• Knowledge of Project Management methodologies (Scrum, Kanban, Prince2).
• Knowledge of Product Management practices (ITIL).
The skills listed reflect what matters most to succeed in this role. If your experience aligns with them, even if your path looks different, we encourage you to apply and start the conversation with us.

Make a difference by contributing to the way data is governed, protected and used across the firm. Work with colleagues from different teams, build expertise in a growing field, and help shape trusted and reliable data practices. Grow your impact, expand your knowledge, and contribute to meaningful transformation across the organisation. Grow here. Go further.

Join the Luxair programme team and take the lead in a groundbreaking strategic project to redefine the commercial capabilities of our tour operator business.
As a Business Analyst in our Project Management & Business Analysis department, you'll drive the transformation of fuzzy business challenges into clear, actionable requirements shaping the future of our end-to-end digital product creation and commercialization processes.
Our business domain is complex and dynamic, calling for someone who's ready to learn fast, adapt, and manage complexity with confidence. You'll be at the heart of optimizing operations, aligning stakeholders across the business, and helping define best-in-class business analysis practices that set new standards for efficiency and innovation across IT.


What you'll be doing:

Mapping business processes from AS-IS to TO-BE in BPMN 2.0
Collecting needs from key users and deep dive with curiosity and persistence, being able to translate them into clear, high-quality requirements ready for design and test
Ensure Acceptance Criteria as formalized in Given/When/Then form alongside every requirement, so design and test always start from validated business need
Prioritizing requirements with the Business Owner, using MoSCoW
Owning the Requirements Traceability Matrix end-to-end, from drafting through closure
Evaluating functional solution options, challenging designs, and keeping business, application, and system layers aligned
Creating training materials and coaching teams through change
Turning data from multiple sources into clear, actionable insight for decision-makers


What you bring:

A Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
5+ years of experience in business analysis, requirements engineering, data engineering
Solid grounding in business analysis methodologies (BABOK, Design Thinking, or similar)
A track record of delivering large-scale projects with real business impact
Sharp attention to detail and a genuine passion for process and implementation into systems

title: Data Governance Analyst - CDD (m/f/d)
description:
Job Description & Summary
Meet your future team
Join the Central Data Office (CDO), the team responsible for implementing the Firm's Data Strategy, supporting users, fostering the adoption of Data Management best practices, and enabling data that is Trusted, Ready to use and Protected. In this role, you will be part of the Data Governance Operations team, working closely with the Data Governance Unit Leader, Data Owners, Data Stewards, and other stakeholders across the firm.
What your role will look like
As a Data Governance Analyst Associate, you will contribute to the firm's data transformation by helping strengthen Data Governance practices across the organisation. You will support the effective use, protection, quality, and management of data while ensuring Data Governance processes and activities are followed consistently.
• Support the Data Governance Unit Leader and the Data Governance Operations team with Data Governance analysis.
• Ensure the efficient follow-up of requests related to data use across the firm and contribute to the evolution of this activity.
• Oversee data issue management activities and data requirements, including Data Subject requests in collaboration with the Data Protection Office.
• Contribute to the analysis of Data Procedures and assess their impact on Data Governance rules and processes.
• Support the management of the community of Data Owners and Data Stewards and help maintain engagement across stakeholders.
• Perform Data Retention implementation campaigns, including database storage analysis to identify areas with the greatest impact.
• Maintain Data Governance documentation, guidelines and templates, while coordinating meetings, organising logistics, and maintaining accurate records as part of the audit trail.
Your growth and opportunities
You will build practical experience in Data Governance, Data Management practices, and data regulations while contributing to the implementation of the Firm's Data Strategy. The role provides exposure to multiple business domains and stakeholder groups across the firm, helping you broaden your understanding of how data supports decision-making and governance.
The skills you bring
• Master's degree in IT, Data Management, Business Management or Sciences.
• Working knowledge of business analysis and the ability to structure large amounts of information within a process framework.
• Keen to acquire knowledge of Data Management practices (DMBOK), Data Regulation rules (GDPR, RoPA and EU data regulations), and business domains.
• Basic knowledge of Data Architecture, data modelling and database design is considered valuable for the role.
• Fluent in French and English
Ways of working
• Analyse information in a structured way and use data and facts to support informed decisions.
• Collaborate effectively with colleagues and stakeholders to achieve shared objectives and build trust.
• You act with integrity, handle confidential information with care, and uphold high ethical standards in every situation.
Additional skills that would support your success
• Knowledge of Project Management methodologies (Scrum, Kanban, Prince2).
• Knowledge of Product Management practices (ITIL).
The skills listed reflect what matters most to succeed in this role. If your experience aligns with them, even if your path looks different, we encourage you to apply and start the conversation with us.
Take your next step
Make a difference by contributing to the way data is governed, protected and used across the firm. Work with colleagues from different teams, build expertise in a growing field, and help shape trusted and reliable data practices. Grow your impact, expand your knowledge, and contribute to meaningful transformation across the organisation. Grow here. Go further.

title: Head of ICT and Security Risk Management Department (m/f) – CDI
description:
Title:  Head of ICT and Security Risk Management Department – CDI

Department:  ICT AND SECURITY RISK DEPARTMENT

Description:

The Risk Management Department is responsible for the risk control function of the Bank, encompassing both Financial Risk and Operational Risk matters.
The Risk Management Department monitors existing and emerging risks, assess them and report them to the Senior Management of the Bank. It supports the business in managing their risks, providing guidance to promote risk awareness continuously.

We are seeking an experienced Head of ICT & Security Risk Management on a permanent role to lead our digital operational resilience strategy and ensure full compliance with the EU Digital Operational Resilience Act (DORA) and relevant regulatory requirements.

Your main tasks will be to:

• Be responsible for establishing and maintaining and governing a comprehensive ICT risk management framework
• Protect the Bank against cyber threats, operational disruptions, and third-party risks while enabling business growth and innovation.
• Manage and enhance the Bank's ICT risk management strategy and digital operational resilience framework in compliance with DORA regulations;
• Provide expert advisory and regular reporting to the Executive Committee and the Board of Directors on ICT Risk appetite, tolerance levels, and evolving regulatory expectations;
• Develop, maintain and enforce comprehensive ICT risk policies, procedures, and governance structures across the organization;
• Conduct and manage the Digital Operational Resilience testing program, including vulnerability management, and Threat-Led Penetration Testing and comprehensive ICT risk assessments covering all systems, applications, and third-party services whenever applicable;
• Implement continuous monitoring and threat intelligence programs to identify emerging risks;
• Develop and maintain Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for ICT risk management purpose;
• Foster collaboration across IT, Risk, Compliance, and operating units;
• Provide training and awareness programs to enhance ICT risk culture across the organization.
• Lead and manage the ICT and Security Risk Management team, while supervising the department's objectives and operational alignment.

Job requirements:

• Relevant experience in information security and ICT risk management;
• Educational background in Computer Science, IT or Information Security
• Professional certifications such as CISM, CRISC, CISSP, or CISA are highly desirable.
• Comprehensive knowledge of ICT risk management methodologies and frameworks as well as cybersecurity frameworks, industry standards and regulations (e.g. ISO27001, NIST, DORA);
• Knowledge of cybersecurity technologies including SIEM, DLP, endpoint protection, and threat intelligence;
• Proactively support business and IT teams for assessing security and ICT Risk;
• Participate in ICT and security projects;
• Adopting a growth mind-set, promoting a culture of security;
• Excellent team player with proactive and autonomous work ethics;
• Strong analytical skills with attention to details;
• Awareness of professional ethics, risk and compliance;
• Fluent in English

Please be aware that in accordance with the law of July 23, 2016, the selected candidate will be requested to provide a criminal record (section 3)

If you are interested in this position and meet the job requirements, please apply by clicking on our Nomura Recruitment Gateway.

• Support AML New Product Assessment activities by coordinating required inputs, tracking actions, and preparing evidence/assessment materials for AML 1LoD Lead review.
• Support regulatory strategy and change monitoring by tracking regulatory change and industry developments impacting JPMSE; maintaining a regulatory change/watch-items tracker (aligned with 2LoD) with actions, owners, and dates; and reporting progress on a regular cadence.

• Run the quarterly BAU cycle for AML Outsourcing Framework maintenance (including the Outsourcing Register) and coordinate regulatory notifications for new outsourcing.

Required qualifications, capabilities and skills

• Demonstrable experience operating within a 1LoD control environment, issue management, governance forums, escalation, evidence discipline, and sustainable remediation.
• Experience in AML and/or wider Financial Crime topics (e.g., AML governance, KYC/CDD, transaction monitoring, sanctions, fraud) and how these translate into business/operations requirements.
• Experience coordinating responses to regulatory requests and/or audits (RFIs, evidence packs, walkthrough coordination), with strong attention to defensibility and consistency of messaging.
• Ability to manage data quality in a controlled way (data sourcing understanding, reconciliations/checks, exception tracking, root cause themes, and prevention), ideally for regulatory submissions/questionnaires.
• Able to influence and drive outcomes across Business, Operations, Technology and 2LoD partners (including GFCC), including confident follow-up and escalation where required.
• Proven ability to run multiple workstreams concurrently, maintain trackers and governance cadence, and drive actions to closure under tight timelines and competing priorities.
• Strong written and verbal skills, produces concise, senior-ready updates and materials that are audit/regulator appropriate.
• Excellent Microsoft office skills, Excel ,Power Point and Word.

Executive Assistant – Corporate Governance & Board Support (M/F/X)

About Luxinnovation

Luxinnovation is Luxembourg's national innovation agency. As a semi-public institution set up as an Economic Interest Group (GIE), we empower companies to innovate today to be ready for tomorrow. We also contribute to the development of the economy as a whole by identifying innovation opportunities and fostering collaborative innovation projects that stimulate the development of a sustainable, competitive and digital economy.
Luxinnovation is supported by three ministries — the Ministry of the Economy, the Ministry for Research and Higher Education, and the Ministry of Foreign and European Affairs — as well as three semi-public institutions: the Luxembourg Chamber of Commerce, the Luxembourg Chamber of Skilled Crafts, and FEDIL – The Voice of Luxembourg's Industry.

Job mission

As an Executive Assistant reporting to the General Secretary, you will serve as the primary point of coordination for the CEO's office, managing the executive diary, organising leadership meetings and ensuring seamless communication between the CEO, internal teams and external stakeholders. You will also play a central role in corporate governance by coordinating Board of Managers meetings and General Assemblies and maintaining compliance with Luxembourg's legal obligations.
You will combine high-level administrative expertise with strong organisational skills to support the agency's leadership team in delivering on Luxinnovation's mission.

Main tasks and responsibilities

Your responsibilities are structured around Luxinnovation's four core pillars of activity:

Inspire: Representing the leadership and enhancing institutional visibility
• Welcome and accompany VIP visitors, ensuring a professional and seamless experience
• Coordinate internal and external events organised by the CEO's office and the broader leadership team
• Prepare briefing documents, background notes and speaking points for the CEO's external engagements
• Support the CEO's institutional representation at high-level meetings and conferences

Assess & Accelerate: Driving operational excellence across the executive office
• Manage the CEO's diary: schedule appointments, meetings and professional travel (transport, accommodation, programmes, visa formalities where required)
• Process and validate travel-related expense reports
• Collect, consolidate and track information for the CEO on ongoing projects, events and pending requests
• Organise semi-annual and annual performance review meetings between the CEO and direct reports
• Manage and validate leave and telework requests from the CEO's direct reports
• Ensure administrative follow-up: filing, archiving and document management

Connect: Facilitating seamless communication and cross-departmental coordination
• Plan and coordinate leadership meetings: Management Committee (MCM), Staff Meetings, Managers Meetings
• Coordinate across Luxinnovation's departments to ensure fluid communication between the leadership team, staff and external partners
• Manage incoming communications: handle phone calls, emails and relay critical information to the appropriate stakeholders
• Provide ad hoc administrative support to members of the leadership team as needed

Fund: Supporting corporate governance and institutional compliance
• Plan and organise Board of Managers meetings (Conseils de gérance) and General Assemblies
• Prepare corporate governance documents: agendas, attendance lists, proxy forms, General Assembly minutes, official convocations and draft presentations
• Prepare documentation packs and dispatch official convocations and correspondence within statutory deadlines
• Coordinate logistics and room reservations for governance meetings
• Maintain and monitor legal obligations with the Luxembourg Trade and Companies Register (RCS) and the Register of Beneficial Owners (RBE)
• Handle confidential and sensitive information with the highest level of discretion

This list is not exhaustive. Additional tasks may be assigned to the holder of the job.

Required competencies

Education level and professional experience required:
• No specific diploma is required; relevant professional experience is the primary criterion
• Minimum 5 years of proven experience in a similar executive assistant, office management or corporate governance coordination role, ideally within a C-suite environment

Specific competencies:
• Demonstrated experience in C-suite diary management and complex travel coordination
• Solid knowledge of corporate governance processes: board meetings, General Assemblies, minute-taking and statutory filings
• Excellent organisational and time-management skills with the ability to handle multiple priorities simultaneously
• Strong written and verbal communication skills across multiple stakeholder levels
• High degree of discretion and ability to handle confidential information
• Proactive, solution-oriented mindset with a keen eye for detail
• Experience coordinating cross-departmental workflows and acting as a liaison between leadership and operational teams

Languages:
• Fluent English and French are mandatory
• Luxembourgish or German is a significant asset

IT skills:
• Strong command of the Microsoft Office suite (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams)
• Very good knowledge and confident use of online tools for travel bookings, reservations, expense management and collaborative platforms

Why choose this position?
This is a unique opportunity to work at the heart of Luxembourg's national innovation agency, directly supporting the leadership team in shaping the country's innovation ecosystem. You will gain first-hand exposure to high-level strategic discussions, corporate governance and cross-departmental coordination. If you want your organisational skills to make a tangible impact, this role offers a genuinely rewarding professional opportunity within a collaborative and forward-looking institution.

Application
Interested candidates are invited to submit online their application showing their relevant experience and motivation for the role.
AI-generated applications might not be the best way to stand out. Show us the real you, and let's see where this journey takes us!
Please note that this position is based at our current offices in Esch-Belval. Luxinnovation GIE will relocate to the Luxembourg main station area in the first quarter of 2027.

This position requires deep customer focus, strong autonomy and exceptional project management skills. It will involve regular communication with executors and project sponsors at both the European and worldwide level, and requires you to be detail-oriented and comfortable partnering across functional business and technical teams. description:
Description:

Job ID: 10529667 | Amazon Europe Core Sarl

Description

The Supply Chain Optimization Technologies (SCOT) organization owns Amazon's global inventory management systems: we decide what, when, where, and how much we should buy to meet Amazon's business goals and to make our customers happy. We do this for millions of items, for hundreds of product lines worth billions of dollars of inventory world-wide. We foster new game-changing ideas, creating ever more intelligent and self-learning systems to maximize the efficiency of Amazon's inventory investment and placement decisions.
The Automated Inventory Management team within SCOT seeks an experienced and motivated Business Intelligence Engineer to develop analytical models and tools to automate the auditing of the SCOT systems. Such tools may include algorithms, metric bridges, dashboards, processes and workflow systems.

The successful candidate will have strong quantitative data mining and modeling skills and be comfortable working on new and sometimes ambiguous problems from concept through to execution. They will have strong communication and leadership skills, will be able to collaborate with other teams (e.g. software development, business owners, product managers) and to present findings to senior audiences to drive business improvements. As well we expect this candidate to raise the bar on any of the following categories: Data Warehousing, Data Architecture, Performant Self Service Toolsets and Data analytics. Candidate might be willing to work with the others BIEs in order to solve organizational problems at scale and setting the grounds of a healthy data products offer while delivering what is required by business.

Key job responsibilities

• Performing complex analysis to understand the behavior of automated inventory management systems, identify the root cause of system / process issues and provide insight on potential solutions.
• Building audits (analytical products) to identify trend breaks or defects at scale for millions of products and multiple Marketplaces globally
• Assessing the end-to-end suite of audits and identifying opportunities for enhancements and simplification, working with other audit owners
• Creating new solutions to automate the business process of identifying and resolving defects (e.g. through metric dashboards and automated alarms, self service dashboard, Single source of truth tables... )
• Supporting the improvement of the automated audit workflow system: integrating new audits and providing input on the future developments/roadmap
• Developing dashboards and insight products
• Fostering culture of continuous engineering improvement through blueprints, mentoring, feedback, and metrics

The Global Product Verification (GPV) team is Amazon's premier product authentication and verification team, protecting marketplace integrity through comprehensive product verification systems.
