title: Account Executive
description:
Are you comfortable in a world where criminal gangs are well funded, life savings of innocent people are destroyed and vulnerable people are trafficked? Do you think financial crime pays? Ever think that selling a Saas solution could help you combat this and be part of the solution? Keep reading…

Strise is a technology company, that helps top-tier banks, fintechs, and other financial institutions fight financial crime through our AI-powered AML automation solutions.

We make an impact by making it easier and faster for banks to fulfill their mission of uncovering financial violations, like money laundering. As a Series A stage company, with investors like Atomico, we're on an extremely ambitious growth trajectory.

After successfully becoming trusted by over 70% of the biggest financial institutions in Scandinavia, we are now expanding into the UK, followed by the rest of Europe. We’re well on our way to becoming the global standard in anti-money laundering.


Apply if?

  • You are ready to sell into a tough industry like finance

  • You genuinely (and not just say you do) love working in an early stage company where you need to build sales stories and processes, sometimes from 0-1

  • You are great not just at selling, but auditing the customer's current process to actually give relevant advice, not just sales fluff.


Don’t apply if…

  • You need everything to be easy and to come inbound to you to be able to sell.

  • You aren’t interested in learning the industry we work in.

  • You think MEDDIC is a new health tech startup.


About the role

We are on the lookout for a driven Account Executive, who will play a key role in achieving revenue growth across a number of markets. Your focus will be to engage potential clients, build a robust pipeline, and guide prospects through the sales process. Your influence will be critical for Strise to stay ahead with innovative, user-centric products in the global arena of financial crime prevention.

We are open to applications from those based in Oslo.

You can read more about why you should join Strise on our careers page.


Expectations?

  • Above all else you are ready for a challenge. You are expected to run your sales remit like an owner, make decisions, lead with ideas. You are not just slotting into a team; you need to create a new standard in an early-stage technology company where not everything is perfect and has a process. The excuse department is closed.

  • Prospecting and Pipeline Development. Leverage multiple channels and your creativity to target clients within our Ideal Customer Profile. You’ll have access to top-tier tools, ongoing training, and an exceptional demand generation engine to support your efforts.

  • Drive the Sales Process to Close. Lead prospects through the sales cycle—from initial contact to closing—ensuring smooth transitions through each stage while maintaining pipeline momentum.

  • Deal Orchestration. Assess strengths, recognize areas for collaboration, and effectively utilize internal resources to close deals.


We absolutely need:

  • A strong background as an Account Executive within B2B sales, SaaS, or finance with a track record of high-velocity, pipeline building.

  • Proactive and curious mindset, who thrives on finding and closing new business.

  • The ability to think outside the box to identify and engage potential clients and generate new opportunities.

  • Confident, clear, and concise communication skills, that can spark interest and create engagement.

  • Comfortable in fast-paced environments, with a willingness to adapt and learn, take responsibility, and drive new experiments.


Fantastic to have;

  • Experience using the MEDDPICC framework.

  • Experience selling AML / KYC / Compliance products.

  • Experience from working with AML and KYC in industry.


Benefits:

  • Competitive salary

  • Occupational pension

  • Generous learning budget for your personal growth and development

  • Flexible working set-up for all, with Lunch or Wellness allowance as options

  • A generous hardware budget is granted, to ensure that you are set up with the best tools to do your best work

  • A unique opportunity to join and impact a fast-growing scale-up with global ambitions in the field of anti-money laundering

  • The privilege of working with modern technology in a highly skilled and motivated team, solving a real societal problem

  • Great workplace options in Oslo (HQ with great location and standard

  • We have the best social committee in the business arranging two off-sites a year, a week workation, after-work catch-ups, monthly sauna visits, and more.


We’re focused on making Strise a great place to be, and to keep hiring great people to work with.

If you want to know more about Strise, check out life at Strise on Instagram (at-strise.ai), our podcast on Anti-Money-Laundering, The Laundry, and our YouTube channel!


Important Note: We will begin reviewing applications on November 10th, but we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.



Om arbeidsgiveren:

Strise is a fast-expanding technology company based in Oslo. We have built a revolutionary AML (anti-money laundering) Automation Cloud to help top-tier banks, fintechs, and other financial institutions fight financial crime. Our self-developed graph and AI technology centers around connecting insights about B2B clients and providing intelligent information to our customers. Vipps, SpareBank 1, and Nordea are just a few that have had great success in using Strise. title: Strategy & Insights Manager
description:
At Tise, we’re on a mission to create the world’s best second-hand marketplace — where sustainability meets style and where buying pre-loved feels even better than buying new. Following our acquisition by eBay, we’re entering an exciting new chapter, scaling our impact across the Nordics and beyond 🌍

To accelerate this journey, we’re looking for a Strategy & Insights Manager to join our Finance & Strategy team at our Oslo HQ. This is a high-impact role for someone who loves driving clarity, structure, and growth in a fast-moving environment — turning insights into action and enabling Tise’s management team to make confident, strategic decisions.


What you’ll do

As a Strategy & Insights Manager, you’ll play a central role in shaping and executing Tise’s strategy. You’ll work closely with the rest of the Finance & Strategy team, as well as the Tise management team to structure strategic processes, align cross-company initiatives, and drive projects that support growth and operational excellence.


Your responsibilities will include:

  • Provide strategic insights and enable data-driven decision-making: Lead end-to-end analytical projects with strategic importance (e.g., strategic growth opportunities, performance drivers, capital allocation and market dynamics) — from hypothesis and data collection to executive-ready recommendations and implementation follow-up. Build models and frameworks to assess business performance, forecast growth, and support investment decisions.

  • Continuous follow-up of strategic insights and initiatives: Partner with relevant functional leaders (Country Managers, Commercial/Product Managers, etc.) to ensure that we deliver on the strategy, and remain focused on the at all times highest-impact opportunities.

  • Execute on Tise’s strategic processes: Coordinate and contribute to improve our strategy process, ensuring effective prioritization, alignment, and execution across all departments. Prepare and facilitate management discussions, follow up on actions, and ensure progress tracking and alignment to company goals.

  • Drive cross-company strategic projects: Manage and support cross-functional projects with strategic importance — including new growth initiatives, GTM planning, strategic insights projects, and more.


Who you are

You are a proactive, structured, and strategic thinker who thrives in a dynamic environment. You combine strong analytical skills with business acumen and have a talent for turning complexity into clear direction.


You likely have:

  • A master’s degree in business, economics, finance, industrial economics, or a related field.

  • 4–6 years of experience from:

    • Management consulting or investment banking,

    • Strategic roles in growth companies or scale-ups,

    • Corporate strategy or business development in tech, digital, or consumer-focused industries, or

    • Finance, investment, or M&A roles with strategic exposure.

  • Proven experience leading cross-functional projects and delivering high-quality insights to senior stakeholders.

  • Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, paired with strong communication and storytelling abilities.

  • A structured and self-driven working style, with the ability to prioritize, plan, and deliver independently.

  • A collaborative mindset and comfort working across teams and disciplines.

It’s a plus if you have:

  • Familiarity with marketplace, e-commerce, or platform business models.

  • Experience with GTM planning.

  • Exposure to working in an international or multi-market setting.


Why join Tise

  • Be part of a purpose-driven company shaping the future of circular consumption — now backed by eBay.

  • Work directly with Tise’s leadership team on high-impact strategic initiatives and cross-company priorities.

  • Enjoy a high degree of ownership and visibility in one of the most exciting growth journeys in the Nordic tech scene.

  • Join a team that values autonomy, humor, and trust — with a strong focus on collaboration and impact 💚

  • Work from our vibrant Oslo HQ, with competitive compensation and benefits.


If this sounds like your kind of challenge, we’d love to hear from you!

Apply by submitting your CV and cover letter in English. Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis until the role is filled.

title: Part-time Driver Hamar
employer: ODA NORWAY AS AVD OSLO DISTRIBUSJON
description:
At Oda, we come to work every day with the goal of creating affordable grocery services to make the logistics of living surprisingly easy for our customers in Norway and Sweden. That’s what gets us fired up. First, we built Norway’s leading online grocery store and now, partnered with Mathem in Sweden, we’re on our way to becoming the world’s most effective retail system. With our wide selection and competitive prices, we deliver to the doorsteps of thousands of Scandinavian homes every week.


Would you like to join us as a part-time driver in Hamar?

As a driver with us, you play an essential role in representing Oda to our customers. You will be part of our dedicated team of drivers and report to the Delivery Operating Manager and the Delivery Team Leaders on-site. You’ll be delivering groceries and packages to our many customers in the area. We believe you'll like working as a driver at Oda if you can manage your time effectively, work independently and in a team, and approach challenges with a solution-oriented mindset. Additionally, it would be best to enjoy being active, as this job involves a lot of physical activity, not only driving.


What you’ll be doing as a Driver 🚚

  • Delivering food and packages to our customers.

title: Frontend Software Engineer (React Native, web)
description:
Monil is building world-leading technology for virtual fencing and livestock monitoring and we’re on a mission to create a product experience that matches that ambition. In just three years, we’ve grown to over 1,000 customers and more than 20,000 collars in active use across multiple markets. Now we’re entering a new phase of international growth, and the quality of our user experience will be a key competitive advantage.

Our technology is trusted not only by forward-thinking farmers, but also by leading research institutions and agricultural organizations across several countries.

As we scale globally, we need to deliver a digital experience that is as reliable, intuitive, and thoughtfully designed as the hardware and technology behind it. That’s why we’re looking for a Frontend Engineer who wants to build products that people truly depend on in environments where usability, performance, and trust matter.

In this role, you’ll help shape and build the interfaces that farmers and internal teams use daily, from onboarding and configuration to real-time monitoring and insights. You’ll work closely with product, design, and backend teams, and have a direct impact on how Monil’s platform evolves as we grow.

Our devices collect tons of data about what the animals are doing. We utilize this data to improve the lives of both animals and farmers. Our expert and experienced team runs our extensive cloud platform, applying deep expertise to provide the best solutions.

In Monil, we don't work in silos – you'll have the chance to contribute to the entire software stack together with our experienced team. We strongly believe in sharing knowledge and constantly learning, with no strict divides between frontend, back-end and infrastructure. As a Frontend Engineer in Monil, you'll work very closely together with back-end engineers and be encouraged to contribute to the entire stack.


What we're looking for

  • 1–3+ years of experience building production-ready applications with React and/or modern frontend frameworks

  • Solid understanding of TypeScript, component architecture, and state management

  • Experience working with APIs (GraphQL or REST)

  • BSc or MSc in Computer Science, Informatics or Engineering

Bonus points for:

  • Experience with React Native or native mobile development

  • Experience working in a startup or fast-paced environment

  • Real-life experience with farming or agriculture (not required, but appreciated)

  • Norwegian language skills (preferred but not required)

Fluency in Norwegian is preferred (we make exceptions for the exceptional).


Our Tech Stack

  • React and React Native: We're building our apps rapidly and correctly – React and React Native helps us do both. This mature way of building apps lets us focus on the important parts, while also peeking under the hood and build features directly for iOS and Android where needed. We're using TypeScript to enforce types, and Expo to simplify our React Native project.

  • GraphQL and gRPC: The main interface between the frontends and our servers is our GraphQL API, which lets us efficiently fetch data and update it in real-time. The API lets us fetch what we need and also communicate directly with devices on animals.

  • NodeJS, Go, Kubernetes: Our back-ends are written in Go and run on Kubernetes, letting us quickly build new APIs – with features often spanning the entire stack. Even if your main focus is Frontend, you'll get the chance to get experience with the whole stack.


We can offer

Join a high-growth startup entering an exciting international scale-up phase.You won’t just write code, you’ll own features and initiatives, influence technical decisions, and help build the foundation of a growing company.Nevertheless your work will create meaningful impact by improving animal welfare, farming efficiency, and global sustainability. You’ll collaborate with a highly interdisciplinary team across hardware, embedded systems, backend, and frontend. We offer a competitive salary, including an option program. 


Requirements

Candidates must have the right to work in Norway or within the EU/EEA, as we are unable to support relocation or visa sponsorship from outside this area.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Accelerate the worlds transition to sustainable agriculture by automating animal care. We design and build high-tech smart collars that benefits both farmer, animal and environment: - The farmer saves time and money on building fences and animal feed - The animals spend less time inside and more time grazing on open pastures - The smart collars enable grazing techniques that boost soil health and reduce the need for artificial fertilizer

  • Operational Mindset: You take pride in consistency, cleanliness, inventory management, and keeping line operations structured and calm.

  • A Growth & Mentorship Mindset: You enjoy learning alongside Justin while taking joy in helping younger team members develop their skills day by day.

  • Ownership & Reliability: You are dependable, proactive when challenges arise, and treat the kitchen with the care of an owner.

Arbeidsoppgaver Your Responsibilities:

  • Direct Leadership: Partner closely with Head Chef Justin to oversee daily kitchen operations, prep schedules, and line execution.

  • Line Command: Run the pass during busy services, ensuring high speed, precise plating, and consistent quality across every bowl.

  • Team Development: Train, mentor, and support kitchen assistants and line cooks in technique, safety, and hygiene standards.

  • Kitchen Operations: Manage daily prep lists, assist with stock control/ordering, and minimize food waste through smart inventory habits.

  • Quality & Hygiene: Maintain strict compliance with food safety (IK-Mat) and maintain a clean, organized workspace at all times.

  • Culture Keeping: Foster a safe, inclusive, and energetic environment where the team enjoys coming to work every day.

Vi tilbyr What We Offer:

  • Competitive Salary: Fair, competitive compensation based on your leadership experience and background.

  • True Partnership: A key role with real influence in a growing, independent food concept alongside an experienced Head Chef.

  • Balanced Work Environment: Paid breaks, shift meals, and structured working hours that respect personal life.

  • Room for Growth: As Tomodomo expands, you will be in a prime position for long-term career progression and creative involvement.

  • Central Location: Located at Pilestredet 24, just a 5-minute walk from Nationaltheatret T-bane station.

Key Details:

  • Location: Pilestredet 24, Central Oslo (5 min walk from Nationaltheatret)

  • Position: Sous Chef (Full-Time)

  • Working Language: English (Norwegian is a plus, but not required!)

  • Start Date: September 2026


Om arbeidsgiveren:

WE ARE TOMODOMO

A young, energetic, and independent company. Our concept brings together Japanese noodle dishes like Ramen & Udon within the Izakaya philosophy.

Our culinary Team, led by Headchef Justin Klungsøyr, brings a deep respect for local produce, culinary history, hands-on technique, and continuous learning and evolving in technique and craft.

In simple words, Tomodomo means "together." We focus on doing the dishes we serve exceptionally well, creating a casual, welcoming dining experience for our guests.

title: Data Engineer
description:
About Us:

At SurplusMap, we are revolutionizing green infrastructure and sustainable mobility through data-driven, AI-powered technology. Our platform is at the forefront of EV charging infrastructure development, geospatial data analysis, and energy forecasting, with ongoing projects supported by leading European tech organizations such as ESA, EIT Urban Mobility, and backed by investors like Equinor-Techstars, Simula, and Bentley Systems.

Join us in accelerating the green transition across Europe as we scale our platform to optimize sustainable mobility and energy solutions.

The Role:

As a Data Engineer at SurplusMap, you will play a pivotal role in supporting our data pipelines and infrastructure. You’ll collaborate with our engineering and data science teams to help maintain efficient and scalable data architectures. Working alongside our Senior team, you will gain hands-on experience with large datasets within , ETL processes, and cutting-edge AI tools to power the green energy transition.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone eager to grow their technical skills and contribute to impactful projects aimed at electrifying the transportation industry and achieving cleaner cities.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Collaborate with our engineering and data science teams to design, develop, and maintain data pipelines, including ETL processes.
  • Implement and optimize data storage solutions using Google Cloud products like BigQuery.
  • Work with DBT and Dataform to build robust data transformation workflows.
  • Assist in managing cloud infrastructure with Terraform (nice to have).
  • Ensure data integrity and security across our platform by following best practices in data engineering.
  • Support AI-powered models for EV charger utilization, energy load forecasting, and geospatial analysis.
  • Participate in the design and development of scalable data architectures, contributing to projects aimed at optimizing sustainable mobility solutions.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams on projects that integrate machine learning models for energy and infrastructure predictions.
Desired Skills and Qualifications:
  • Can-do mindset, practical and hands-on with excellent communication skills and results-oriented.  
  • Strong proficiency in Google Cloud products (especially BigQuery).
  • Hands-on experience with SQL for querying large datasets.
  • Familiarity with DBT, Dataform, or similar tools for data transformations.
  • Basic knowledge of Python for scripting and automation.
  • Exposure to Terraform for infrastructure-as-code is a plus.
  • Understanding of data pipeline design, optimization, and ETL processes.
  • Interest in AI, geospatial data, and green energy technologies (experience with GIS tools or similar is a bonus).
  • Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and collaborate with diverse teams.
  • Preferred 2+ years of experience in relevant positions
What We Offer:
  • Work on cutting-edge projects in the EV charging infrastructure and green energy space.
  • Opportunity to collaborate with world-class partners like the European Space Agency and EIT Urban Mobility.
  • A vibrant, innovative startup environment with flexible working hours at our office in StartupLab in Oslo.
  • Be part of a mission-driven team dedicated to bold innovation, sustainability, and creating positive environmental impact.
Preferred Location:

We prefer candidates based in Oslo, but we are open to remote positions for the right candidate.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Introduction to SurplusMap SurplusMap is on a mission to revolutionize the way we develop and optimize EV charging infrastructure. By leveraging advanced geospatial tools and machine learning models, we empower energy companies, local utilities, and charge point operators to make informed decisions about site selection and utilization prediction. This ensures the efficient and effective deployment of charging stations, addressing a critical need in the rapidly growing electric vehicle market. Our secret advantage is our ability to draw on Norway's leadership in EV infrastructure, combined with our collaborations with top-tier partners like Google and Bentley Systems, to deliver cutting-edge solutions. The challenge we face is significant: the current pace of infrastructure development is insufficient to meet the future demands of the booming EV market. The market is highly fragmented, causing inconvenience for EV users and difficulties for energy companies and local utilities trying to optimize their investments. For instance, the EU mandates the installation of 6,000 new charging points per week by 2030, a target that is far from being met with the current rate of deployment. This gap presents a substantial opportunity for innovative solutions like SurplusMap to make a real difference. At SurplusMap, we focus on ensuring our customers invest wisely. Our sophisticated, map-based software integrates geospatial data and machine learning algorithms to pinpoint optimal sites for new charging stations. This means our clients can invest in the right locations, install the ideal number of chargers, and maintain high utilization rates over time. By doing so, we help them maximize their investments and build a robust EV infrastructure network that meets the demands of the future. We are driven by a vision of cleaner, more sustainable cities. Electric vehicles are crucial in reducing air pollution and creating healthier urban environments. However, the key to this transition lies in the efficient deployment of charging infrastructure that provides greater flexibility to the energy grid, allowing for more renewable energy sources to be integrated. At SurplusMap, we are passionate about facilitating this energy transition. By optimizing EV charging infrastructure, we help accelerate the shift to cleaner energy, positively impacting both the environment and the communities we live in. Join us in our mission to create a greener, more sustainable future through innovative technology and strategic planning. Together, we can drive the change needed to make our cities cleaner and our energy systems more resilient.

title: Join our Account Executive teams!
description:
At Mercell, we're on a mission to revolutionize public procurement, making it accessible and effortless for everyone involved. Imagine a world where public buyers and visionary suppliers come together seamlessly to make a great deal easier and shape the future. That's what we're all about.

With a dynamic culture built on continuous growth, trust, and collaboration, Mercell offers an environment where your talents can thrive. You will be part of an international environment with ambitious and dedicated colleagues who are passionate about what they do and supported to be themselves.

Together, let's shape the future and create real value for society, one innovative solution at a time.

Join Us

We are growing our Buy-Side Sales teams and looking for ambitious Account Executives to join us in several markets. This is not a single open role, but a talent pool - an ongoing hiring pipeline which we will continuously review and match strong profiles with upcoming opportunities across our teams.

Your Mission

Our Account Executives are at the heart of Mercell’s mission. You’ll be a trusted advisor to public sector customers, guiding them through a value based buying journey and showing how Mercell’s solutions can help them achieve efficiency, compliance, and real impact for society.

You’ll manage the entire sales cycle from prospecting and qualifying leads (both inbound and outbound) to running demos, managing tender responses, negotiating terms, and closing deals.

With each success, you’ll help strengthen Mercell’s presence in your market and expand our growing community of public sector partners.

Core Responsibilities  

  • Proactively identify, engage, and build relationships with key decision-makers across your market.

  • Translate the business pains of the organization into a value based selling approach to drive large strategic engagements.

  • Own the entire sales journey from first contact and discovery to negotiation, closing, onboarding, and upselling.

  • Confidently demonstrate the value and impact of Mercell’s SaaS platform to organisations of all sizes.

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date CRM data in HubSpot, using insights to optimise pipeline and sales performance.

  • Stay ahead of developments in the local and European public procurement landscape to uncover new growth opportunities.

Required Qualifications  

  • Strong experience (ideally 3-5 years) managing a full B2B SaaS sales cycle, preferably to the public sector or highly regulated industries with a tender driven sales motion.

  • Strong experience in outbound sales and pipeline generation with demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.

  • Ability to engage confidently with senior stakeholders and decision-makers.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, agile, and collaborative environment where priorities evolve.

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills in English.

  • Fluency in at least one of the following languages: Swedish, Norwegian, Danish, German or Dutch.

Preferred Qualifications  

  • Familiarity with public procurement, tendering, or compliance-driven buying processes.

  • Experience working in an international or multi-market sales environment.

  • Strong consultative selling mindset with a focus on long-term customer value. 

Workplace type: Hybrid, working onsite at the office and from home balancing flexibility with collaboration

Locations: Sweden, Norway, Denmark, Germany, Netherlands

 

What we offer 

As a fast growing technology company, we are committed to taking care of our employees through initiatives such as hybrid work to support work-life balance, health and insurance plans (may differ per country/office), pension plans, paid parental leave, social happenings and competitive salary packages. Please see https://career.mercell.com/posts/our-perks-benefits to get more insights on what to expect of perks, benefits and culture when joining Mercell.

Has this sparked your interest?

Apply now and join our team!

This is a talent pool, there is no fixed application deadline — we will review applications continuously.

By applying, your profile will be considered for upcoming opportunities that match your skills, experience, and interests. We will keep you updated accordingly throughout the process.

-Mercell is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and experiences.

-Mercell handles all personal data in line with GDPR and our Privacy Policy.

-Mercell does not provide relocation support. We are seeking candidates who are already based in, or have existing work authorization for, the country where the role is located.

-Mercell may carry out background checks on applicants to verify information that appears on CVs and other documentation. This background check is carried out by an external party and is not carried out without the consent of the applicant. Current applicants will receive further information about this.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

At Mercell, we’re transforming how businesses manage procurement and public tendering processes. As a leading provider of digital solutions for procurement, we help organizations across Europe streamline, automate, and optimize their sourcing operations. Our cloud-based platform connects buyers and suppliers, driving transparency, efficiency, and compliance in public and private sector procurement. The Problem We Solve: Procurement is often plagued by inefficiencies, manual workflows, and a lack of transparency, making it time-consuming and prone to errors. This not only impacts operational performance but can also prevent businesses from making strategic, cost-effective decisions. At Mercell, we are solving these challenges by providing an integrated solution that simplifies the tendering process, ensures compliance with regulatory standards, and empowers businesses with data-driven insights. Why We Do It: We believe that efficient procurement is at the heart of sustainable business growth. By digitizing and optimizing the procurement process, we help organizations save time, reduce costs, and make smarter decisions, all while fostering a more competitive and transparent marketplace. Our goal is to empower organizations to focus on their core business, leaving procurement complexity to us. At Mercell, we’re driven by innovation and a passion to continuously improve the procurement landscape.

title: Production Technician
description:
Production Technician at ROEST – Bring Innovation to the Heart of Coffee!

Are you passionate about technical products, great design, and precision work? Then we may have the perfect job for you!

ROEST søker en produksjonstekniker til vårt team i Oslo, som skal montere, teste og forbedre verdensledende kaffebrennere med avansert teknologi, presisjon og design.

At ROEST, we design and produce some of the world’s most innovative coffee roasters, combining advanced technology with sleek design. Our products are renowned for precision, quality, and sustainability. With customers in over 80 countries, we’re proud to set new standards in the coffee industry.


What We Offer:
  • An exciting and varied workday with tasks including assembly, testing, service, and continuous improvement of our award-winning technology.
  • The opportunity to help launch our next-generation electric roaster .
  • A key role in producing a product that impacts the global coffee industry.
  • A collaborative work environment where we support each other to ensure top quality and efficient processes.

Your Responsibilities:

As a Production Technician/Assembler at ROEST, your tasks will include:

  • Assembling and inspecting advanced mechanical, electrical, and electronic components.
  • Performing quality control and testing of finished products.
  • Contributing to the optimization of production processes to enhance efficiency and quality.
  • Troubleshooting and repairing components when needed.

Who Are You?

You’re a great fit if you:

  • Has experience in technical assembly, mechanics, electronics, or a related field.
  • Enjoys precise, systematic work with strong attention to detail.
  • Is eager to contribute to continuous improvement in production processes
  • Thrive in a collaborative, team-driven environment.


If you’re passionate about technology, have a knack for hands-on work, and enjoy seeing tangible results from your efforts, this could be the job for you!

Your Benefits:
  • We offer a chance to work in a team-oriented working atmosphere in a fast-growing, profitable scale-up 
  • Competitive salary.
  • Employee stock program.
  • 25 days’ holiday plus bank holidays.
  • Company pension scheme.

Why Work For Us?

At ROEST, you’ll have the opportunity to make an impact and join us as we design solutions that revolutionize the coffee industry. We are on an incredible journey to create smart and efficient innovations for our customers and the coffee world.

What began as a master’s thesis has grown into a fast-paced, open-minded company with an international team passionate about improving coffee. Since 2018, we have sold over 2,000 coffee roasters to more than 80 countries worldwide. Along the way, we’ve earned numerous industry awards, including the prestigious Red Dot Award and numerous best new product awards.

We’re now preparing for our next big leap – the launch of the P3000, a cutting-edge production roaster designed to redefine coffee roasting for professional roasteries.

Join us at ROEST and be part of shaping the future of the coffee industry!


Location: ROEST is centrally located at Bryn in Oslo, Norway.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Our team is dedicated to develop and manufacture innovative products for the coffee industry, increasing quality in the cup and efficiency in the workflow. ROEST’s current portfolio includes two models of an AI powered hybrid coffee roaster designed for quality control. ROEST Sample Roaster has received several industry awards and even helped coffee enthusiasts to succeed in the World Coffee Championships. In 2023 we will launch a new production roaster for small to medium-sized roasteries. Since 2018 we have sold over 1000 roasters to more than 80 countries around the world. What started as a master thesis has turned into a fast-growing, open-minded company with an international team dedicated to improving coffee. ROEST AS became the national gaselle winner for 2022. https://www.dn.no/gaselle Our product can be viewed here: https://youtu.be/VDi4KYr3pYw Our story can be viewed here: https://youtu.be/xMdB0wTXoR8

title: Seeking COO Chief Operating Officer at ROEST
description:
ROEST, a leading Norwegian tech scale-up, is seeking a Chief Operating Officer (COO) to drive our next phase of growth. Over the past 10+ years, we have built an international success story by redefining coffee roasting using sensor technology. We are now serving leading coffee customers in over 90 countries. ROEST has a Red Dot Award for its innovative first product and was named the national “Gaselle” Company of the Year for its rapid growth in early 2023. But we are just getting started.

With the launch of our new production roaster, we are now set to scale significantly in the coming years. To support this growth, we need a strong people-focused leader who can ensure effective operations while fostering a high-performing team, and we look forward to seeing if this is you!


About the role

As ROEST’s COO, you will be responsible for daily operations across all departments, ensuring alignment with strategic goals. This role is heavily focused on people management, requiring a leader who can empower and develop our team while working closely with the founders (CEO & CTO) and department heads on execution. The role is part of a high-expectation, high-support environment, and as a team, we strive to embody curiosity, quality and challenging the status quo. We hope these values resonate with you too.


Key responsibilities:

  • Strategy: As a key member of the executive team, contribute to the development and refinement of company strategy, ensuring alignment with business objectives and market opportunities.

  • Operations: Oversee and optimize daily operations across departments, identify opportunities and initiate action plans to ensure ROEST has highly efficient, scalable and quality-oriented operations.

  • Growth: Drive sustainable growth by ensuring our processes, systems, and teams evolve in line with our expansion, scaling in a way that strengthens both our business and our culture.

  • People: Foster an inclusive and supportive environment where talent thrives, collaboration flows, and our company culture makes ROEST the place to work. Inspire people to join us - even from across the world - by building a workplace that is as exciting as our technology.


Who you are:

  • Execution oriented: you are a doer and a problem solver, with a focus on efficiency and data.

  • Proven leader: you have well-documented experience in leading teams and empowering the team and department heads to drive growth.

  • Global mindset: you have experience from working across cultures and geographies.

  • Technical savvy: you have a strong understanding of tech-driven business models, with the ability to collaborate effectively with technical teams.

  • Scaling expert: you are experienced in scaling organizations, optimizing operations, and executing strategic plans.

  • People-centric: you have strong communication, collaboration and emotional intelligence skills with a focus on team development and company culture.

  • Structured and strategic: you can balance big-picture thinking with attention to detail. Develop clear strategies while ensuring structured execution, effective processes, and thorough follow-through.


Requirements:

  • Minimum 8 years of relevant work experience.

  • A master's degree in business, economics, technology, or a related field is preferred.

  • Oslo-based or willing to relocate: the role is based in Oslo, Norway.

A plus for us:

  • Passion for coffee: You have a genuine love for coffee and an appreciation for the industry.

  • A deep understanding of startup culture, or experience from tech companies and/or manufacturing.


Why join ROEST?

  • Join a company that has spent the last decade perfecting a groundbreaking product and is now ready to scale from 40 MNOK to 500 MNOK+ in revenue.

  • Lead a highly skilled and passionate team in a creative, innovative, and global market.

  • We are still a small team (20+ people), so you can make a big impact on the future of our company and its culture.

  • An opportunity to become a shareholder at an early stage, as part of the company’s Employee Share Options Program (ESOP).


What began as a Master’s thesis has grown into a fast-paced, open-minded company with an international team passionate about improving coffee. Since 2018, we have sold over 2,000 coffee roasters in more than 90 countries worldwide and we continue on our mission to help coffee people make (even) better coffee.


📩 Apply now and be part of shaping the future of the coffee industry!

Our team is dedicated to develop and manufacture innovative products for the coffee industry, increasing quality in the cup and efficiency in the workflow. ROEST’s current portfolio includes two models of an AI powered hybrid coffee roaster designed for quality control. ROEST Sample Roaster has received several industry awards and even helped coffee enthusiasts to succeed in the World Coffee Championships. In 2023 we will launch a new production roaster for small to medium-sized roasteries. Since 2018 we have sold over 1000 roasters to more than 80 countries around the world. What started as a master thesis has turned into a fast-growing, open-minded company with an international team dedicated to improving coffee. title: Senior Go (Golang) Developer
description:

Do you have experience designing robust and scalable cloud solutions using technologies like Go and GCP?

Want to work with clean and high-quality code with minimal legacy?


Then we want to hear from you! 

As a Senior Go Developer in reMarkable, you'll not only craft state-of-the-art cloud solutions but also collaborate closely with cross-functional experts in design, embedded systems, data & insights, and frontend development. Your expertise will be instrumental in designing and championing best practices tailored for reMarkable, ensuring the robustness, scalability, and future-proof nature of our solutions. We foster a culture of continuous improvement, where you'll have the opportunity to consistently elevate our codebase.


Our main tech stack:

Go, GCP, Terraform (infrastructure as code).


Your responsibilities may include

  • Design, develop, and test backend services using Go

  • Tune robust APIs and API frameworks for a multi-tenant environment

  • Set up, monitor, and run services primarily in GCP, ensuring continuous integration and deployment of your code

  • Investigate AI opportunities within products and cloud strategy, optimizing existing models while leveraging our data's unique features

  • Build data pipelines and IAM policies to handle petabyte datasets in the cloud

  • Experience working with infrastructure as code

  • Understanding of lower level programming languages like C++ or Rust

  • Holds a higher degree in technology or a relevant field, with hands-on experience in both operations and development and a


What sets you apart is that you are able to take ownership, demonstrating an end-to-end pragmatic approach, and consistently finding creative solutions. You are an analytical thinker, who thrives in a collaborative and cross functional team.


Practical information

  • We will consider applicants on a rolling basis.

As part of our hiring process, we assess candidates' affiliation with high-risk countries, defined by PST (Norwegian Police Security Service), for security purposes. We also conduct background checks for candidates in the final stages. Data is handled in full compliance with privacy regulations. Should you reach the final stages of the recruitment process, you will be informed. Background checks will not be performed without your knowledge.

reMarkable is on a mission to help people think better through technology in a distracted world. Our paper tablet isn’t just another screen - it’s an experience. title: VP Head of Marketing
description:
About Us  

Join Kongsberg Digital — Shaping the future of work with the AI-powered Industrial Work Surface.

At Kongsberg Digital, our mission is to transform the world’s most complex and asset-intensive industries through world-leading, AI-powered digital twin technology.   

As a pioneer in industrial digitalization, we provide a comprehensive suite of software solutions that empower organizations to manage the full lifecycle of their assets—more efficiently, safely, and sustainably than ever before. 

The industry is on the cusp of a digital revolution—and we’re leading the charge. From early adoption of AI to building trusted partnerships with some of the world’s largest industrial players, we are redefining how work gets done. With domain expertise baked into every line of code and a high-calibre team united by a clear mission, we’re not just keeping pace with change—we’re setting the standard. 

As we expand rapidly across the Middle East and Africa, deepen our end-to-end offerings, and push the boundaries of AI, now is the perfect time to join a company that’s growing fast, thinking bold, and delivering real impact. 


About the role

We are seeking a strategic and execution-focused VP Head of Marketing to join our team.

Reporting directly to the Chief Revenue Officer, you will lead a global marketing organization across demand generation, product marketing and performance marketing functions, with a mandate to align marketing strategy with commercial execution and measurable revenue outcomes.

As a key member of the revenue leadership team, you will align marketing strategy with sales objectives to accelerate growth, improve pipeline velocity, and increase recurring revenue across our industrial software portfolio.

This role will shape how we position and scale our marketing capability as we strengthen our independent market identity and accelerate global growth.

You will be expected to challenge, influence and partner with executive leadership on commercial direction, positioning and growth priorities.

This is a leadership role for someone who brings clarity, focus and momentum in an ambitious scaling environment.


Key Responsibilities

Revenue & Demand Generation Leadership

  • Shape and lead the company’s global go-to-market marketing strategy, balancing long-term positioning with measurable commercial impact.

  • Build scalable inbound and outbound programs across digital, industry events, partners, and account-based marketing.

  • Align marketing initiatives directly to revenue targets and sales capacity planning.

  • Optimize funnel performance across MQL, SQL, pipeline creation, and closed-won revenue.

Product Marketing Excellence

  • Lead product positioning, messaging, and go-to-market strategy for our industrial software solutions.

  • Translate complex technical capabilities into clear, compelling value propositions for target industries.

  • Partner with Product Management and Sales to drive successful launches and field enablement.

  • Develop vertical and persona-based messaging strategies.

Pipeline & Performance Management

In this role, you will own performance across key revenue and pipeline indicators, ensuring marketing impact is measurable and trusted at executive level.

  • Establish and monitor core revenue metrics, including:

    • Marketing Qualified Leads (MQL)

    • Sales Qualified Leads (SQL)

    • Pipeline velocity

    • Pipeline conversion rates

    • Order intake and close rates

    • Recurring revenue growth

    • Customer acquisition cost (CAC)

  • Drive accountability through dashboards, reporting cadence, and executive-level insights.

  • Partner closely with Revenue Operations to ensure data integrity and forecasting accuracy.

Team & Cross-Functional Leadership

We value clear, pragmatic leadership, low ego collaboration and a strong commercial mindset. You will be expected to:

  • Build, mentor, and scale a high-performing marketing organization.

  • Foster strong alignment with Sales, Delivery, Product and Communications to ensure cohesive go-to-market execution and consistent market messaging.

  • Develop a performance-driven culture grounded in measurable outcomes and continuous optimization.


Why settle for the ordinary when you can be part of the extraordinary? 

  • Where you will have the opportunity to work alongside industry experts, thought leaders, and innovative minds who are passionate about driving change. 

  • Where you will foster a culture of creativity, collaboration, and continuous learning. 

  • Where you will reshape the norms and build a future where everyone can thrive and excel. 

  • Where you can be part of our game changing culture where we believe in empowering our employees to unleash their full potential and make a meaningful impact. 

  • Where you can be part of our commitment to creating a workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work.      


Diversity & Inclusion 

  At Kongsberg Digital, we celebrate diversity and strive for inclusivity. We strongly believe that different perspectives and backgrounds drive innovation and contribute to our success. We actively promote a culture of inclusiveness that values and respects every individual, providing equal opportunities for all our employees. Together, we will create a workplace where every game-changing employee can shine and seize equal opportunities.  

 

Application process 

If you're ready to be a game changer in the pursuit of creating a better tomorrow, seize this opportunity! Submit your resume and a compelling cover letter that showcases yourrelevant experience and articulates why joining us at Kongsberg Digital excites you.  

 

[Note to Recruitment Agencies:] 

KDI occasionally partners with recruiting agencies for specific roles. To ensure compliance we work with a limited number of preferred suppliers who follow an agreed process for vetting and representing KDI in the external market. KDI will not accept unsolicited candidates or be liable to pay associated fees unless terms are agreed with our Procurement team prior to any work being carried out.

title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
At No Isolation, your work has real purpose. We’re on a mission to bring learning and belonging to every child — and we need a sharp digital mind to help us get there. You'll be part of an international and inspiring team making a real impact on society, and playing a key role in how we show up online.


⭐️ Your role and impact.

As our Digital Marketing Manager, you'll take the lead in building and optimising our digital presence — from paid ads to SEO and social media. You’ll run campaigns, follow the data, and keep levelling up performance, making sure No Isolation shows up in a meaningful way wherever people are searching, scrolling or clicking.

We’re growing fast, entering new markets, and reaching more educators and children than ever before, and you’ll be a key part of that momentum, helping us cut through the noise and get our message to the right people in the right way. You’ll work closely with the rest of the Marketing and Sales team, and you’ll be our in-house go-to for anything digital — guiding and inspiring with your knowledge, and helping the team stay digitally sharp.


🛠 What you'll be creating.

  • Run performance-driven campaigns across Google Ads, Facebook, LinkedIn and other platforms 

  • Own our SEO efforts — from keyword research to on-page/off-page improvements

  • Analyse user data and run A/B tests to improve conversion rates (CRO)

  • Collaborate with UX and creative designers to optimise landing pages and campaign creatives

  • Identify and manage direct ad placements on relevant industry sites

  • Plan and schedule organic social content tailored to different platforms

  • Write and publish website articles together with the wider marketing team

  • Maintain and optimise website content, including landing pages for regional

  • Track and report on key metrics, media spend, and campaign ROI campaigns


🎯 Who are we looking for?

You’re someone who gets excited about digital marketing, data, and finding smart, creative ways to drive results. You know your way around campaign tools and analytics dashboards, and you’re not afraid to dive into the details and make things happen. You’re curious, up-to-date on the latest digital marketing solutions, and you love testing out new things to see what works.


Your skill set includes.…

  • Hands-on experience with Google Ads, Meta Business Manager, and LinkedIn Campaign Manager

  • Solid understanding of SEM, SEO, CRO, A/B testing and analytics tools (e.g., Hotjar, Piwik Pro)

  • Proven track record in B2B digital marketing, preferably in a tech or digital agency environment

  • Experience managing direct media buys and negotiating placements

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English — and ideally fluency in another language from our core markets (Scandinavian or DACH)


🚀 What will make you stand out?

  • You’ve worked in high-performing teams or top digital agencies

  • You balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution

  • You bring a collaborative mindset and enjoy juggling a few things at once

  • You're passionate about meaningful work and using your skills for something that matters


What’s in it for YOU? 

🌍 Impactful work. Help us reach educators and decision-makers across Europe to bring learning and belonging to every child.

🎨 Autonomy and trust. Take ownership of our digital strategy and bring your ideas to life.

📈 Growth and development. You’ll be part of an exciting scale-up journey where the pace is fast and the opportunities are wide open — new markets, new roles, new ideas. There's plenty of room to grow.

🤝 Incredible colleagues. Work with smart, inspiring people who are truly passionate about what they do.

💻 Flexible setup. Core hours are 10–15, with a hybrid work model that allows you to split your time between home and the office.

🌱 Wellness support. We offer therapy sessions, mobile/internet reimbursements, wellness hours, and PJ days. 

📍 Location: Oslo or London (hybrid). You'll work closely with both the sales team and the rest of the global marketing team. 💰 Salary: NOK 550,000–700,000 / £40,000-50,000. This range is an estimate; the actual salary will depend on experience, skills, and other factors.


🤖 Who Are We?

No Isolation was founded in 2015 when we developed AV1, a telepresence robot that helps children and young people stay connected to their education during long-term absences due to illness. Our mission is to help educators bring learning and belonging to every child.

Today, there are over 3,500 active AV1 robots used across 18 European countries. Positioned in the EdTech sector, AV1 is a unique solution to the growing issue of persistent absence, supporting both the academic and social needs of students.


nclusion And Diversity

At No Isolation, we value diversity and inclusion in our workplace. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and experiences. If you require adjustments during the application process, please contact us at below email.


We kindly ask external recruitment agencies and consultants to refrain from contacting us regarding this position.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

We help educators bring learning and belonging to every child. School absence is the biggest challenge facing education. Our AV1 robots connect absent students, ensure learning and belonging, and support reintegration back to the classroom. Today, there are over 3,500 active AV1 robots used across 18 European countries. Positioned in the EdTech sector, AV1 is a unique solution to the growing issue of persistent absence, supporting both the academic and social needs of students. No Isolation works across Europe, with 45 employees across Europe and in offices in Oslo, Munich and London. Join us in our growth journey!

title: Technical Support Manager
description:
WHO WE ARE:

Heimdall Power is a fast-growing Norwegian tech company, established in 2016. We have global ambitions and are already present in 17 European countries as well as the US and Asia. We provide solutions to optimize power grids worldwide, promoting a swift, secure and affordable green energy transition. Our unique offering combines software and sensors to increase grid capacity and monitor asset health. By enabling more efficient use of existing infrastructure we reduce carbon footprints while at the same time creating value for society, industry and our shareholders.


THE POSITION:

We are seeking a Technical Support Manager to build and lead Heimdall Power’s technical support organization. This role is critical in ensuring that our customers experience best-in-class operational support. The Technical Support Manager will be responsible for establishing and managing first-line support processes, monitoring system performance, managing escalations, and driving continuous improvements in customer support and technical operations.

This role requires a hands-on, proactive leader with a strong technical background, a passion for operational excellence, and a dedication to delivering outstanding customer service.


RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Building the Support Organization: Establish and grow Heimdall Power’s technical support team and processes. Improve support workflows, procedures, and best practices.

  • Monitoring & First-Line Support: Oversee daily monitoring of customer installations and system performance. Provide and manage efficient first-line technical support.

  • Reporting & Escalations: Implement structured reporting routines for incidents, performance metrics, and system health. Manage escalations by collaborating closely with engineering, and product teams.

  • Process Improvement: Identify and implement improvements to support processes, tools, and systems. Drive initiatives to increase support efficiency and customer satisfaction.

  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with Customer Success, Operations, Engineering, and Product teams to ensure issues are addressed swiftly and effectively.

  • Customer Advocacy: Act as a key voice of the customer internally, ensuring that support insights are shared to improve our offerings.


QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Technology, or a related field.

  • 5+ years of experience in technical support, operations, or system monitoring roles, preferably within technology or energy industries.

  • Experience in building or managing a technical support function is highly desirable.

  • Strong technical understanding of IoT systems, software platforms, and/or grid technologies.

  • Familiarity with support tools and ticketing systems.

  • Fluency in English is required; additional languages are a plus.


SKILLS:

  • High sense of ownership, structured mindset, and proactive problem-solving skills.

  • Strong leadership skills and the ability to build and motivate a team.

  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.

  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities in a dynamic environment.

  • Customer-centric mindset with a passion for delivering high-quality support.

  • Ability to work effectively within an international team and across time zones.

  • Flexibility to accommodate operational needs outside standard business hours when necessary.



WHAT WE OFFER:

  • Competitive compensation package

  • An energetic, young, and dynamic work environment

  • A chance to work with top-tier technology and contribute directly to the green transition on a global scale

  • Professional development. We strongly believe in the growth of our employees. At Heimdall Power, you will be given the necessary tools to grow as a person and a professional.

  • Work-life balance. We offer flexible working conditions, allowing you to balance your professional and personal life.


At Heimdall Power, you’ll have the opportunity to work at the intersection of cutting-edge technology and to ensure that we drive customers towards success, helping towards a meaningful change in the energy sector. If you’re passionate about developing the electrical grid, project management, thrive in a collaborative environment, and excel at building strong customer relationships, we want to hear from you!

Om arbeidsgiveren:

In Norse mythology, Heimdall is the all-seeing, all-knowing watchman who guards Asgard, the home of the gods. He possesses extraordinary abilities to see for hundreds of miles, hear the faintest of sounds, and stands vigilant at the Bifrost, the rainbow bridge connecting Asgard to the world of mortals, ready to sound the Gjallarhorn at the first sign of danger. Much like the mythical guardian, Heimdall Power ensures the safety and efficiency of power grids. Founded in Norway in 2016, we provide accurate, cost-effective monitoring of both grid capacity and health. We achieve this through advanced grid-enhancing technologies, combining world-leading sensors (Neurons) and software (Heimdall’s Brain) to optimize the performance and reliability of energy networks. Our unique autonomous drone installation system facilitates safe, quick, and scalable deployment worldwide. With our help, grid operators can unlock up to 40% more capacity in their high-voltage power grids while simultaneously improving operational safety. Our technology equips you to meet the increasing demand for electricity while reducing the need for expensive infrastructure upgrades.

title: Unity Developer
description:
👋 Hey there! We’re Attensi – a tech company born in Norway with a passion for gamified simulation training. Since 2012, we’ve gone global, and today our solutions are used by some of the world’s biggest brands in 150+ countries and 50+ languages.

We combine gamification, realistic interactive scenarios, and decision-driven dialogues – all powered by our own game AI – to create immersive, hands-on learning experiences. It's a radically new way to deliver high-impact training that scales across large organizations and actually sticks.

We work with some of the world’s largest brands in energy, retail, hospitality, pharma, professional services, and more – including Circle K, The Boston Consulting Group, PwC, Accenture, KPMG, ABB, Zurich, and Novartis. We are currently over 250 Game Changers across Europe and the US – with 140 of us based in our HQ in Oslo.

We’re currently looking for an experienced Unity Developer to help us push the boundaries of gamified learning by making world-class products.

As Attensi continues to grow, we’re looking for a skilled Unity developer to join our product development team. You’ll be part of a collaborative, cross-functional group working closely with product managers, designers, artists, and other tech teams to create simulations and training games that are engaging, effective, and fun to build.

In this role, you’ll take long-term ownership of one of our Unity products. You’ll be an integral part of the team, with real influence over how the product evolves — from big-picture decisions to everyday improvements. We’re looking for someone who enjoys shaping product direction, contributing ideas, and being actively involved in discussions about what we build and why.


Who are you?

We’re looking for a confident and capable developer who learns quickly and enjoys solving complex problems. If you’ve worked on published games, that’s a definite advantage — but just as important is your ability to dive into new challenges and contribute across different parts of the tech stack.

You have solid knowledge in one or more technical areas, such as software architecture, networking, UI, or rendering. Experience with other game engines or application/web development is also highly relevant.

Our ideal candidate has strong cross-platform development skills and a solid understanding of how to design robust, scalable software for PC, Mac, iOS/iPadOS, and Android. You’re self-driven, solution-oriented, and comfortable working independently as well as collaboratively.


We believe you’ll bring most of the following:

  • A bachelor's or master’s degree in game development, computer science, or a related field

  • Solid experience with Unity and/or Unreal Engine

  • Previous work with application or web development

  • Multiple years of relevant professional programming experience

  • A good grasp of software architecture principles


We’re looking for committed, value-driven team members who are motivated by the opportunity to help shape one of Norway’s most exciting tech companies. To thrive at Attensi, you should enjoy collaborating across disciplines, sharing knowledge, and working toward shared goals.


What can we offer you?

At Attensi, you’ll become part of an exciting and rapidly growing scale-up that’s already a global leader in its field. You’ll work in a flat, open, and collaborative environment, surrounded by committed, smart, and talented colleagues from diverse backgrounds — both culturally and academically.

We’re committed to giving people the opportunity to grow with us, and you’ll be able to shape your role over time. Expect exciting challenges in a dynamic, innovative environment with big ambitions.

We work hard, but we also have a lot of fun. From Attensi-days to sporting events, after-work drinks, parties, game nights, hackathons, guilds and company trips — we make sure we don’t just work together, we play together too.


Excited to make an impact with us? Let’s talk!

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Attensi is a Norwegian tech company specialised in gamified simulation training. Since our inception in 2012, Attensi has grown to become a global leader in the field, with training solutions used by global brands in more than 150 countries and 50 different languages. We use gamification, realistic interactive scenarios, and decision-driven dialogues, powered by our game AI, to create a ‘learning by doing’ training environment that encourages repetition and builds mastery. It is a radically new method to achieve high impact training that scales across large organisations. We work with some of the largest industry, energy, retail, hospitality, pharmaceutical and professional services brands in the world including Circle K, The Boston Consulting Group, PwC, Accenture, KPMG, ABB, Zurich, and Novartis. Attensi is growing fast and are now focused on accelerating our business growth. We are over 250 Game Changers across US and Europe, with 140 based in our thriving Oslo HQ. Are you a Game Changer?

description:

To support and expand on our international growth, we are currently seeking an energetic and motivated Business Development Director to focus on building our European market. This is a key role in our growth and is reflected in both the remuneration and opportunities for growth outlined below.


To support and expand on our international growth, we are currently seeking an energetic and motivated Business Development Director to focus on building our European market. This is a key role in our growth and is reflected in both the remuneration and opportunities for growth outlined below.

We are looking for someone smart, analytical, commercial, and curious who is comfortable taking an insight-driven approach to generating leads, converting them to meetings and communicating Attensi’s unique value proposition to land and develop new client relationships. Attensi’s products delight existing and prospective customers easily and when we have conversations with the right prospects, we have enviably high closing rates.

Our sales processes are moved forward through close collaboration with the customer so that we create value propositions and solutions that address their specific needs and pain points. For a person who enjoys the art of business development through consultative selling and collaboration with large corporations this is a fantastic opportunity to join a rapidly growing company, backed by strong investors and with solutions that make a real, measurable impact.

We are particularly excited by people who can empathize with our prospects’ learning goals and who can credibly and comfortably craft bespoke and tailored solutions to meet their needs. Since 2021, the company has been focused on growth both in the number of new customers it works with, and international expansion. We'll play a big part in shaping how the company rapidly scales.

Attensi primarily work with medium and large companies (typically ranging between 1,000 – 100,000 employees). Success in this role will depend on the ability to identify the right prospective clients, initiate conversations and conduct meetings with CxOs and director-level prospects.


You Will Have

  • BSc degree or higher

  • Proven experience of consultative selling within SaaS

  • Experience building strong and trusting relationships with prospects and clients alike to become a trusted partner at both a professional and personal level

  • At least 6-8 years' work experience

We want you to get under the skin of our business and truly understand the value we provide our customers, so that you can represent us externally with genuine excitement and confidence.


Your role will include:

  • Identifying ideal customers, and actively pursuing conversations and meetings with key decision makers in those companies, leveraging our proven playbook the ‘Attensi way of Selling’

  • Prospecting, generating leads and increasing awareness and knowledge about Attensi in the market through attending industry events and exhibitions, hosting webinars etc.

  • Mapping and specifying organisational challenges, training and development needs together with prospective customers

  • Working closely with our Customer Success team who provide operational support for our customers as well as work with them to explore upsell opportunities

  • Work closely with the broader Attensi commercial team and overall organisation to develop best practices and grow the organisation


What do we offer?

At Attensi you will become part of an exciting and rapidly growing scale-up that is already a global leader in its field. You get to work in a flat, open and free environment, surrounded by committed, smart and talented colleagues from a variety of backgrounds, both culturally and academically.

Attensi is committed to giving people the opportunity to grow and you will also be able to develop your role over time. You will also be offered exciting challenges in a dynamic and innovative environment with great ambitions.

Attensi has an energetic and social working environment. We work hard, but also have a lot of fun. Monthly social activities like Attensi-days, sporting events, after-work drinks, parties, game nights and company trips are some of the ways in which we ensure we not only work together, but also play together!


Are you a Game Changer?

title: Senior Backend Software Engineer
description:
WHO WE ARE:

Heimdall Power is a fast-growing Norwegian tech company established in 2016. We have global ambitions and are already present in several European countries as well as the US and Asia. We provide solutions to optimize power grids worldwide, promoting a swift, secure, and affordable transition to green energy. Our unique offering combines software and sensors to increase grid capacity and monitor asset health. By enabling the more efficient use of existing infrastructure, we reduce carbon footprints while creating value for society, industry, and our shareholders.


THE POSITION:

We are looking for a Senior Backend Software Engineer to help shape and deliver the core software powering Heimdall Power's grid operations platform. You will play a key role in designing and developing scalable backend services that enable real-time data processing, grid insights, and operational insights for utilities worldwide.

This is a hands-on senior engineering role focused on building backend services and software components that integrate with utility operational systems. You'll contribute to data pipelines, APIs, and automation that help our customers operate the power grid more efficiently and safely. This includes implementing aggregation techniques for time-series data, developing features that improve both user-facing insights and developer observability, and building robust backend infrastructure that supports both cloud and customer-hosted deployments.

You'll join a team that values clarity, simplicity, and long-term maintainability. We work from a monorepo, use shared infrastructure and tooling, and apply Domain-Driven Design (DDD) to ensure our software accurately reflects the complexity of the energy grid. We aim to build things once—and build them right.


RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Software Development: Design, implement, and maintain robust backend services using modern technologies and best practices

  • Architecture & Design: Contribute to system design decisions, ensuring modularity, scalability, and maintainability

  • Grid Integration: Build services and components for data ingestion, processing, and integration into customer operational systems

  • Data & Observability: Implement time-series aggregation, developer observability, and user-facing insights using the Grafana stack

  • Collaboration: Work closely with other engineers, product managers, and domain experts to deliver complete solutions

  • Continuous Improvement: Identify areas for performance optimization, automation, and architectural improvements


QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field

  • 5-8+ years of experience in backend development, ideally in distributed systems or data-intensive applications

  • Strong proficiency in C# and .NET is required.

  • Experience with cloud platforms (preferably Azure) and containerized environments (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes)

  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, and system observability

  • Strong experience with relational databases (especially PostgreSQL); bonus if you've worked with time-series data and PostgreSQL extensions such as Citus


SKILLS:

  • Strong sense of ownership, autonomy, and accountability

  • Pragmatic engineering mindset with attention to quality and performance

  • Ability to take initiative and work independently in a cross-functional setting

  • Comfortable working across data, APIs, infrastructure, and observability layers

  • Passion for sustainability, innovation, and building systems that have real-world impact


WHAT WE OFFER:

  • Competitive compensation package

  • An energetic and dynamic work environment

  • A chance to work with top-tier technology and contribute directly to the green transition on a global scale

  • Professional Development: We strongly believe in the growth and development of our employees. At Heimdall Power, you will be given the necessary tools to grow as a person and a professional

  • Work-life balance: We offer flexible working conditions, allowing you to balance your professional and personal life


At Heimdall Power, you will contribute to technology that supports the global transition to clean energy. If you are excited about solving complex challenges and building impactful software that makes a difference, we would love to hear from you!

Om arbeidsgiveren:

In Norse mythology, Heimdall is the all-seeing, all-knowing watchman who guards Asgard, the home of the gods. He possesses extraordinary abilities to see for hundreds of miles, hear the faintest of sounds, and stands vigilant at the Bifrost, the rainbow bridge connecting Asgard to the world of mortals, ready to sound the Gjallarhorn at the first sign of danger. Much like the mythical guardian, Heimdall Power ensures the safety and efficiency of power grids. Founded in Norway in 2016, we provide accurate, cost-effective monitoring of both grid capacity and health. We achieve this through advanced grid-enhancing technologies, combining world-leading sensors (Neurons) and software (Heimdall’s Brain) to optimize the performance and reliability of energy networks. Our unique autonomous drone installation system facilitates safe, quick, and scalable deployment worldwide. With our help, grid operators can unlock up to 40% more capacity in their high-voltage power grids while simultaneously improving operational safety. Our technology equips you to meet the increasing demand for electricity while reducing the need for expensive infrastructure upgrades.

title: Driver

title: Senior Product Manager

description:

Lastly we are entering the space of becoming a logistics systems provider to serve other online grocery players meaning we are commercializing our ways of working, our hardware blueprint and our proprietary smart software into Oda systems!

Are you our next Senior Product Manager?
