  • Articulate and break down strategy into actionable roadmaps together with the team.

  • Set ambitious goals and measure success by tracking progress, iterating and testing new ideas based on results and insights, ensuring continuous improvement as well as step changing when and where needed.

  • Communicate and align stakeholders by sharing key learnings, business performance updates, and strategic insights across the organization.


What's in for you?

  • Make a real difference: Revolutionize the European grocery industry with a product people love.

  • Shape the future: Drive the next generation of online grocery logistics and a company that's here to stay.

  • Pioneer a new market: Create a groundbreaking system for online groceries.

  • Drive Oda's growth: Be a key player in building a new era for the company.

  • Be part of a supportive team: Work with ambitious teammates who champion each other and in a flat structure where everyone's voice is heard.

  • Collaborate on exciting challenges: Tackle tech and product problems together across diverse fields of logistics.

  • Grow with a supportive Product Team: Find success together and learn more about our work here.


What you’ll need to succeed in the role🌟

  • Understanding of what it takes to run logistics processes and building operations; hardware, people and software in combination to create outstanding results. Simply put: a hands-on and can-do attitude.

  • Understand what it takes to build systems for external business customers; product platform, support and relationships.

  • Deep understanding of e-commerce logistics and are used to shipping products fast.

  • Focus on solving real problems, not just building features. You adapt and step change tools and processes, learn continuously, and create meaningful solutions where they matter most.

  • Have a Business and Data-Driven Mindset - with a sharp focus on product, growth and business impact in a modern tech company.

  • Deep understanding of complex problems and systems, and skilled at scaling platforms while navigating the challenges and opportunities of rapid growth with many customers.

  • Lead with a holistic approach - you are a strong leader who thrives in handling ambiguity in a complex environment. You take responsibility, set direction, and lead by example, balancing inclusivity with assertiveness, growing teams and building relationships with stakeholders and customers.

  • Lead the way and collaborate - you have 7+ years of experience in a cross-functional role, leading product teams to deliver complex software and data solutions.


What Oda offers 🚀

  • A chance to make a real impact as a Senior Product Manager in a fast-moving company - while shaking up the grocery industry.

  • Teammates from all parts of Oda who aim high and have each other’s backs. We care about people, and that means supporting each other every step of the way.

  • A flat structure where we team up across disciplines to solve exciting challenges. Big ideas come from everywhere!

  • A transparent way of working. We use Slack to stay in the loop—less email, fewer meetings, more getting things done.

  • A buzzing office at Tøyen, with lunch made by our very own chefs. 🧑‍🍳

  • A collaborative approach—we tackle exciting tech and product challenges together, across different fields of logistics.


A few final words

At Oda, you’ll join a passionate, ambitious team working to change the future of grocery shopping. We’re all different—just like you—and we wouldn’t have it any other way. If you need any adjustments or support during the application process, just let us know, and we’ll do our best to help. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and want everyone to have an equal shot at landing the job. 🧡


Next step

If you are curious to learn more about Oda and the position prior to applying, feel free to contact Erik Falk Hansen (erik at redepeople.com +47 40 43 54 93) or Glenn Bøe (glenn at redepeople.com +47 95 40 44 80) at our recruitment partner Rede People. They have a detailed prospect they happily send to you. Also feel free to check out these posts on Medium in relation to how we work.

Come build the future of grocery with us! We can’t wait to hear from you! 🧡

Our goal is to create the world's most efficient retail system. Through smart work, passionate customer focus and our own technology we make a difference in the lives of thousands of customers and change society for the better through a completely re-imagined value chain for grocery shopping. title: Senior / Principal Software Engineer
description:
About Spoor

Spoor is a venture-backed climate tech company on a mission to make wind power nature-friendly. Our AI-powered monitoring systems help wind farms reduce wildlife collisions and optimize turbine performance. Using advanced computer vision, machine learning, and edge computing, we provide real-time, actionable insights to customers operating in complex environments.

We're a multidisciplinary team of scientists, engineers, and product thinkers committed to impact and innovation. Based in Oslo, we foster a pragmatic, collaborative culture that values autonomy and technical excellence.

At Spoor, we are committed to building an inclusive, energetic and dynamic workplace where diverse perspectives thrive. Our team represents 12 nationalities, and we believe that diversity fuels high performance, creativity, innovation, and success. We strive to ensure that everyone feels valued, heard and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. If you’re passionate about our mission, we’d love to have you on board!


About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior or Principal Software Engineer to lead core systems development across backend infrastructure, ML inference pipelines, and edge computing workloads. You’ll operate across architecture and implementation, working on systems that enable real-time tracking of birds and bats, on-device species classification, and scalable data onboarding.

This is a high-impact technical leadership role, with deep individual contribution and strong cross-functional collaboration. You’ll help shape system design, guide other engineers, and take ownership of critical software foundations.


What you’ll Do

  • Architect and implement scalable backend cloud services using Python, Postgres, Docker, and AWS

  • Design and build low-latency edge computing pipelines

  • Collaborate with ML engineers to deploy and optimize vision-language models in production

  • Lead development of systems for customer onboarding, processing pipeline orchestration, and PTZ camera control

  • Apply geometry and trigonometry to solve spatial computing problems in tracking and classification

  • Drive engineering standards and best practices, design reviews, and technical direction across the team

  • Mentor junior engineers through pairing, review, and collaborative design


What we’re looking for

We recognize that experience comes in many forms, and we encourage you to apply even if you don’t check every box. If you’re excited about our mission and eager to make an impact, we want to hear from you!

We think you’ll thrive in this role if you have:

  • Minimum 6 years of professional software engineering experience

  • Strong backend development skills, particularly in Python and cloud-native systems

  • Hands-on experience with computer vision applications in production

  • Proficiency in a compiled systems language (Rust or C++) for edge computing

  • Solid understanding of mathematics, especially geometry and trigonometry

  • Proven ability to lead technical architecture while remaining deeply hands-on

  • Effective collaborator with a bias toward simplicity, clarity, and reliability


🚀 Bonus points if you have:

  • Experience with camera control systems (e.g. PTZ devices)

  • Familiarity with real-time video processing and edge deployment

  • Background in IoT, robotics, or sensor networks

  • Exposure to pipeline orchestration and data onboarding systems


Why join Spoor?

🌍 Work on a mission that matters: making renewable energy safer for nature

🧠 Solve hard, real-world problems in AI, edge computing, and applied math 🤝 Join a focused, collaborative team where your work has visible impact

🏢 Be based in Oslo with a high degree of autonomy and technical ownership

What are you waiting for? Apply now!

Note: Only candidates who will be invited for an interview will get a response.

Our vision is to help industry and nature to coexist. 🦅 With the current pressure on nature, biodiversity management is bound to see a new wave of regulations and increased pressure on industry to monitor, measure and reduce its impact. We help industry tackle this challenge with our proprietary biodiversity monitoring technology.

  • You’re generous with knowledge – you believe in collaboration, mentoring, and helping teammates grow.

  • You’re dedicated – you take pride in writing clean, scalable code and building systems that make a real impact.


We’re a supportive, cross-functional team where people share ideas openly, learn from one another, and push for quality. If that sounds like a culture you want to be part of, we’d love to hear from you.


Why we enjoy working here:

  • A modern campus located central in Oslo, specially designed to reflect reMarkable as a company.

  • Access to a free employee gym with top equipment.

  • A flexible hybrid work model

  • 5 extra “reMarkable days” you can make use of in addition to regular vacation.

  • Wednesday is Zen-day with no internal meetings to create space for you to focus, deepdive and be creative.

  • Premium health insurance, travel insurance, and home broadband coverage.

  • Access to our employee share incentive scheme.

  • Most importantly: We have fun! We have regular events and social gatherings.


Practical information:

  • We will consider applications on a rolling basis.

  • Language requirements: Our company language is english.

  • Location: Oslo, Norway.

  • Visa requirements: Citizenship/valid work permit from the EU/EEA. (Relocation assistance can be provided).


As part of our hiring process, we assess candidates' affiliation with high-risk countries, defined by PST (Norwegian Police Security Service), for security purposes. We also conduct background checks for candidates in the final stages. Data is handled in full compliance with privacy regulations. Should you reach the final stages of the recruitment process, you will be informed. Background checks will not be performed without your knowledge.


About reMarkable

reMarkable creates hardware and software products that help people all over the world find focus. We want to combine the best of both worlds: the digital and the analogue, and to create tools that enhance learning, focus and presence for knowledge workers. Our tablet isn’t just another screen - it’s an experience. We add the warmth of paper to digital solutions, creating something brand new. We are enabling better thinking through technology.

Join us in preserving human creativity amidst a sea of technological time thieves!!

title: Fullstack Software Engineer - Data & AI
description:
👋 Hey there! We’re Attensi – a tech company born in Norway with a passion for gamified simulation training. Since 2012, we’ve gone global, and today our solutions are used by some of the world’s biggest brands in 150+ countries and 50+ languages.

We combine gamification, realistic interactive scenarios, and decision-driven dialogues – all powered by our own game AI – to create immersive, hands-on learning experiences. It's a radically new way to deliver high-impact training that scales across large organizations and actually sticks.

We work with some of the world’s largest brands in energy, retail, hospitality, pharma, professional services, and more – including Circle K, The Boston Consulting Group, PwC, Accenture, KPMG, ABB, Zurich, and Novartis. We are currently over 240 Game Changers across Europe and the US – with 140 of us based in our HQ in Oslo.

We're now seeking a developer who understands both code and context — someone who can build interfaces that make data actionable.


Join Attensi INSIGHTS — where raw training data becomes clear, actionable stories.

We’re building a next-generation analytics platform that helps users explore, interpret, and act on complex datasets with ease. Your work will shape the interfaces that turn this data into real impact for our clients.

This is a fullstack role with a strong frontend focus — ideal for someone who loves building user-first data products, learns fast, and thrives at the intersection of design, data, and AI. You’ll be a key part of a nimble, cross-functional team, collaborating with backend services and our data platform team to create seamless, high-performance web experiences. We value velocity, clarity, and autonomy — and we’re looking for someone who does too.


You'll:

  • Build intuitive, data-rich interfaces that support deep exploration and storytelling

  • Translate complex data structures into clean, interactive UIs

  • Contribute to AI-driven product features that surface insights and drive decisions

  • Collaborate closely with backend and data teams on architecture and APIs

  • Write scalable, maintainable code focused on user value and performance


The stack you'll work with: We use a modern, evolving tech stack. You don’t need to know it all — but you should be eager to learn fast and go deep when needed:

  • Frontend: Vue 3, TypeScript

  • Backend: Node.js, C#, .NET

  • Data: PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Docker, data visualization tools

  • AI & Analytics: Tools for structured data handling and model integration


Who are you?

  • A frontend-leaning fullstack engineer who’s built complex web-based apps — ideally with a data or analytics focus

  • Curious, resourceful, and fast-learning — you pick up new technologies quickly and thrive in fast-moving environments

  • Comfortable navigating both frontend and backend architecture, and how they fit together to deliver value

  • Passionate about building clean, understandable interfaces that empower users

  • Excited by the opportunity to work on AI-native tools and help shape how people interact with data in the future

  • A team player who collaborates closely with engineers, designers, and product thinkers

  • You’ve owned product features end-to-end and enjoy shaping not just the ‘how’ but the ‘why’


What do we offer?

At Attensi, you’ll become part of an exciting and rapidly growing scale-up that’s already a global leader in its field. You’ll work in a flat, open, and collaborative environment, surrounded by committed, smart, and talented colleagues from diverse backgrounds — both culturally and academically.

We’re committed to giving people the opportunity to grow with us, and you’ll be able to shape your role over time. Expect exciting challenges in a dynamic, innovative environment with big ambitions.

We work hard, but we also have a lot of fun. From Attensi-days to sporting events, after-work drinks, parties, game nights, hackathons, guilds and company trips — we make sure we don’t just work together, we play together too.


Excited to make training data simple, meaningful, and actionable?

Send us your CV — and if you’ve got any dashboards, data projects, or frontend work you’re proud of, we’d love to check them out. Bonus points if you can share something you’ve built!

We’re looking for curious, collaborative developers who want to make a real difference by turning complex data into simple, powerful tools — and who are excited to grow and push boundaries with a passionate, product-driven team.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Attensi is a Norwegian tech company specialised in gamified simulation training. Since our inception in 2012, Attensi has grown to become a global leader in the field, with training solutions used by global brands in more than 150 countries and 50 different languages. We use gamification, realistic interactive scenarios, and decision-driven dialogues, powered by our game AI, to create a ‘learning by doing’ training environment that encourages repetition and builds mastery. It is a radically new method to achieve high impact training that scales across large organisations. We work with some of the largest industry, energy, retail, hospitality, pharmaceutical and professional services brands in the world including Circle K, The Boston Consulting Group, PwC, Accenture, KPMG, ABB, Zurich, and Novartis. Attensi is growing fast and are now focused on accelerating our business growth. We are over 250 Game Changers across US and Europe, with 140 based in our thriving Oslo HQ. Are you a Game Changer?

title: Project Manager
employer: ODA NORWAY AS AVD OSLO SALG
description:
At Oda, we develop affordable grocery services to make the logistics of living surprisingly easy. First we built Norway’s leading online grocery store and now, partnered with Mathem in Sweden, we’re on our way to becoming the world’s most effective retail system, delivering to thousands of Scandinavian doorsteps every week.

As part of our team, you’ll work with smart, passionate colleagues who bring their whole selves to work every day. It’s a fast-moving, collaborative environment where everyone is welcome and everyone’s opinion matters. Whether you're shaping the future of online retail, tackling complex logistical problems, or making everyday life better for our customers, your work will have a real impact. Read on to find out what part you could play in our story.

We’re looking for a Project Manager to join the Creative & Content team at Oda!

We’re looking for a temporary Project Manager, Creative & Content to join Growth & Marketing team while covering a parental leave in the team. In this role, you’ll be the driving force behind all creative production execution in Norway and Sweden – the key connector who turns ideas into action, and action into growth.

You’ll lead creative production projects from start to finish, explore new growth opportunities, and help shape our marketing and brand plans. In other words: you’ll play a key role in taking Growth Norway to new heights and strengthening our results in the Norwegian and Swedish market. 🚀

This is a temporary position running from November 2025 to January 31, 2027, reporting directly to the Head of Creative.


What you’ll be doing as  Project Manager

  • Drive end-to-end delivery of creative and marketing projects in both Oda and Mathem – from initial concept to final execution – ensuring every detail is on point.

  • Keep timelines, budgets, and quality in check while juggling multiple projects with ease.

  • Partner with internal creative teams and external creative agencies to bring ideas to life and deliver impactful campaigns.

  • Champion smooth workflows using tools like Asana, Trello, or Microsoft Project, and optimize CRM platform usage.

  • Communicate with clarity, influence stakeholders, and build strong cross-functional relationships.


To thrive in this role, we believe you’re a natural project leader – equally comfortable steering big, complex initiatives as you are keeping track of the small but important details. You have a knack for bringing order to moving parts, ensuring nothing falls through the cracks, and you take pride in delivering projects on time, on budget, and to a high standard. You’re a clear and confident communicator who builds trust with stakeholders and keeps everyone aligned from start to finish.


What you’ll need to succeed 🌟

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Project Management, or a related field

  • 3+ years’ experience managing projects in creative, marketing, or advertising environments.

  • Proven ability to take marketing and creative projects from concept to execution.

  • Solid understanding of marketing, branding, and content development processes.

  • Experience collaborating with internal creative teams and external partners, including agencies.

  • Exceptional organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects at once.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills to engage and align diverse stakeholders.

  • Proficiency with project management tools (e.g., Asana, Trello, Microsoft Project) and familiarity with CRM platforms.

  • Fluency in Norwegian and English. 


What would be nice to have 💡

  • It’s great if you’ve got experience or are familiar with the retail or grocery industry!


What we offer 🚀

  • A chance to make a real impact as a Project Manager in a fast-moving company with a product people love-while shaking up the grocery industry.

  • Teammates who aim high and have each other’s backs. We care about people, and that means supporting each other every step of the way.

  • A flat structure where we team up across disciplines to solve exciting challenges. Big ideas come from everywhere!

  • A transparent way of working. We use Slack to stay in the loop-less email, fewer meetings, more getting things done.

  • A buzzing office at Tøyen, with lunch made by our very own chefs. 🧑‍🍳

  • A collaborative approach-we tackle exciting tech and product challenges together, across different fields.

  • A chance to shape the future of grocery shopping while building a company that’s here to stay.


A few final words

At Oda, you’ll join a passionate, ambitious team working to change the future of grocery shopping. We’re all different—just like you—and we wouldn’t have it any other way. If you need any adjustments or support during the application process, just let us know, and we’ll do our best to help. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and want everyone to have an equal shot at landing the job. 🧡

Come build the future of grocery with us! Want to know more about how we work? Check out these posts on Medium.

We can’t wait to hear from you! 🧡

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Oda is the leading online grocery retailer in Norway, but as a company, we’re first and foremost an ambitious tech and logistics company - not a classic retailer. We’re one of the fastest-growing startups in the Nordics, working with huge, complex challenges to make the lives of our customers simpler and easier. Want to join us? Our goal is to create the world's most efficient retail system. Through smart work, passionate customer focus and our own technology we make a difference in the lives of thousands of customers and change society for the better through a completely re-imagined value chain for grocery shopping. Our customers save more than 60 hours a year, time we believe can be better spent than going to the store. Our effective value chain and logistics save society tonnes of food waste each year and our distribution network replace almost 13,000 individual trips by car to the grocery store each year.

title: Talent Acquisition Manager
description:
At No Isolation, your work has real purpose and impact. You’ll be a key contributor to help us grow with the passionate and talented individuals needed to reduce social isolation and improve lives through technology. This is more than just a job; it’s a chance to make a tangible impact on society by helping us attract and hire the people who will drive our mission forward.


⭐️ What will be your mission?

Our People & Organization Team is growing! We’re expanding our Talent Acquisition team by adding a second Talent Acquisition Manager to help scale our efforts in attracting and hiring top talent. You will play a crucial role in sourcing, attracting, and hiring the best candidates to meet No Isolation’s recruitment needs as we grow in existing and new markets. Working closely with hiring managers, you will ensure they are supported in identifying and selecting the right talent to fuel our expansion.

Additionally, you’ll play a key role in enhancing our employer brand, continuously improve No Isolation’s ability to attract top talent and ensure a positive candidate experience. You will report to the Chief People & Organization Officer.


What you'll be doing...

Collaborating with hiring managers:

  • Partner with hiring managers to understand their recruitment needs and align the hiring process with business needs and goals

  • Provide guidance on interview techniques and candidate selection processes

Sourcing and recruitment:

  • Proactively source candidates across current and emerging markets

  • Produce compelling job postings

  • Streamline and automate recruitment tasks to improve efficiency

Working across markets:

  • Support international recruitment across multiple countries, adapting to local candidate markets, hiring cultures, and role-specific expectations

Candidate screening and assessment:

  • Review resumes and applications

  • Conduct initial interviews to shortlist candidates

  • Manage and interpret Alva Labs assessments to support data-informed hiring decisions

Employer branding:

  • Promote our employer brand across online platforms and social media

  • Maintain and develop our career site to reflect No Isolation’s employee value proposition

Candidate experience:

  • Ensure a positive, transparent experience for all candidates with timely communication and feedback

Building a talent pipeline:

  • Build and nurture a strong talent pipeline for future hiring needs

  • Use the applicant tracking system to manage candidate data

Metrics and continuous improvement:

  • Track recruitment metrics and use data to optimize recruitment strategies

  • Staying up-to-date with the latest trends and developments in recruitment practices and technologies


What else is in it for you?

🌟 Big impact: You’ll play a crucial role in shaping our team, attracting the talent that helps No Isolation grow and succeed

📚 Exceptional growth opportunities: Work on challenging projects that stretch your abilities and drive our growth and build our talent acquisition capabilities

🎯 Autonomy: We trust you to bring your own ideas and experience to life and take ownership of acquiring the best talents

🌍 Flexible location: We are more about the impact of your work than your location. You are welcome to work remotely from any location with a reliable internet connection, provided that we share a time zone CET +/- 2 or you may choose to work from our offices in Oslo, London or Munich

⏰ Flexible hours: We all work from 10am - 3pm CET. You can work the rest of your hours whenever you want

🤝 Great leadership based on trust and accountability

🏖 Generous time off: 27 vacation days (including 2 “PJ days”)

❤️ Mental health support: Free digital mental health services, including therapy sessions

💪 Health and wellness: Take one hour each week for exercise during working hours

🌴 Sabbatical: After 4 years of service, enjoy a fully paid 1-month sabbatical to recharge


Who are you?

We are looking for someone who is exceptionally dedicated to and experienced in talent acquisition. You know how to do it and execute fast. You thrive in fast-paced environments, love building relationships, and are passionate about connecting people with purpose-driven work.

You bring experience from international recruitment and know how to adapt sourcing strategies, communication styles and hiring processes to suit different candidate markets and cultures.


Your skill set includes:

  • You have a solid understanding of recruitment processes and tools

  • Sourcing expertise: You know how to find the right candidates across various channels. Going forward we will mainly be looking to hire commercial roles (sales and customer success)

  • Talent assessment: You’re confident in evaluating candidates using both structured interviews and data-driven tools like psychometric assessments

  • Communication skills: You’re a great communicator, able to build trust and rapport with both candidates and hiring managers

  • Organizational abilities: You’re able to manage multiple vacancies and deadlines simultaneously

  • Resilience: You have a can-do mentality and can perform well under pressure

  • Proactive approach: You’re self-driven and always looking for ways to learn and improve

  • Fluency in English is required, both written and verbal, as you will be working with international teams and candidates


Excited? We are too!

If you’re ready to help us build a team that makes a lasting impact on society, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today by uploading your CV in English! 😊 We will be handling applicants and conducting interviews on a continuous basis.

🎥 Show us what excites you about joining our team! You can upload a short video as part of your application. This is completely optional but gives us a chance to get to know you beyond your CV. Let your personality and passion shine! 


Who are we?

No Isolation was founded in 2015 when we developed AV1, a telepresence robot that helps children and young people stay connected to their education during long-term absences due to illness. Our mission is to help educators bring learning and belonging to every child.

Today, there are 4,000 active AV1 robots used across 19 European countries. Positioned in the EdTech sector, AV1 is a unique solution to the growing issue of persistent absence, supporting both the academic and social needs of students.


Inclusion and Diversity

Not meeting all the requirements? No problem! If you’re passionate about our mission and have the ambition to succeed, we encourage you to apply anyway. We value diversity and inclusion in our workplace and welcome applicants of all backgrounds and experiences. If you require adjustments during the application process, please contact our Talent Acquisition Manager, Julia Riis at riis at noisolation.com

For questions about the role itself, you’re welcome to contact the hiring manager directly, Heidi Nygjelten below email.


We kindly ask external recruitment agencies and consultants to refrain from contacting us regarding this position.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

We help educators bring learning and belonging to every child. School absence is the biggest challenge facing education. Our AV1 robots connect absent students, ensure learning and belonging, and support reintegration back to the classroom. Today, there are over 3,500 active AV1 robots used across 18 European countries. Positioned in the EdTech sector, AV1 is a unique solution to the growing issue of persistent absence, supporting both the academic and social needs of students. No Isolation works across Europe, with 45 employees across Europe and in offices in Oslo, Munich and London. Join us in our growth journey!

title: Validation Engineer
description:
About Nofence

Nofence is a Norwegian scale up who has built the world’s first virtual fencing solution for livestock. As we are revolutionizing livestock management we need more top-notch competence in our Engineering team, and we are now looking for a Validation Engineer.

About the Role

As a Hardware Validation Engineer you will be part of the New Product Development Team (NPD team), who's responsible for developing new hardware from prototype phase to volume manufacturing. Your work environment will be a mix of lab life and farm life. 

Main tasks:

  • User research to understand the various environments in which our products are used.

  • Develop test equipment and validation processes for our lab.

  • Develop and execute field tests.

  • Document test procedures and results.

  • Contribute on hardware development.

You will be part of a core team of quality engineers who together cover validation in the field and lab. In projects you will cooperate with the rest of the engineering team, and you will report to the Engineering Manager for the NPD team. Your work life will be spent 50% in the lab close to Oslo, 25% in office (including a bit of travel to see your colleagues in Trondheim, Molde and beyond) and 25% on travel to do field and animal research.

Animal and environmental research

Understanding our current and new markets is crucial for developing state of the art validation procedures. This means that you will need to be actively involved in doing user and environmental studies so that you can best replicate field use of our product in order to simulate in the lab. This means a varied work schedule where you need to be able to travel when needed to our key markets in Europe and the US.

In the lab

Back in the lab you will replicate the conditions from the field by running and developing our test equipment and procedures. You shall be able to document data in a structured way and communicate findings to our stakeholders.

Working with the animals

Not everything in the field can be replicated in the lab. Especially when you design for animals. You will also plan, conduct and document user and animal tests in the field. This means that you shall be comfortable working in farm environments with animals and our heroes: the farmers.


Experience and qualifications

  • Bachelor or Master degree in electrical, mechanical, automation engineering or a similar discipline.

  • Experience with lab validation of hardware.

  • Enjoy working in an autonomous cross-functional team.

  • Structured with the ability to document and communicate your work.

  • Excellent analytical and problem solving skills.

  • Comfortable working hands on in farm environments around the world.


What can we offer?

Your work will directly shape products used by farmers worldwide, influencing animal welfare and sustainable farming.

You’ll work hands-on with state-of-the-art AgTech hardware, both in the field and in our lab, combining innovation with real-world impact. This is a role full of variety, flexibility, and purpose. Frequent travel to farms and test sites will take you beyond the office, turning your workdays into a mix of exploration, collaboration, and practical problem-solving.  We offer a competitive salary and the opportunity to be part of a fun, supportive and collaborative team.

Still curious? Visit our website. We will evaluate candidates continuously. If you have any questions about Nofence or regarding the application, please reach out to our Engineering Manager NPD, Kjetil Grimsæth at below email.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Vår beiteteknologi skal bidra til at mer av verdens arealressurser kan utnyttes til bærekraftig matproduksjon.En stor andel beitedyr lever mesteparten av livet innendørs og spiser mye kraftfor. Målsettingen til Nofence er å få beitedyra ut på beite, på en trygg og god måte, slik at de kan ha det godt og selv finne den maten de er skapt for å spise.Vi vil at beitedyr skal få muligheten til å ta i bruk sitt naturlige miljø. Det er god dyrevelferd og det vil frigjøre store arealer som kan brukes til å dyrke menneskemat i stedet for soya i kraftforproduksjon.Vår teknologi gir dyra denne muligheten.

title: Salesforce Marketing Cloud Specialist
description:
Are you passionate about optimizing marketing workflows and creating impactful customer experiences through technology?

reMarkable is looking for a Marketing Cloud Specialist to join our dynamic team and drive the future of our Marketing Cloud ecosystem!

In this role, you’ll play a key part in shaping and executing world-class marketing automation processes that are at the core of our customer engagement strategy. Working with cross-functional teams, you’ll bring your expertise in Salesforce Marketing Cloud to help us create seamless, personalized journeys that engage our customers and make a real difference.


About reMarkable

reMarkable creates hardware and software products that help people all over the world find focus. We want to combine the best of both worlds: the digital and the analogue, and to create tools that enhance learning, focus and presence for knowledge workers. Our tablet isn’t just another screen - it’s an experience. We add the warmth of paper to digital solutions, creating something brand new. We are enabling better thinking through technology.

Join us in preserving human creativity amidst a sea of technological time thieves!


About the role:

As a Marketing Cloud Specialist at reMarkable, you'll be instrumental in shaping our customer communication strategy. You'll optimize event-based and transactional workflows, ensuring timely and personalized messaging, while also strategically partnering with business teams to translate their goals into scalable technical solutions aligned with our broader Marketing, Sales, and Software objectives.

You'll lead the technical execution within Marketing Cloud, managing data extensions, AMPscript, and dynamic content, always ensuring compliance with global privacy regulations (CAN-SPAM, GDPR, CCPA). Collaborating with developers, you'll configure API calls, data syncs, and real-time message triggers. As a technical leader, you'll guide design, testing, QA, and deployment, troubleshooting issues and documenting technical specifications. Your proactive approach will include championing new feature developments in Marketing Cloud that drive significant benefits across reMarkable.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Proactively identify new feature developments within Marketing Cloud, advocating for those that align with and deliver benefits to wider reMarkable business goals.

  • Champion platform adoption and knowledge sharing by supporting super user and stakeholder training sessions and developing comprehensive enablement documentation.

  • Drive strategic business enablement by working with cross-functional teams to translate complex business requirements into robust, scalable technical solutions within Marketing Cloud, aligning with Marketing, Sales, and Software objectives.

  • Lead prioritization meetings and manage sprints for the Marketing stream, ensuring efficient project delivery.

  • Act as the primary point of contact for key partnerships such as Signature Success MCE and DeSelect, fostering strong relationships and maximising platform value.

  • Build and optimise event-based triggered customer journeys (e.g., payment confirmations, shipping updates), including data extensions, AMPscript, and templates.


We are looking for someone with:

  • Minimum 3+ years of experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud and related technologies.

  • Strong expertise in designing and optimizing marketing automation workflows.

  • Experience with AMPscript, dynamic content, and transactional templates.

  • Knowledge of API integrations and data synchronization processes.

  • Familiarity with compliance standards (CAN-SPAM, GDPR, CCPA).

  • Proven experience leading cross-functional teams and workshops.

  • Experience in troubleshooting technical issues related to email systems and integrations.


As a person you have collaborative mindset who is passionate about continuous improvement and actively seeks opportunities to drive technical solutions. You have strong communication skills and the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, accessible language for non-technical stakeholders.


Practical Information:

  • We will consider applications on a rolling basis.

  • Language requirements: Our company language is English.

  • Location: Oslo, Norway.

  • Visa requirements: Citizenship/valid work permit from the EU/EEA (Relocation assistance can be provided).


Why reMarkable?

  • A modern campus located central in Oslo, specially designed to reflect reMarkable as a company.

  • Access to a free employee gym with top equipment.

  • A flexible hybrid work model

  • 5 extra “reMarkable days” you can make use of in addition to regular vacation.

  • Wednesday is Zen-day with no internal meetings to create space for you to focus, deepdive and be creative.

  • Premium health insurance, travel insurance, and home broadband coverage.

  • Access to our employee share incentive scheme.

  • Most importantly: We have fun! We have regular events and social gatherings.


At reMarkable, we are constantly evolving, and we need exceptional talent like you to help us shape the future. If you’re ready to make an impact with your technical expertise in Marketing Cloud, we’d love to hear from you!

Apply now and become part of the reMarkable team, where your work will inspire better thinking through technology!

As part of our hiring process, we assess candidates' affiliation with high-risk countries, defined by PST (Norwegian Police Security Service), for security purposes. We also conduct background checks for candidates in the final stages. Data is handled in full compliance with privacy regulations. Should you reach the final stages of the recruitment process, you will be informed. Background checks will not be performed without your knowledge.

title: Chief Product Officer (CPO)
description:

title: Chief Technology Officer (CTO)
description:
We're thrilled that you're considering a career at Kindly! Here's everything you need to know about this job. 🥳

Do you want to lead the next wave of AI-driven customer experiences in Europe? Are you passionate about scaling SaaS platforms and building world-class engineering teams? We’re looking for a Chief Technology Officer (CTO) to join Kindly at a pivotal moment in our growth.

As we scale, we need a CTO who can own our long-term technical strategy, elevate our AI and automation capabilities, and lead our outstanding engineering organization. This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of conversational AI across Europe.


About Kindly 🟢

Kindly is a tech scale-up company of 70+ employees, working out of Oslo, Stockholm, Copenhagen, and Amsterdam! We create AI-agents for businesses, particularly in the B2C sector. We have over 150 incredible clients that include Booking.com, Voi, Tele 2, Boozt Fashion, Kahoot!, TV4, and Norwegian Airlines – just to name a few. Our tech reaches over one million users every month, and we handle thousands of messages every hour.

We believe that one of the key factors for success in a job is enjoying your workplace. At Kindly, we all work towards common goals, and everyone wants the best for each other. We want you to have fun at work! That's why it's important for us that when we hire new people, they share this philosophy.  


About the role👋 

As the CTO at Kindly, you will be part of the Management Team and responsible for all aspects of Kindly’s technology and product architecture. You’ll lead our engineering, DevOps, and AI/ML teams consisting of 20+ people in Oslo, while working closely with Product, Sales, and Customer Success to ensure we deliver robust, scalable, and innovative solutions.

This is both a strategic and operational role. You'll drive the technical vision but also explore architecture decisions, security, platform scalability, and team structure.


What you’ll be doing 📋

As a CTO, your job will be to:

  • Define and execute the long-term technology roadmap aligned with business goals

  • Lead and scale a distributed team of software engineers, AI specialists, and technical leaders

  • Ensure our platform is scalable, secure, and reliable for enterprise customers across Europe while laying the foundation for global growth

  • Drive our AI strategy, integrating LLMs and automation into customer-facing use cases

  • Collaborate with Product to accelerate feature delivery and innovation

  • Own the technical hiring strategy, processes, and team culture

  • Represent Kindly’s tech strategy to key customers, partners, investors, and the board

  • Stay close to architecture and implementation to ensure technical excellence

  • Champion agile practices, continuous delivery, and a strong DevOps mindset

  • Evolve Kindly into a fully agentic platform, using technologies like MCP, ML, and LLMs


Who you are 🏌️

  • You have led engineering or product teams in a scaling B2B SaaS company

  • Strong technical background—ideally hands-on at some point—with experience in building cloud-native, API-first platforms

  • Experience working with AI/ML or LLM-driven products is a big plus

  • You’ve scaled systems, teams, and infrastructure to meet enterprise-grade reliability and security

  • Collaborative and pragmatic—you balance product velocity with long-term architecture

  • You lead with empathy and clarity, and are comfortable coaching teams through growth and change

  • You’re comfortable in an international environment and fluent in English

  • Bonus: You have experience with and enjoy public speaking


The Kindly perks 🛍️

  • Kindly offer a pleasant, inclusive, and creative workplace. We give our team both responsibility and trust, along with the opportunity to shape their own working day

  • Large degree of professional freedom

  • Recognition of hard work and direct influence on our products

  • Modern office, situated near Oslo Central Station

  • Option to buy stocks at a discount

  • Modern gym with everything you need to get a sweat in

  • Subsidized employee restaurant with delicious food

  • Competitive salary and conditions

  • All the necessary hardware to thrive in the role

  • 2-day bi-monthly Hackathon during work hours

  • Personal development hours during work hours (10 hours /month)


That's it for now. There is more to tell, but let's do that if you find this interesting 🤞


Om arbeidsgiveren:

Kindly is one of Europe’s leading chatbot providers specializing in the development of artificial intelligence and automation solutions for customer service and communication. The company offers a platform that combines advanced machine learning techniques and natural language processing (NLP) to enhance the customer experience and improve the efficiency of customer service processes.

title: Head of Business Technology
description:
Location: Oslo, Norway or Stockholm, Sweden

Reports to: COO


About Nofence

Nofence is a Norwegian scale-up who has built the world’s first virtual fencing solution for livestock. As we aim to revolutionize livestock management, we will need top-notch competence within Business Technology / IT, and we are now looking for a Head of Business Technology. This position can be performed from our Stockholm or Oslo office. Occasional travel will be required. Elevate your career with us and be at the forefront of innovation in agricultural technology!


The Role

As Head of Business Technology at Nofence, you will define, build, and lead our business technology function shaping the systems, data, and infrastructure that enable scalable growth and operational excellence.

Reporting to the COO, you’ll combine strategic leadership with hands-on execution. You’ll balance transformation with reliable, secure, and scalable operations that keep our business running smoothly every day.

This role carries ownership for the business technology roadmap, budget, and delivery. You’ll ensure investments are cost-effective, compliant, and aligned with business objectives, while driving the adoption of tools, data, and platforms that empower every team at Nofence.


Key Responsibilities

Tech Strategy & Governance

  • Define and execute Nofence’s business technology strategy and enterprise architecture

  • Manage the business technology budget, optimizing cost efficiency and value realization

  • Define technology standards, interoperability principles, and governance frameworks

  • Manage run/change portfolios, allocate capacity, and track technical debt and dependencies

  • Serve as product owner for enterprise platforms by managing roadmaps, partners, and delivery

Data & Business Intelligence

  • Establish data governance, MDM, and quality SLAs with clear domain ownership

  • Define and implement the BI strategy to deliver a trusted single source of truth and enable self-service analytics

Security, Risk & Compliance

  • Own information security, privacy, and compliance frameworks

  • Oversee risk management, vendor assessments, and audit readiness

  • Define business continuity and disaster recovery plans with clear response governance

Operations & Reliability

  • Design and maintain scalable, secure, and resilient IT infrastructure

  • Oversee end-user IT services, including device lifecycle, software provisioning, and service desk operations

  • Lead the evaluation and rollout of platforms such as ERP, CRM, e-commerce, and low/no-code tools, always balancing governance, security, and ROI

  • Implement QA and release governance for enterprise platforms and integrations

Ecosystem & Vendor Management

  • Own the partner and vendor landscape across enterprise platforms and services

  • Negotiate contracts, manage SLAs/OLAs, and ensure transparent SaaS/cloud spend through FinOps practices

Stakeholder & Change Management

  • Collaborate with Product & Engineering, Finance, Commercial, and Operations to deliver secure, scalable solutions that enable business performance

  • Serve as the executive point of contact for IT, ensuring transparent communication, alignment, and proactive risk management

  • Drive user adoption and readiness for new systems and processes through structured change management

Talent & Organization

  • Design the future IT organization, hire and develop key roles

  • Build team capabilities and foster effective collaboration across technical and business teams


Collaboration with Product & Engineering

This role focuses on business technology: the systems, data, and infrastructure that enable scalable internal operations.

Our Product & Engineering teams retain full ownership of customer-facing technology, development frameworks, and cloud architecture decisions. The Head of Business Technology will collaborate closely as a consultative partner to ensure coherence, data flow, and security across the enterprise landscape.


What We’re Looking For

  • 7+ years of IT leadership experience, ideally in a fast-growing international environment

  • Proven track record in IT strategy, systems/enterprise architecture, and infrastructure management

  • Deep understanding of IT security, privacy, compliance, and risk management frameworks

  • Experience managing run/change portfolios, platform roadmaps, and technical debt

  • Strong knowledge of data governance, MDM, and modern BI tooling

  • Experience managing IT budgets, P&L accountability, SaaS/cloud FinOps, and vendor relationships

  • Background with ERP, CRM, process automation, and integrations

  • Skilled in defining and enforcing QA/release governance and service SLAs

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder alignment skills across all levels

  • Hands-on leader with experience hiring and developing high-performing IT teams

  • Fluent in English (Norwegian or Swedish is a plus)


Why Join Nofence

Join a passionate, mission-driven team redefining agriculture through innovation. You’ll have end-to-end ownership of the business technology function, shaping how systems and data drive growth, efficiency, and security across the company.

If you’re ready to combine strategic influence with hands-on execution and make a real-world impact, we’d love to hear from you.


Apply Now

Apply through Teamtailor and tell us how your experience can help Nofence scale with secure, reliable, and impactful business technology.

description:

Following our acquisition by eBay, we’re entering an exciting new chapter, and we’re now looking for a Data Integration & Analytics Manager to help us shape the future of Tise as we integrate into the broader eBay ecosystem 🚀

In this role, you’ll own the data integration between Tise and eBay, and operate as the analytics function. You’ll standardize definitions and reporting across teams and serve as the single source of truth for integration metrics, alignment tracking, and executive-ready content.

This is a unique opportunity for someone who loves turning complexity into clarity — building the foundation for data-driven integration across two dynamic organizations.


What you will accomplish:

  • Own data integration and definitions alignment across Tise and eBay to establish consistent metrics taxonomies and reporting standards; stand up alignments and business reporting capabilities for launch and post-close execution.

  • Build and maintain scorecard, ensuring quarterly updates post-close and alignment to the integration operating model; provide content for weekly integration forums and bi-monthly Steering Committee (SteerCo) as required.

  • Partner with multiple teams to produce executive-ready deliverables (scorecards, SteerCo packs, metrics dashboards) covering standalone and alignment performance.

  • Contribute to central integration governance by preparing materials, minutes, templates, and action tracking across weekly cross-functional meetings, SteerCo, and quarterly MAC forums; keep trackers audit-ready per eMIT standards.

  • Track and report integration metrics and achievements, alignment targets, risks/heatmap highlights, and progress status for leadership forums.

  • Develop dashboards and reports by market to support additional launches, including active buyers/sellers, online GMV/listings, acquisition/retention, and marketing allocation impact, ensuring provable linkage to the deal model and quarterly scorecards.

  • Ensure controls and compliance in reporting, maintaining documentation, RASCI, and audit-ready outputs (finance, legal/privacy, risk/compliance), aligned with public company standards and integration playbooks.

  • Support product/tech integration analytics for foundational tech/security workstreams (e.g., sign-in with eBay, customer data platform alignment), providing measurement frameworks for readiness and performance where applicable.

title: Platform Engineer
employer: ODA NORWAY AS AVD OSLO SALG
description:
At Oda, we develop affordable grocery services to make the logistics of living surprisingly easy. First we built Norway’s leading online grocery store and now, partnered with Mathem in Sweden, we’re on our way to becoming the world’s most effective retail system, delivering to thousands of Scandinavian doorsteps every week.

As part of our team, you’ll work with smart, passionate colleagues who bring their whole selves to work every day. It’s a fast-moving, collaborative environment where everyone is welcome and everyone’s opinion matters. Whether you're shaping the future of online retail, tackling complex logistical problems, or making everyday life better for our customers, your work will have a real impact. Read on to find out what part you could play in our story.

Our world-class logistics and tech solutions allow us to reduce food waste, save time and money, and ease the mental and physical load for people who want more space for life.


We’re looking for a Platform Engineer to join Oda!

We’re looking for an experienced Platform Engineer to join our Infrastructure & Organizational Engineering team in Oda! You’ll work on the fundamental platform that keeps our systems running, while helping our product and platform teams move faster and more reliably. This is a senior role in a small, highly competent team where you’ll have real influence over how things are built and operated.

You’ll develop and operate scalable cloud-based systems, shaping the platform that enables teams across Oda to own their services from code to production. Expect autonomy, ownership, complex problems, and the chance to make existing systems even better. We value people who take initiative, enjoy solving tough challenges, and thrive in an environment where you can move fast and have a tangible impact.

Our platform is built on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and Kubernetes/GKE, powered by a custom deployment system. For observability, we use the Grafana stack, and for Infrastructure as Code, it’s Terraform all the way. On the coding side, you’ll work with Python, and with a bit of Go and Rust sprinkled in for glue. Oh, and yes — YAML might occasionally make an appearance in your workflow.


What you’ll be doing as a Platform Engineer

  • Develop and operate scalable cloud infrastructure.

  • Build and maintain our development platform.

  • Support and accelerate developers by providing tools and best practices for deployment, reliability, security, and observability.


What you’ll need to succeed 🌟

  • Have experience with cloud infrastructure, infrastructure as code (IaC), container orchestration, observability, monitoring, and alerting systems.

  • Are proficient in one or more programming/scripting languages, along with knowledge of DevOps tools, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices, cloud security, and network design, particularly in cloud networking.

  • Have great communication skills and know how to work well with both technical and non-technical people.

  • Have fluency in English, both written and spoken; Norwegian is a plus.

  • Are self-motivated and take responsibility for tasks from start to finish.

  • Are eager to learn new things and share knowledge with others.

  • Are committed to writing clean, scalable, and maintainable code.


What we offer 🚀

  • A close-knit Infrastructure & Organizational Engineering team that supports and enables our organization. Curious about how the team works? You can read more about it here!

  • A chance to make a real impact as a Platform Engineer in a fast-moving company with a product people love—while shaking up the grocery industry.

  • Teammates who aim high and have each other’s backs. We care about people, and that means supporting each other every step of the way.

  • A flat structure where we team up across disciplines to solve exciting challenges. Big ideas come from everywhere!

  • A transparent way of working. We use Slack to stay in the loop-less email, fewer meetings, more getting things done.

  • A buzzing office at Tøyen, with lunch made by our very own chefs. 🧑‍🍳

  • A collaborative approach-we tackle exciting tech and product challenges together, across different fields.

  • A chance to shape the future of grocery shopping while building a company that’s here to stay.


A few final words

At Oda, you’ll join a passionate, ambitious team working to change the future of grocery shopping. We’re all different—just like you—and we wouldn’t have it any other way. If you need any adjustments or support during the application process, just let us know, and we’ll do our best to help. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and want everyone to have an equal shot at landing the job. 🧡

Come build the future of grocery with us! Want to know more about how we work? Check out these posts on Medium.

Application deadline: 21/10/2025

We can’t wait to hear from you! 🧡

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Oda is the leading online grocery retailer in Norway, but as a company, we’re first and foremost an ambitious tech and logistics company - not a classic retailer. We’re one of the fastest-growing startups in the Nordics, working with huge, complex challenges to make the lives of our customers simpler and easier. Want to join us? Our goal is to create the world's most efficient retail system. Through smart work, passionate customer focus and our own technology we make a difference in the lives of thousands of customers and change society for the better through a completely re-imagined value chain for grocery shopping. Our customers save more than 60 hours a year, time we believe can be better spent than going to the store. Our effective value chain and logistics save society tonnes of food waste each year and our distribution network replace almost 13,000 individual trips by car to the grocery store each year.

title: Integration Lead
description:
Integration Lead

At Tise, we’re on a mission to create the world’s best second-hand marketplace — where sustainability meets style and where buying pre-loved feels even better than buying new. Following our acquisition by eBay, we’re entering an exciting new chapter, and we’re now looking for an Integration Lead to help us shape the future of Tise as we integrate into the broader eBay ecosystem🚀

In this role, you’ll act as the central program manager and point of contact for all back-office functional integration activities — connecting the dots between Tise, eBay’s integration teams, and key functional leads across the business. You’ll make sure we stay aligned, coordinated, and ready to deliver on our ambitious goals while preserving the unique Tise culture that makes us who we are.

This is a unique opportunity to join a mission-driven, fast-paced environment where technology, sustainability, and global scale meet. If you thrive on structure, people, and progress — this role is for you.


What you’ll accomplish:

  • Lead Integration Coordination: Act as the primary liaison with eBay’s Business Unit Integration Lead and integration teams. Attend central integration meetings, provide status updates, and ensure requirements from leadership are surfaced and documented.

  • Drive Execution: Schedule, coordinate, and ensure timely execution of all back-office integration deliverables — raising issues, managing dependencies, and maintaining clear communication with partners.

  • Problem-Solve Across Functions: Identify, raise, and help resolve risks, blockers, and resource constraints in collaboration with eMIT and functional teams, ensuring alignment with the overall integration strategy.

What you’ll bring:

  • You’re an excellent project manager with a natural ability to create structure in fast-paced, evolving contexts.

title: Chief Marketing Officer (CMO)
description:
At Tise, we’re on a mission to create the world’s best second-hand marketplace — where sustainability, culture, and commerce come together in a way that feels modern, meaningful, and fun. We are entering a decisive stage in our growth, and we’re now strengthening our leadership team with a Chief Marketing Officer (CMO) to elevate our brand, sharpen our presence, and deepen our impact across the markets we operate in🚀

As CMO, you will be responsible for leading the Marketing department, which currently consists of around 20 Tisees based in Norway, Denmark, and Finland. You will also lead and empower our Country Managers, who drive strategy and commercial performance locally. You will also directly lead the Brand and Performance Marketing teams, ensuring that positioning, storytelling, and growth efforts are aligned and pulling in the same direction.

This is a role for someone who can connect market reality with strategic clarity — and turn both brand equity and marketing craft into real business outcomes.


What you will accomplish:

  • Lead and develop the Country Managers, setting ambition, clarity, and executional pace in each market, while helping them tailor strategy to the local needs.

  • Oversee & lead Brand and Performance Marketing as two strategic teams, ensuring they work in sync with local needs and commercial goals.

  • Build a cohesive cross-market marketing model that turns local insights into learning, direction, and repeatable playbooks.

  • Strengthen how Tise shows up culturally — distinctive, relevant, and true to our values.

  • Grow and coach senior marketing leaders, raising the level of ownership, creativity, and execution.


What you will bring:

  • Proven success leading marketing in a consumer brand, platform, or marketplace across multiple markets.

  • The ability to combine brand instinct with commercial sharpness, and make decisions rooted in both data and intuition.

  • Experience running teams where creativity and performance work hand-in-hand, not in silos.

  • A leadership style based on empowerment, empathy, trust, clarity, and accountability.

  • Strong communication skills and fluency in English.


Why Tise?

  • A mission with real relevance — cultural, environmental, and community-driven.

  • A marketing organisation with strong foundations and the mandate to scale its impact.

  • A leadership role at a pivotal moment in the company’s development.

  • Competitive compensation including equity.

  • A vibrant, values-driven culture at our Oslo HQ.


If you want to build a brand people don’t just use — but believe in — this is the role.

title: Salesforce B2B Commerce Architect
description:
We are looking for a Salesforce Architect to take ownership of the technical direction for reMarkable’s new B2B eCommerce platform. This is a rare opportunity to join early, define the architecture, and make a lasting impact on how we scale enterprise sales globally. You’ll work with modern tools, minimal legacy systems, and a Platform-First strategy, building solutions that have never been done before at reMarkable.

About the Team

You’ll be part of a newly established B2B eCommerce team, working closely with colleagues in design, product, sales, and architecture. Together, we develop scalable, efficient, and future-ready solutions that drive reMarkable’s enterprise business forward. This role offers a unique opportunity to shape both our ways of working and the solutions we build, helping us create industry-leading experiences for enterprise customers.


Your responsibilities may include:

  • Own the development and technical architecture of our new Salesforce B2B Commerce platform, ensuring scalability and best practices across the ecosystem.

  • Lead the development, design and integration of B2B solutions with Salesforce and other internal/external systems.

  • Collaborate closely with stakeholders to translate business requirements into robust technical designs and functionalities.

  • Oversee system performance, testing, and release management, ensuring a stable and healthy enterprise buying experience.

  • Shape how

  • B2B eCommerce function operates, helping to establish team practices, technical standards, and future roadmap decisions.


We are looking for the following experience:

  • Proven experience with Salesforce B2B Commerce Cloud (hands-on development and architecture).

  • Strong technical background in Apex/Java and Lightning Web Components (LWC).

  • Experience designing and managing Salesforce integrations with other systems.

  • Solid understanding of Salesforce best practices, system architecture, and data governance.

  • Ability to align technical design with business strategy and enterprise-level requirements.


Technologies and tools you’ll work with:

  • Salesforce B2B Commerce Cloud

  • Apex, Java, LWC

  • Salesforce CRM & Platform Architecture

  • Data and Integration tools (API, REST, etc.)


Practical information:

  • We will consider applications on a rolling basis.

  • Language requirements: Our company language is English.

  • Location: Oslo, Norway.

  • Visa requirements: Citizenship/valid work permit from the EU/EEA. (Relocation assistance can be provided)


Why we enjoy working here:

  • A modern campus located central in Oslo, specially designed to reflect reMarkable as a company.

  • Access to a free employee gym with top equipment.

  • A flexible hybrid work model

  • 5 extra “reMarkable days” you can make use of in addition to regular vacation.

  • Wednesday is Zen-day with no internal meetings to create space for you to focus, deepdive and be creative.

  • Premium health insurance, travel insurance, and home broadband coverage.

  • Access to our employee share incentive scheme.

  • Most importantly: We have fun! We have regular events and social gatherings.


About reMarkable

reMarkable creates hardware and software products that help people all over the world find focus. We want to combine the best of both worlds: the digital and the analogue, and to create tools that enhance learning, focus and presence for knowledge workers. Our tablet isn’t just another screen - it’s an experience. We add the warmth of paper to digital solutions, creating something brand new. We are enabling better thinking through technology.

Join us in preserving human creativity amidst a sea of technological time thieves!


As part of our hiring process, we assess candidates' affiliation with high-risk countries, defined by PST (Norwegian Police Security Service), for security purposes. We also conduct background checks for candidates in the final stages. Data is handled in full compliance with privacy regulations. Should you reach the final stages of the recruitment process, you will be informed. Background checks will not be performed without your knowledge.
