title: Talent Acquisition & People Operations Manager
description:
People & Organization | Oslo, London, Munich or remote within Europe

No Isolation is an award-winning EdTech scale-up on a global mission to help educators bring learning and belonging to every child. As we continue to scale, hiring the right people and running structured, reliable People processes are business-critical.

We are now looking for a Talent Acquisition & People Operations Manager to strengthen both. The scope of the role is split between proactive Talent Acquisition and operational People responsibilities and may flex based on business priorities.

This is a high-impact execution role. You will actively drive sourcing for demanding and hard-to-fill roles while ensuring structured, compliant and efficient People Operations that support performance, scalability and our ability to deliver on our mission.

The role supports recruitment and People Operations across our European entities and EoR employees. You will report to the Chief People & Organizational Officer. 


The impact you’ll have

You will:

  • Proactively identify, approach and engage strong candidates for priority and hard-to-fill roles

  • Build and nurture high-quality talent pipelines

  • Ensure structured, efficient and professional recruitment processes

  • Maintain reliable and compliant People Operations across the employee lifecycle

  • Contribute to structured workforce insights and continuous process improvement


You will continuously improve our sourcing and People workflows by leveraging AI and modern HR tech to automate the repetitive stuff, freeing you up to focus on engaging with high-calibre candidates, and employee engagement.

This role sits at the intersection of growth and operational discipline. Your work will directly influence hiring quality, execution capacity and long-term scalability. 


What you’ll work on

Talent Acquisition

You will play an active role in strengthening our sourcing capability and pipeline quality to attract and engage high-caliber talent. 

You will conduct structured talent mapping and market research, identify and engage passive candidates through proactive outreach, and build strong pipelines for demanding roles. You will contribute to screening and candidate assessment when relevant, ensure disciplined use of our ATS and workflows, and continuously improve sourcing tools and efficiency.

We are particularly interested in candidates who truly enjoy outbound sourcing and are motivated by finding and engaging high-quality talent in competitive markets. You take pride in raising the bar on talent quality.

People Operations

You will play a key role in ensuring structured, reliable and compliant People Operations across the organization. This includes maintaining accurate employment documentation, supporting employee relations matters and ensuring our HR systems and processes function effectively in daily operations.

You will coordinate key employee lifecycle processes, from onboarding to role changes, parental leave and offboarding, ensuring a consistent and positive experience at every stage.

You will provide operational HR support across the organization and contribute to continuous improvement of our People processes.

In addition, you will help maintain visibility into workforce data and engagement through pulse surveys, People KPIs and structured reporting, contributing to a strong company culture aligned with our Guiding Principles.


We believe you bring...

  • Experience: 3–5 years in Talent Acquisition and/or People Operations, ideally within a fast-growing international scale-up

  • Sourcing DNA: A proven track record of finding and engaging high-caliber talent for demanding or hard-to-fill roles. You genuinely enjoy the "hunt."

  • Operational grip: A solid understanding of the employee lifecycle, from structured onboarding to compliant offboarding, including exposure to labor law (preferred) and employee relations

  • Tech-forward mindset: You are naturally curious and tech-savvy. You proactively use AI and automation to "automate the boring stuff," improve efficiency, and work smarter and faster

  • Business Acumen: The ability to prioritize your workload based on business impact

  • Growth mindset: You actively seek feedback, take initiative to improve your skills, and see challenges as opportunities to learn and raise the bar.


As a person, you are structured, resilient, and self-driven. You thrive in environments where disciplined execution is the key to performance, and you are comfortable navigating the healthy "chaos" of a scaling company.


What we offer 

  • Real impact on a mission that matters. Your work directly strengthens our ability to scale and deliver on our mission of bringing learning and belonging to every child. You will play a key role in building strong teams and ensuring structured, efficient People Operations in a growing international scale-up

  • Learning & development in a growing scale-up. Growth creates constant new challenges and opportunities. You will continuously develop your capabilities across international People Operations, demanding sourcing, and process improvement

  • High-performance, high-support. You’ll join 60+ driven and highly-skilled colleagues from 20 nationalities in a "high-challenge, high-support" environment. We set the bar high and celebrate wins, but we also prioritize a fun, collaborative atmosphere where people genuinely enjoy working together

  • Trust-based leadership. We start from a place of trust. You’ll have ownership and accountability of your responsibilities and the space to drive your work, with the support and mentorship needed to grow


How to apply

Please click APPLY NOW, upload your CV (English) and answer the screening questions. 

🎥 Want to stand out? You’re welcome to upload a short (optional) video introducing yourself and what motivates you to join No Isolation.

We are excited to hear from you!


About No Isolation

No Isolation is an award-winning scale-up in EdTech on a global mission to help educators bring learning and belonging to every child. With offices in Oslo, London, and Munich, and employees spread across Europe, we provide the technology and solutions required to tackle the societal challenge of school absence, empowering institutions to uphold academic continuity and inclusion for every student.

Our flagship solution, the AV1 robot, is deployed across 19 countries with 5,000+ units, supporting schools to sustain attendance, belonging, and continuity of learning for children who cannot be physically present. Consistently described as life-changing, it bridges the gap between the student and their peers, restoring both educational continuity and the essential sense of social belonging.

🎥 Watch how AV1 transforms inclusion in education here: vimeo.com/1098745115 🌍 Explore our mission and impact stories at noisolation.com

Om arbeidsgiveren:

We help educators bring learning and belonging to every child. School absence is the biggest challenge facing education. Our AV1 robots connect absent students, ensure learning and belonging, and support reintegration back to the classroom. Today, there are over 3,500 active AV1 robots used across 18 European countries. No Isolation works across Europe, with 45 employees across Europe and in offices in Oslo, Munich and London. Join us in our growth journey!

employer: VOI TECHNOLOGY NORWAY AS AVD TRONDHEIM

title: Firmware / Embedded Software Engineer
description:
Heimdall Power is a growing Norwegian tech company established in 2016. With closer to 70 employees across Norway, Europe and the US we produce a Neuron, our sensor sollution often reffered to as "magic ball", that exceptionally combines hardware, firmware and software into one product. The purpose of the Neuron is to bring greater awareness and intelligence to power grids — making them safer, smarter, and more responsive. Our solution strengthen the grid, the people who operate it, and everyone who depends on it. We are a proud contributor to the world's green energy transition. Our unique offering combines software and sensors to increase capacity in existing power grids by up to 30%. This technology enables integration of more renewable energy and electrification of consumption.  By making better use of what we already have, we reduce carbon footprints while also creating value for society, industry, and our shareholders. 

We have global ambitions and are already present in 15 European countries, as well as the US. 


What are we looking for?

We are now looking for a new firmware / Embedded Software Engineer. You will be part of a great team of 10 colleagues, working with both hardware and firmware. You will also be working closely with the rest of the teams in the company.


What will you be working with? 

Your main tasks will be within:

  • Development of firmware for sensor and communication products 

  • Implementation of low-level drivers all the way up to high-level application code 

  • Participation in architectural discussions, design and code reviews 

  • Close collaboration with hardware and test engineers 

  • Debugging and troubleshooting embedded systems on real hardware 

  • Supporting verification, testing, and production ramp-up 

  • Taking ownership of features and contributing to product success 

  • Participate in firmware release processes, monitor and roll-out new firmware to field devices 


Who are you?

You have 0–3 years of relevant work experience, and a BS/MS in Embedded Systems, Electronics, Computer Engineering, or similar. You value readability, clean code, good architecture and think that code is meant to be read by humans and happen to compile for machines. You also think unit tests are equally as important as code. Last but not least, you want to contribute to a great working environment enjoy working collaboratively in cross-disciplinary teams. 

Not a requirement, but it would be extra beneficial if you have experience working close to hardware (MCUs, peripherals, sensors), are familiar with RTOS (preferably Zephyr) and embedded system constraints and have basic experience with Python.


What do we offer? 

We offer competitive salary with great pension and insurance benefits. We have a positive, flexible, and trust-based work environment, with flexible working condition. We are a team of highly competent and friendly colleagues, with lots of social events, such as game nights, chess, running clubs etc. Our office is centrally located in Oslo, close to public transportation of all kind.  

Does this sound interesting? If so, we want to hear from you! We are interviewing candidates on a continuous basis. We therefore encourage interested applicants to submit their application as early as possible.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

In Norse mythology, Heimdall is the all-seeing, all-knowing watchman who guards Asgard, the home of the gods. He possesses extraordinary abilities to see for hundreds of miles, hear the faintest of sounds, and stands vigilant at the Bifrost, the rainbow bridge connecting Asgard to the world of mortals, ready to sound the Gjallarhorn at the first sign of danger. Much like the mythical guardian, Heimdall Power ensures the safety and efficiency of power grids. Founded in Norway in 2016, we provide accurate, cost-effective monitoring of both grid capacity and health. We achieve this through advanced grid-enhancing technologies, combining world-leading sensors (Neurons) and software (Heimdall’s Brain) to optimize the performance and reliability of energy networks. Our unique autonomous drone installation system facilitates safe, quick, and scalable deployment worldwide. With our help, grid operators can unlock up to 40% more capacity in their high-voltage power grids while simultaneously improving operational safety. Our technology equips you to meet the increasing demand for electricity while reducing the need for expensive infrastructure upgrades.

title: Key Partner Specialist
employer: TOO GOOD TO GO NORGE AS
description:
Porteføljeoptimalisering | Kommersiell vekst | Datadrevet rådgivning


Om rollen

Som Partner Growth Specialist (SMB) får du kommersielt ansvar for en utvalgt portefølje av våre viktigste individuelle partnere (Tier 1 & 2). Dette er ikke en klassisk kundeservice-rolle – du jobber tett med butikk- og restauranteiere for å skape målbar vekst, redusere matsvinn og optimalisere både pris og volum.

Porteføljen din er sentral for Too Good To Go sitt samfunnsoppdrag og inntektsmodell. Du lykkes når partnerne dine vokser, overskuddsmat selges, og beslutninger tas basert på data – ikke magefølelse.


Dine viktigste ansvarsområder

  • Eie og utvikle en høyverdiportefølje (Tier 1 & 2) Bruke innsikt fra Salesforce og Looker til å identifisere hvor potensialet er størst, og prioritere deretter.

  • Drive kommersiell vekst gjennom dynamisk prising Rådgive og implementere Dynamic Pricing for kvalifiserte partnere for å øke snittpris og total omsetning.

  • Optimalisere tilbud og volum Sikre at partnerne selger mest mulig av overskuddsmaten sin, med mål om høy Saved Ratio og stabil daglig supply.

  • Rådgivende og datadrevet dialog Foreslå konkrete forbedringer i drift og struktur (f.eks. Scheduled Supply) som gjør samarbeidet enklere, mer lønnsomt og mer forutsigbart.

  • Håndtere kommersiell motstand Ta eierskap til innvendinger rundt pris, drift eller brukeropplevelse – og omgjøre dem til løsninger som skaper verdi for begge parter.


Hvem vi tror du er

  • Du har kommersiell teft og sterk tallforståelse – og evner å gjøre innsikt om til handling

  • Du er trygg i dialog, særlig på telefon, og trives med rådgivende salg og kommersiell påvirkning

  • Du har erfaring fra Account Management eller Salg, gjerne innen SaaS, Fintech eller FMCG

  • Du er komfortabel med CRM-verktøy (Salesforce) og jobber strukturert med data og KPI-er

  • Du er selvstendig, strukturert og trives i et høyt tempo

  • Du motiveres av å jobbe med et tydelig samfunnsoppdrag og ønsker å bidra til å redusere matsvinn

Språk: Flytende norsk og engelsk, muntlig og skriftlig


Hva vi tilbyr

  • En rolle med stor påvirkning, der du forvalter en portefølje med tyngde og ansvar

  • Muligheten til å jobbe med avanserte prismodeller og markedsplass-optimalisering

  • Et engasjert og ambisiøst team med tydelige mål

  • Kontor i Oslo og fleksibel/hybrid arbeidshverdag

  • Konkurransedyktige betingelser og gode utviklingsmuligheter


A Movement for Everyone

We want to inspire and empower everyone to fight food waste together. With that mission, it’s only natural that we want to build a diverse and inclusive team of highly capable individuals who are passionate about doing things in a better way. We strongly believe we all excel and are more creative when we’re allowed to be ourselves, and we’re committed to a culture where all of us belong. We are an equal opportunity employer and all employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit and business need. If you need reasonable accommodation at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

At Too Good To Go we are dedicated to the fight against food waste! Food waste is a huge global issue, with one-third of all food produced being wasted, a landfill is overflowing and our environment is really suffering the consequences. And it's not just about the food itself, it's all the resources that went into producing the food, the land, the water, the labour. It's a sad state of affairs and we're on a mission to inspire and empower everyone to take action! Our platform allows people to buy surplus, unsold food from restaurants, cafes, supermarkets, bakeries etc. that otherwise would have to be thrown out. Through our app, everybody can make a difference by 'saving'​ perfectly good, delicious food from going in the bin.

title: Senior Mulesoft Developer
description:
Do you want to:

  • Play a core role in our transformational journey as a MuleSoft Expert, shaping both technical and strategic direction?

  • Work with a modern DevOps and automation-first approach, building scalable, high-quality integrations end-to-end?

  • Join a close-knit, diverse team where you can both learn from others and make a real impact on the platform and the business?

If yes, check out the job ad below – we’re hiring a Senior Mulesoft Developer to join our team and make an impact!

As a Senior MuleSoft Developer, you will play a key role in reducing complexity and manual effort across reMarkable by building a modern, scalable integration layer. You will design, build, and operate production-grade integrations that connect platforms, processes, and people enabling automation, speed, and scale across the business.

This role sits at the heart of a major transformation journey, including the replatforming of our integration layer to MuleSoft. You will have explicit ownership of integration best practices and standards, and real influence over both technical and strategic direction.

Our team is a cross-functional integration and engineering team that enables IT initiatives across supply chain, finance, e-commerce, and customer experience. We integrate and complement platforms such as SAP and Salesforce, unlocking value through APIs, microservices, and event-driven solutions.

  • Experience designing integration solutions and creating technical reference materials, including RAML and/or OpenAPI specifications.

You enjoy solving complex problems and bring an “outside-the-box” mindset, looking beyond obvious solutions to create meaningful and effective outcomes.

  • Language requirements: Our company language is English.

Why we enjoy working here:

  • A flexible hybrid work model

  • 5 extra “reMarkable days” you can make use of in addition to regular vacation.

  • Wednesday is Zen-day with no internal meetings to create space for you to focus, deepdive and be creative. 

  • Premium health insurance, travel insurance, and home broadband coverage.

  • Access to our employee share incentive scheme.

  • Most importantly: We have fun! We have regular events and social gatherings.


About reMarkable

reMarkable creates hardware and software products that help people all over the world find focus. We want to combine the best of both worlds: the digital and the analogue, and to create tools that enhance learning, focus and presence for knowledge workers. Our tablet isn’t just another screen - it’s an experience. We add the warmth of paper to digital solutions, creating something brand new. We are enabling better thinking through technology.

As part of our hiring process, we assess candidates' affiliation with high-risk countries, defined by PST (Norwegian Police Security Service), for security purposes. We also conduct background checks for candidates in the final stages. Data is handled in full compliance with privacy regulations. Should you reach the final stages of the recruitment process, you will be informed. Background checks will not be performed without your knowledge.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

reMarkable is on a mission to help people think better through technology in a distracted world. Our paper tablet isn’t just another screen - it’s an experience. We add the warmth of paper to digital solutions, creating something brand new - enabling better thinking through technology. We have sold millions of devices worldwide, wanting to combine the best of the digital and analogue to create tools that enhance learning, focus and presence. To help us get there, we need colleagues that want to make a real difference through their work – and that’s where you come in! Find our current job openings here: https://jobs.remarkable.com/jobs

title: Head of Finance
description:
Join the future of Sustainable Manufacturing at reTyre!

At reTyre, you’re not just joining a company — you’re joining a groundbreaking industrial journey together with a great team of innovators.

We’ve built the world’s first sustainable tire factory, right in the heart of Ski, 20 min outside of Oslo. Our factory uses a revolutionary production method that makes it possible to replace traditional rubber in pneumatic tires with new, sustainable materials.

We are now looking for a hands-on scale-up experienced Head of Finance to lead the company’s Finance efforts in a crucial growth phase, driving our mission forward to a larger scale.

Our team is young, energetic, and united by a passion for innovation and sustainability, highly motivated by development and success. Every day, we challenge the conventional and push the boundaries of what manufacturing can be — for the benefit of people and the planet.

The company language is English, and the position demands good English communication skills.

This position is mainly stationed at the Company’s HQ in Ski, but remote possibilities can be discussed for the right candidate.


The role

The Head of Finance provides financial leadership with hands-on operational execution, ensuring strong financial control, regulatory compliance, and data-driven decision-making. While partnering with the CEO and Executive Management team to make informed decisions that maximize value creation, the Head of Finance is a partner for data driven and operational financial efficiency and planning.

The position oversees financial reporting, cash flow management, budgeting, working capital optimization, inventory control, cost accounting, payroll oversight, and external stakeholder reporting.

The right person will have the ability to balance the compliance rigor, have commercial insight, operational understanding, and the ability to support processes that scale alongside the organization’s growth trajectory.


What You’ll Do

Overall, our Head of Finance will be involved in a wide range of financial strategies, efforts and tasks in the company and collaborate across departments, with great influence on decisions supporting the company’s overall strategies and goals.

Top-level summary:

Business flow

  • Budgeting and growth forecasting

  • Monitor financial performance through monthly, quarterly and yearly reports and collaboration with department managers and subsidiary companies.

  • D2D accounting, bookkeeping, timely payments including payroll, ERP flow and financial compliance.

  • Yearly close and audit

  • Investor relations

New initiatives

  • Strengthen liquidity

    • Grants

    • Leasing

    • Loans

Strengthen Working capital

  • COGS reduction

  • Supplier payment terms

  • Export financing


Who We’re Looking For

Experience matters — but so does attitude and passion!

Finding the right person that fits our company environment, and mentality is very important when looking for our Head of Finance.

We are looking for someone who has the right “on paper” competences and also is personally motivated and enthusiastic for the opportunity to take the driver seat of the financial efforts in a company with big goals and potential in a growing phase.

You preferably started your career in revision or similar to having the compliance foundation, and have later been working in business finance, controlling or accounting prior to entering a Senior or Managerial role. Overall, you know what it takes to run a profitable and compliant business.

You are experienced with growth processes, preferably in a company producing physical hardware with a global supply chain. You feel confident entering this role with your existing skillsets and are still highly motivated and eager for further growth and success by reaching great milestones in your new journey.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Economics, Accounting, Auditing, or equivalent.

  • 3-5 years of experience in a senior or managerial Finance position.

  • Understanding of fundraising and capital markets.

  • Strong expertise in financial planning and unit economics.

  • Knowledge of Norwegian accounting legislation, tax, VAT, and payroll regulations.

  • Strong English communication skills, both written and spoken.

  • A plus if one has experience from a hardware manufacturing startup or early-stage company’s growth stage (IPO, acquisition, or major funding round).


Personal Qualities

  • Proactive and take initiative.

  • Structured, accurate and strong analytical skills.

  • Good communication and collaboration skills.

  • Self-driven and highly independent.

  • Motivated by growth and reaching targets.

  • Solution oriented and can thrive in a fast-changing environment.

  • Flexible and comfortable working in a modern, small-team environment with real influence.

  • A positive team player who contributes to a great work culture.

Why Work at reTyre?

🌱 Be a Pioneer — Join a company redefining an entire industry

🚀 Real Impact — Your ideas can become reality fast

🤝 People First Culture — We invest in our team through collaboration, support, and growth.

🧠 Innovation Every Day — Work with motivated experts shaping the future

💼 Competitive Salary & Benefits

🚗 Easy Work-Life Balance — Easy commute to Ski, free parking, available charging stations.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

We are an award-winning tyre manufacturer focusing on innovation and sustainability and the first company in the world capable of mass-producing pneumatic tyres without the use of rubber. As pioneers in tyre manufacturing, we’re spearheading an ambitious production method that integrates cutting-edge technologies from multiple industries. As a result, our tyres have significantly lower emissions compared to conventional tyres. reTyre wants to make the lives of various vehicle users easier by sustainable tyre solutions. Above anything else, reTyre values an innovative and fearless entrepreneurial mindset. JOIN THE REVOLUTION Make A Real Difference If you have been dreaming of being part of something great – now’s your time. We’re not just another tyre company. We’re building a state-of-the-art factory with groundbreaking machines, pushing the boundaries of innovation. Our mission? Leading the charge in sustainability and innovation. We have multiple positions open in all departments of our company and we are always looking for talented people who want to be a part of our exciting growth journey and make a real difference.

title: Frontend Software Engineer (React Native, web)
description:
Monil is building world-leading technology for virtual fencing and livestock monitoring and we’re on a mission to create a product experience that matches that ambition. In just three years, we’ve grown to over 1,000 customers and more than 20,000 collars in active use across multiple markets. Now we’re entering a new phase of international growth, and the quality of our user experience will be a key competitive advantage.

Our technology is trusted not only by forward-thinking farmers, but also by leading research institutions and agricultural organizations across several countries.

As we scale globally, we need to deliver a digital experience that is as reliable, intuitive, and thoughtfully designed as the hardware and technology behind it. That’s why we’re looking for a Frontend Engineer who wants to build products that people truly depend on in environments where usability, performance, and trust matter.

In this role, you’ll help shape and build the interfaces that farmers and internal teams use daily, from onboarding and configuration to real-time monitoring and insights. You’ll work closely with product, design, and backend teams, and have a direct impact on how Monil’s platform evolves as we grow.

Our devices collect tons of data about what the animals are doing. We utilize this data to improve the lives of both animals and farmers. Our expert and experienced team runs our extensive cloud platform, applying deep expertise to provide the best solutions.

In Monil, we don't work in silos – you'll have the chance to contribute to the entire software stack together with our experienced team. We strongly believe in sharing knowledge and constantly learning, with no strict divides between frontend, back-end and infrastructure. As a Frontend Engineer in Monil, you'll work very closely together with back-end engineers and be encouraged to contribute to the entire stack.


What we're looking for

  • 1–3+ years of experience building production-ready applications with React and/or modern frontend frameworks

  • Solid understanding of TypeScript, component architecture, and state management

  • Experience working with APIs (GraphQL or REST)

  • BSc or MSc in Computer Science, Informatics or Engineering

Bonus points for:

  • Experience with React Native or native mobile development

  • Experience working in a startup or fast-paced environment

  • Real-life experience with farming or agriculture (not required, but appreciated)

  • Norwegian language skills (preferred but not required)

Fluency in Norwegian is preferred (we make exceptions for the exceptional).


Our Tech Stack

  • React and React Native: We're building our apps rapidly and correctly – React and React Native helps us do both. This mature way of building apps lets us focus on the important parts, while also peeking under the hood and build features directly for iOS and Android where needed. We're using TypeScript to enforce types, and Expo to simplify our React Native project.

  • GraphQL and gRPC: The main interface between the frontends and our servers is our GraphQL API, which lets us efficiently fetch data and update it in real-time. The API lets us fetch what we need and also communicate directly with devices on animals.

  • NodeJS, Go, Kubernetes: Our back-ends are written in Go and run on Kubernetes, letting us quickly build new APIs – with features often spanning the entire stack. Even if your main focus is Frontend, you'll get the chance to get experience with the whole stack.


We can offer

Join a high-growth startup entering an exciting international scale-up phase.You won’t just write code, you’ll own features and initiatives, influence technical decisions, and help build the foundation of a growing company.Nevertheless your work will create meaningful impact by improving animal welfare, farming efficiency, and global sustainability. You’ll collaborate with a highly interdisciplinary team across hardware, embedded systems, backend, and frontend. We offer a competitive salary, including an option program. 


Requirements

Candidates must have the right to work in Norway or within the EU/EEA, as we are unable to support relocation or visa sponsorship from outside this area.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Accelerate the worlds transition to sustainable agriculture by automating animal care. We design and build high-tech smart collars that benefits both farmer, animal and environment: - The farmer saves time and money on building fences and animal feed - The animals spend less time inside and more time grazing on open pastures - The smart collars enable grazing techniques that boost soil health and reduce the need for artificial fertilizer

title: Tech Lead
description:
🚀 Join ZTL as Our Next Tech Lead

Help shape the future of B2B payments.

ZTL is building the next generation of bank-independent payment infrastructure. We provide modern, API-driven payment solutions that enable software platforms and system owners to offer seamless financial services to thousands of businesses.

We’re now looking for a Tech Lead who wants to play a key role in shaping the technical direction of our regulated payment platform.

As a Tech Lead in ZTL, you’ll work closely with the CTO, Product, DevOps, and the engineering team to balance delivery speed, quality, scalability, and regulatory requirements.


🌟 What You’ll Do

Shape Technical Direction

  • Contribute to and refine ZTL’s technical strategy together with the CTO

  • Set direction for architecture, scalability, and long-term system health

  • Translate product goals and regulatory requirements into pragmatic technical solutions

Lead by Doing

  • Work hands-on in the code while guiding architectural decisions

  • Lead design discussions and code reviews

  • Identify and manage technical debt over time

  • Ensure high standards for code quality, security, and reliability

Strengthen Engineering Culture

  • Support and mentor engineers

  • Improve engineering processes and collaboration

  • Work closely with Product and DevOps to ensure smooth, predictable delivery

  • Contribute to hiring and team growth when needed


👩‍💻 Who We Think You Are

  • You have solid experience building modern backend or full-stack systems, ideally in cloud environments

  • You’ve contributed to system design and architectural decisions in a product-driven environment

  • You understand the balance between engineering excellence and pragmatic delivery

  • You care about security, scalability, and reliability, especially in regulated environments

  • You enjoy writing code, but are equally motivated by helping others succeed.

  • You communicate effectively in Norwegian and English

Experience in fintech, payments, APIs, or regulated systems is a strong advantage, but curiosity and the ability to learn fast matter more than ticking every box.


🛠️ Our Tech Stack

We run our applications in the cloud (Microsoft Azure), using containerized services, Kubernetes, and Infrastructure as Code.

Our current stack includes:

  • Kotlin, Ktor, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, Next.js, React, Typescript

  • Docker, Kubernetes, Helmfile, Bitbucket Pipelines

  • Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus, Slack, Miro, Jira, Confluence

You don’t need hands-on experience with every tool in our stack. If you’ve worked with similar technologies and understand the underlying principles, you’ll ramp up quickly.


💡 Why You’ll Thrive at ZTL

Real Impact

You won’t just maintain a system, you’ll shape how we build it. From architecture decisions to engineering culture, your influence will be tangible.

Meaningful Complexity

Payments are not simple. You’ll work at the intersection of infrastructure, compliance, product, and real business value.

Ownership with Collaboration

You’ll have technical ownership, but always within a tight-knit, ambitious team that builds together.

Growth and Opportunity

We’re scaling across markets and expanding our platform. That means room to grow, both technically and professionally.


🏠 About ZTL

ZTL is a Norwegian B2B PayTech company building modern payment infrastructure for system providers and their customers. Through one API integration, our partners gain access to payments and open banking services — delivered in a transparent, scalable, and developer-friendly way.

We’re currently around 20 people, characterized by an entrepreneurial and innovative mindset. While we can offer some flexibility, we primarily like to work together from our office in downtown Oslo.


If you want to help build the backbone of modern business payments, we’d love to hear from you.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

ZTL is a challenger to the banks' "Transactional Services". We're a cloud-native SaaS hybrid B2B payment company in the early expansion phase. We integrate our Open Banking APIs into various ERPs and API platforms to build new business models within payment services. Drop us an email if you want to explore opportunities.

title: Salesforce Developer
description:
Join reMarkable at a pivotal moment as we scale our Salesforce ecosystem, strengthen customer engagement, and build a world-class CRM foundation. As our Salesforce Developer with Marketing Cloud focus, you will bridge technical development across Salesforce Core and Marketing Cloud, building integrated solutions that power customer journeys and platform operations within a fast-growing, cross-functional CRM team.

You'll be part of a multicultural CRM team that owns Salesforce Core, Marketing Cloud, and Data Cloud across reMarkable. Together we deliver stable operations, continuous improvements, and strategic initiatives that support the full customer lifecycle. In this role, you'll work across clouds, connecting systems, ensuring data quality, and building automation that spans the entire Salesforce platform.

Your responsibilities may include

  • Developing and maintaining integrations between Salesforce Core and Marketing Cloud, ensuring seamless data flow and system connectivity.

  • Building automated journeys, triggers, campaigns, and segmentation flows in Marketing Cloud - or learning to do so with team support.

  • Writing Apex, flows, and custom solutions in Salesforce Core while expanding skills in AMPscript, SQL, and Marketing Cloud automation.

  • Configuring data extensions, automations, and data workflows across Marketing Cloud, Salesforce Core, and Data Cloud.

  • Troubleshooting technical issues across multiple Salesforce clouds, debugging code, and ensuring platform reliability.

  • Supporting Data Cloud activation use cases and cross-cloud governance.

  • Leading technical documentation, QA, and platform architecture to maintain scalable, well-structured Salesforce environments.

  • Collaborating closely with Marketing, Sales, Service, Software, and Data teams to translate business needs into robust, well-architected technical solutions.

We are looking for the following experience

  • 4+ years of hands-on Salesforce development, including Apex, Lightning Components, Flows, and integrations.

  • Strong technical expertise in at least one Salesforce Cloud (Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, or Marketing Cloud).

  • Solid experience with SQL, data modeling, API integrations, and automation design.

  • Hands-on experience with Marketing Cloud (Email Studio, Journey Builder, AMPscript) OR a strong interest and demonstrated aptitude for learning Marketing Cloud development.

  • Proven ability to work independently in a fast-paced, high-volume environment while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.


Nice to have:

  • Familiarity with Data Cloud and cross-cloud activation.

  • Marketing Cloud skills: AMPscript, Automation Studio, Journey Builder, segmentation.

  • Experience in CRM, digital marketing, or customer lifecycle communication in a scale-up or international environment.

  • Salesforce certifications (Platform Developer I/II, Marketing Cloud Developer, Administrator, Data Cloud Consultant).


As a person, you are analytical, structured, and proactive. You take ownership, build reliable solutions, and ensure quality across systems. You're curious about learning new Salesforce technologies and excited to expand your skill set. You communicate clearly, collaborate well across teams, and translate technical complexity into simple explanations.


Practical information: 

  • We will consider applications on a rolling basis. 

  • Language requirements: Our company language is English.

  • Location: Oslo, Norway.

  • Visa requirements: Citizenship/valid work permit from the EU/EEA. (Relocation assistance can be provided)


Why we enjoy working here: 

  • A modern campus located central in Oslo, specially designed to reflect reMarkable as a company.

  • Access to a free employee gym with top equipment.

  • A flexible hybrid work model

  • 5 extra “reMarkable days” you can make use of in addition to regular vacation.

  • Wednesday is Zen-day with no internal meetings to create space for you to focus, deepdive and be creative. 

  • Premium health insurance, travel insurance, and home broadband coverage.

  • Access to our employee share incentive scheme.

  • Most importantly: We have fun! We have regular events and social gatherings.


About reMarkable

reMarkable creates hardware and software products that help people all over the world find focus. We want to combine the best of both worlds: the digital and the analogue, and to create tools that enhance learning, focus and presence for knowledge workers. Our tablet isn’t just another screen - it’s an experience. We add the warmth of paper to digital solutions, creating something brand new. We are enabling better thinking through technology.


Join us in preserving human creativity amidst a sea of technological time thieves!


As part of our hiring process, we assess candidates' affiliation with high-risk countries, defined by PST (Norwegian Police Security Service), for security purposes. We also conduct background checks for candidates in the final stages. Data is handled in full compliance with privacy regulations. Should you reach the final stages of the recruitment process, you will be informed. Background checks will not be performed without your knowledge.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

reMarkable is on a mission to help people think better through technology in a distracted world. Our paper tablet isn’t just another screen - it’s an experience. We add the warmth of paper to digital solutions, creating something brand new - enabling better thinking through technology. We have sold millions of devices worldwide, wanting to combine the best of the digital and analogue to create tools that enhance learning, focus and presence. To help us get there, we need colleagues that want to make a real difference through their work – and that’s where you come in! Find our current job openings here: https://jobs.remarkable.com/jobs

title: Er du vår nye Kjøkkensjef?
description:
Nordpå søker en kjøkkensjef med ambisjoner, høye krav til kvalitet og evne til å bidra med gode matopplevelser gjennom hele dagen, fra frokost til middag. Vi satser på lokalmat i flere former, og du vil jobbe tett med våre lokale leverandører for videreutvikling av menyer og konsepter. Du er glad i å jobbe med mennesker, yte service og få folk til å føle seg velkommen. Du liker å bruke lokale råvarer, og kjenner godt til tradisjonelle matretter fra området, men du er heller ikke redd for å prøve ut nye konsepter. Du vil være hovedansvarlig for at kjøkkendriften følger Mattilsynet krav, at råvarene blir tatt vare på, og at kjøkken og lagre holdes rene og ryddige.Du blir motivert av å skape gode opplevelser for gjestene, og de rundt deg. Du har lett for å samarbeide, og har sans for orden og renhold.Det er en fordel at du er glad i naturen og kan sette pris på å være i et flott fjellområde.

Arbeidsbelastningen varierer i løpet av året, og det er derfor viktig at du er fleksibel og god til å planlegge arbeidsdagene dine.

Vi søker en kjøkkensjef som:

  • Er fleksibel, og trives med en allsidig jobb

  • Innovativ og skapende med god kjennskap til tradisjoner

  • Ikke er redd for høyt tempo når det trengs

  • Snakker flytende engelsk, norsk(eller svensk)

  • Kan jobbe helg, morgen og kveld ved behov

  • Setter høye krav til deg selv

  • Utøver stolthet for faget

  • Setter kunden i fokus hver eneste gang

Sentrale arbeidsoppgaver

  • Ansvar og ledelse av kjøkken

  • Produksjon og rutineoppfølging på kjøkkenet

  • Kontroll på oppskrifter, volumer, kvalitet og leveranser til våre gjester

  • Kontroll på varebestilling, svinn og lager

  • Kalkyle- og kostnadskontroll for kjøkken

Påse at Internkontrollsystem blir etterfulgt og videreutviklet

Ønskede kvalifikasjoner

Du har fagbrev som kokk (krav)

Du har god kjennskap til lokale råvarer og matretter

Du har IK-mat kurs

Førerkort kl. B

Vi kan tilby:

En arbeidsplass i erværdige og sjarmerende lokaler

En ansvarsfull jobb med varierte arbeidsoppgaver

Et inkluderende arbeidsmiljø

Vi kan være behjelpelige med bosted

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Nordpå består av Nordpå Fjellhotell, Nordpå Hub, Lille Nordpå og Kaffekråa. Vi ligger i Holtålen kommune i Sør-Trøndelag.

Nordpå Fjellhotell har 47 sengeplasser fordelt på 23 rom og ei hytte. Badet består både av badstue og utendørs Jacuzzi.

Vi arrangerer jevnlig konserter på Nordpå Låven, og Låven er også en populær festsal for bryllup og selskap. Nordpå er også populært for møter og kurs blant bedrifter og lag.

Nordpå Hub ligger i Haltdalen, nært tog, buss og fylkesvei. Her har vi utleie av rom, kontorplass, selskapslokaler og en liten kafe i tillegg til et antikvariat.

Lille Nordpå er en matvogn som deltar på festivaler og ulike arrangement. Her serverer vi vår signaturrett - Gøkburger - og promoterer Nordpå Fjellhotell.

Kaffekråa er et unikt samlingspunkt i bygda, og vi forener historie og tradisjoner med urbant kaféliv. Tradisjonsrike produkter som Hempøsje, Sylte, Sviskegrøt og Ålbyggsodd produseres for salg. Kaffekråa tilbyr også catering for hele regionen.

description:

on a part-time basis(30 hours per week) for a fixed term of one year with the possibility of extension

Job responsibilities include:

• Cleaning tasks within the embassy (offices and functional rooms, restrooms, pantries, stairwells, storage rooms, etc.) as well as in the residence of the ambassador as a temporary replacement during vacation as well as the outdoor areas

  • Service at the embassy and the ambassador´s residence

  • Assisting the grounds maintenance staff and the caretaker (e.g., mowing the lawn, shovelling snow)

Required qualifications and experience:

• Several years of experience as a cleaning staff in a demanding environment

• Sufficient knowledge of German, Norwegian, or English for everyday communication, kunnskap I norsk er ønskelig, men ikke nodvendig

• Reliability and a sense of responsibility

• Robust health, resilience, and flexibility

• Ability to work well in a team

Additional information:

The weekly working hours are 30 hours per week. The compensation is in accordance with the embassy's current pay scale. The salary is 27.897 NOK gross per month. The contractual terms are governed by Norwegian law.

Applicants who do not hold Norwegian or EU member state citizenship are asked to provide a valid work and residence permit for Norway and already be bearers of a so called "fødselsnummer".

Interested?

Please apply by September 14, 2026 with the following documents:

Please send your application with the subject line "Application for Cleaning Staff" electronically (preferably in a single PDF file, max. 5 MB) to: bewerbung@oslo.diplo.de

Unfortunately, travel expenses cannot be reimbursed. We value diversity and welcome all applications - regardless of cultural, social, or ethnic background, gender, religion or belief, disability, age, or sexual orientation. People with disabilities and those with equivalent status will be given priority if equally qualified, in accordance with legal requirements. Further information about the embassy can be found on our website www.oslo.diplo.de.

Information regarding data protection under Article 13 of the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) is available at https://oslo.diplo.de/no-de/datenschutz/737876

  • to prepare and accompany high-ranking visits from Germany

title: Miljøterapeut i barnevernsinstutusjon
description:
Vil du være en del av løsningen? Vi søker miljøterapeut i barnevern

Hver dag gjør våre ansatte en innsats som betyr alt for menneskene vi er her for. I Humana omsorg og assistanse jobber vi etter visjonen om at alle har rett til et godt liv, ja alle. Nå leter vi etter deg som vil være en helt avgjørende del av løsningen for våre ungdommer.

Som en av Norges største private aktører er vi en uunnværlig partner for det offentlige. For å styrke laget vårt i region vest søker vi nå engasjerte kollega til 100% fast stilling i medleverturnus. Du vil inngå i en turnusordning på enten 3-7 eller 4-7, der du bor på avdelingen i tre eller fire døgn og har syv døgn fri mellom hver arbeidsperiode. Vi er også på utkikk etter nattevakt til en stilling på 59,15%.

Avdelingen er godkjent for målgruppen atferd høy/lav og omsorg, og boligen er godkjent for 3 ungdommer her i aldersgruppen 13-18 år.

En jobb preget av glede, engasjement og ansvar

Ingen dager er like hos oss. Som miljøterapeut spiller du en nøkkelrolle i det daglige miljøarbeidet og behandlingen av ungdommene våre. Du blir en relasjonsbygger som skaper et hjem preget av forutsigbarhet, trygghet, rammer og kjærlighet. I tillegg vil du delta aktivt i planlegging, evaluering og drøfting av tiltak, samt bidra med nødvendig dokumentasjon og rapportering for å sikre god drift.

Dette er en krevende jobb som ikke passer for alle. Vi ser etter deg som allerede har noen års erfaring fra barnevernsinstitusjon og som utstråler trygghet og ro. Du evner å se ungdommenes behov bak følelsesuttrykkene, og du vet at endringsarbeid krever tålmodighet. Hos oss får du bruke ditt faglige engasjement til å se muligheter der andre ser hindringer.

Hva skal til for å lykkes hos oss?

  • Ønskelig med treårig høyskoleutdanning, men relevant erfaring fra barnevernsfeltet kan kompensere for dette.

  • Du har erfaring fra miljøterapeutisk arbeid i barnevernsinstitusjon, spesielt med ungdom som målgruppe og arbeid med utfordrende atferd.

  • Du har gode norskferdigheter, både skriftlig og muntlig.

  • Du har gyldig førerkort klasse B.

  • Du har norsk pass eller gyldig arbeidstillatelse.

  • Du må kunne fremlegge godkjent politiattest i henhold til Barnevernloven § 12-11, jf. politiregisterloven § 39, første ledd (attesten skal ikke legges ved selve søknaden).

Bli en del av et sterkt lag

Når du begynner hos oss, blir du en del av et faglig sterkt miljø med fokus på kontinuerlig kompetanseheving gjennom hyppig opplæring og veiledning. Som en av Norges største private aktører er vi en uunnværlig partner for det offentlige, og vi kombinerer menneskelig nærhet med høy kvalitet.

Vi tilbyr et inkluderende arbeidsmiljø med stedlig ledelse, gode muligheter for personlig utvikling og interne karrieremuligheter. Du får også konkurransedyktige lønnsbetingelser, gode medlevertillegg, samt solide pensjons- og forsikringsordninger.

Er du klar for å bli en del av løsningen sammen med oss? Hvis du kjenner deg igjen i våre verdier og ønsker å ta ansvar på et lag som bygger morgendagens omsorg, vil vi gjerne høre fra deg!

For mer informasjon om stillingen, ta gjerne kontakt med avdelingsleder Daniel David på telefon 920 60 744.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Humana omsorg og assistanse utvikler og leverer omsorgs- og assistansetjenester etter enkeltmenneskers behov og samfunnets ønsker. Vi yter tjenester innenfor områdene helse og omsorg, brukerstyrt personlig assistanse, barnevern institusjon og fosterhjem, praktisk bistand og hjelpetiltak.

Vi er et av Norges største private helseforetak, og vi arbeider etter visjonen, Alle har rett til et godt liv.

title: Prosjektmedarbeider
description:
Du har muligheten til å bety en forskjell!

Vi har ledig prosjektstilling ved Crux oppfølgingssenter i Sandnes. Studenter og nyutdannede innen helse- og sosialfag er også velkommen til å søke. 

  • I første omgang ansetter vi for 9 måneder
  • Stillingsprosent: 20-40 % 
  • Tiltredelse snarest

Arbeidsoppgaver:

  • Miljøarbeid, tilrettelegge for aktivitet og turer
  • Samtale, veilede og støtte i rehabiliteringsprosesser
  • Delansvar for planlegging og utvikling av aktiviteter

Om oss

UNG Crux er et tilbud for unge voksne mellom 18-35 år med vekt på felleskap og aktiviteter. UNG Crux har faste samlinger onsdag ettermiddag og kveld. Vi søker etter en person som sammen med prosjektleder deltar i utviklingen av UNG Crux, og som deltar i planlegging og gjennomføring av kveldssamlingene. 

UNG Crux er del av Crux oppfølgingssenter som tilbyr individuell oppfølging til mennesker som har bakgrunn i rusavhengighet og/eller soning, sliter med psykisk helse eller som av ulike årsaker er satt ut av det ordinære arbeidslivet. 

Vårt mål er å styrke og støtte enkeltmennesker gjennom individuell oppfølging, praktisk hjelp, sosialt fellesskap og arbeidstrening. Vi vil bidra til livskvalitet, nye livshistorier og mestringserfaringer. 

Viktige samarbeidspartnere er kriminalomsorgen, kommunen og NAV. Vi holder til i hyggelige lokaler i Sandnes sentrum. 


Kvalifikasjoner

Kvalifikasjoner

  • Student ved helse- eller sosialfaglig studier, eller med erfaring fra miljøarbeid.
  • Førerkort klasse B
  • Motivasjon og personlig egnethet vil bli vektlagt

Personlige egenskaper

  • God på relasjonsbygging, være en samtalepart og rollemodell
  • Gode kommunikasjons- og samarbeidsevner
  • Fleksibel i møte med ulike arbeidsoppgaver

Vi tilbyr
  • En jobb som gir mening og nyttig erfaring
  • Lønn etter avtale
  • Pensjonsordninger gjennom medlemskap i SPK

Send søknad

Ta gjerne kontakt for mer informasjon
Kontakt oss på hverdager mellom kl. 09.00-15.00. 
Vi ønsker ingen henvendelser fra bemanningsbyrå.

Søknad, CV og vedlegg
Send søknad, CV og vedlegg på epost til crux@stiftelsencrux.no
 


Om arbeidsgiveren:

Vi er en virksomhet i stiftelsen CRUX - som er en landsomfattende, ideell og diakonal aktør innen helse- og sosialfeltet i Norge. 
Stiftelsen CRUX tilbyr tjenester innen: 

  • Barnevern
  • Psykisk helsevern
  • Rus- og avhengighetsbehandling
  • Tilbud til aktive rusmiddelavhengige
  • Oppfølging etter soning og behandling
  • Aktivitetssenter for mennesker med utviklingshemming
  • Akutt overnattingstilbud til bostedsløse barnefamilier

Vårt formål er å avdekke hjelpebehov i befolkningen og bidra med tiltak for å bedre livskvaliteten for mennesker som trenger det.

I CRUX er vi medvandrere som står opp for mennesker i sårbare og utfordrende livssituasjoner, slik at de kan oppleve trygghet og nå sine mål. 

Med over 600 ansatte og 170 frivillige er vi til stede fra Tromsø til Kristiansand. Virksomheten er preget av høy faglig kvalitet og en tydelig verdiprofil. 

Som ideell stiftelse går eventuelt økonomisk overskudd tilbake til drift. 

Våre kjerneverdier er: Helhjertet. Raus. Dristig. Solid. Slagordet vi jobber etter er hver dag er: Det finnes alltid muligheter.

title: Data Engineer
description:
About Us:

At SurplusMap, we are revolutionizing green infrastructure and sustainable mobility through data-driven, AI-powered technology. Our platform is at the forefront of EV charging infrastructure development, geospatial data analysis, and energy forecasting, with ongoing projects supported by leading European tech organizations such as ESA, EIT Urban Mobility, and backed by investors like Equinor-Techstars, Simula, and Bentley Systems.

Join us in accelerating the green transition across Europe as we scale our platform to optimize sustainable mobility and energy solutions.

The Role:

As a Data Engineer at SurplusMap, you will play a pivotal role in supporting our data pipelines and infrastructure. You’ll collaborate with our engineering and data science teams to help maintain efficient and scalable data architectures. Working alongside our Senior team, you will gain hands-on experience with large datasets within , ETL processes, and cutting-edge AI tools to power the green energy transition.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone eager to grow their technical skills and contribute to impactful projects aimed at electrifying the transportation industry and achieving cleaner cities.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Collaborate with our engineering and data science teams to design, develop, and maintain data pipelines, including ETL processes.
  • Implement and optimize data storage solutions using Google Cloud products like BigQuery.
  • Work with DBT and Dataform to build robust data transformation workflows.
  • Assist in managing cloud infrastructure with Terraform (nice to have).
  • Ensure data integrity and security across our platform by following best practices in data engineering.
  • Support AI-powered models for EV charger utilization, energy load forecasting, and geospatial analysis.
  • Participate in the design and development of scalable data architectures, contributing to projects aimed at optimizing sustainable mobility solutions.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams on projects that integrate machine learning models for energy and infrastructure predictions.
Desired Skills and Qualifications:
  • Can-do mindset, practical and hands-on with excellent communication skills and results-oriented.  
  • Strong proficiency in Google Cloud products (especially BigQuery).
  • Hands-on experience with SQL for querying large datasets.
  • Familiarity with DBT, Dataform, or similar tools for data transformations.
  • Basic knowledge of Python for scripting and automation.
  • Exposure to Terraform for infrastructure-as-code is a plus.
  • Understanding of data pipeline design, optimization, and ETL processes.
  • Interest in AI, geospatial data, and green energy technologies (experience with GIS tools or similar is a bonus).
  • Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and collaborate with diverse teams.
  • Preferred 2+ years of experience in relevant positions
What We Offer:

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Introduction to SurplusMap SurplusMap is on a mission to revolutionize the way we develop and optimize EV charging infrastructure. By leveraging advanced geospatial tools and machine learning models, we empower energy companies, local utilities, and charge point operators to make informed decisions about site selection and utilization prediction. This ensures the efficient and effective deployment of charging stations, addressing a critical need in the rapidly growing electric vehicle market. Our secret advantage is our ability to draw on Norway's leadership in EV infrastructure, combined with our collaborations with top-tier partners like Google and Bentley Systems, to deliver cutting-edge solutions. The challenge we face is significant: the current pace of infrastructure development is insufficient to meet the future demands of the booming EV market. The market is highly fragmented, causing inconvenience for EV users and difficulties for energy companies and local utilities trying to optimize their investments. For instance, the EU mandates the installation of 6,000 new charging points per week by 2030, a target that is far from being met with the current rate of deployment. This gap presents a substantial opportunity for innovative solutions like SurplusMap to make a real difference. At SurplusMap, we focus on ensuring our customers invest wisely. Our sophisticated, map-based software integrates geospatial data and machine learning algorithms to pinpoint optimal sites for new charging stations. This means our clients can invest in the right locations, install the ideal number of chargers, and maintain high utilization rates over time. By doing so, we help them maximize their investments and build a robust EV infrastructure network that meets the demands of the future. We are driven by a vision of cleaner, more sustainable cities. Electric vehicles are crucial in reducing air pollution and creating healthier urban environments. However, the key to this transition lies in the efficient deployment of charging infrastructure that provides greater flexibility to the energy grid, allowing for more renewable energy sources to be integrated. At SurplusMap, we are passionate about facilitating this energy transition. By optimizing EV charging infrastructure, we help accelerate the shift to cleaner energy, positively impacting both the environment and the communities we live in. Join us in our mission to create a greener, more sustainable future through innovative technology and strategic planning. Together, we can drive the change needed to make our cities cleaner and our energy systems more resilient.

title: Join our Account Executive teams!
description:
At Mercell, we're on a mission to revolutionize public procurement, making it accessible and effortless for everyone involved. Imagine a world where public buyers and visionary suppliers come together seamlessly to make a great deal easier and shape the future. That's what we're all about.

With a dynamic culture built on continuous growth, trust, and collaboration, Mercell offers an environment where your talents can thrive. You will be part of an international environment with ambitious and dedicated colleagues who are passionate about what they do and supported to be themselves.

Together, let's shape the future and create real value for society, one innovative solution at a time.

Join Us

We are growing our Buy-Side Sales teams and looking for ambitious Account Executives to join us in several markets. This is not a single open role, but a talent pool - an ongoing hiring pipeline which we will continuously review and match strong profiles with upcoming opportunities across our teams.

Your Mission

Our Account Executives are at the heart of Mercell’s mission. You’ll be a trusted advisor to public sector customers, guiding them through a value based buying journey and showing how Mercell’s solutions can help them achieve efficiency, compliance, and real impact for society.

You’ll manage the entire sales cycle from prospecting and qualifying leads (both inbound and outbound) to running demos, managing tender responses, negotiating terms, and closing deals.

With each success, you’ll help strengthen Mercell’s presence in your market and expand our growing community of public sector partners.

Core Responsibilities  

  • Proactively identify, engage, and build relationships with key decision-makers across your market.

  • Translate the business pains of the organization into a value based selling approach to drive large strategic engagements.

  • Own the entire sales journey from first contact and discovery to negotiation, closing, onboarding, and upselling.

  • Confidently demonstrate the value and impact of Mercell’s SaaS platform to organisations of all sizes.

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date CRM data in HubSpot, using insights to optimise pipeline and sales performance.

  • Stay ahead of developments in the local and European public procurement landscape to uncover new growth opportunities.

Required Qualifications  

  • Strong experience (ideally 3-5 years) managing a full B2B SaaS sales cycle, preferably to the public sector or highly regulated industries with a tender driven sales motion.

  • Strong experience in outbound sales and pipeline generation with demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.

  • Ability to engage confidently with senior stakeholders and decision-makers.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, agile, and collaborative environment where priorities evolve.

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills in English.

  • Fluency in at least one of the following languages: Swedish, Norwegian, Danish, German or Dutch.

Preferred Qualifications  

  • Familiarity with public procurement, tendering, or compliance-driven buying processes.

  • Experience working in an international or multi-market sales environment.

  • Strong consultative selling mindset with a focus on long-term customer value. 

Workplace type: Hybrid, working onsite at the office and from home balancing flexibility with collaboration

Locations: Sweden, Norway, Denmark, Germany, Netherlands

 

What we offer 

As a fast growing technology company, we are committed to taking care of our employees through initiatives such as hybrid work to support work-life balance, health and insurance plans (may differ per country/office), pension plans, paid parental leave, social happenings and competitive salary packages. Please see https://career.mercell.com/posts/our-perks-benefits to get more insights on what to expect of perks, benefits and culture when joining Mercell.

Has this sparked your interest?

Apply now and join our team!

This is a talent pool, there is no fixed application deadline — we will review applications continuously.

By applying, your profile will be considered for upcoming opportunities that match your skills, experience, and interests. We will keep you updated accordingly throughout the process.

-Mercell is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and experiences.

-Mercell handles all personal data in line with GDPR and our Privacy Policy.

-Mercell does not provide relocation support. We are seeking candidates who are already based in, or have existing work authorization for, the country where the role is located.

-Mercell may carry out background checks on applicants to verify information that appears on CVs and other documentation. This background check is carried out by an external party and is not carried out without the consent of the applicant. Current applicants will receive further information about this.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

At Mercell, we’re transforming how businesses manage procurement and public tendering processes. As a leading provider of digital solutions for procurement, we help organizations across Europe streamline, automate, and optimize their sourcing operations. Our cloud-based platform connects buyers and suppliers, driving transparency, efficiency, and compliance in public and private sector procurement. The Problem We Solve: Procurement is often plagued by inefficiencies, manual workflows, and a lack of transparency, making it time-consuming and prone to errors. This not only impacts operational performance but can also prevent businesses from making strategic, cost-effective decisions. At Mercell, we are solving these challenges by providing an integrated solution that simplifies the tendering process, ensures compliance with regulatory standards, and empowers businesses with data-driven insights. Why We Do It: We believe that efficient procurement is at the heart of sustainable business growth. By digitizing and optimizing the procurement process, we help organizations save time, reduce costs, and make smarter decisions, all while fostering a more competitive and transparent marketplace. Our goal is to empower organizations to focus on their core business, leaving procurement complexity to us. At Mercell, we’re driven by innovation and a passion to continuously improve the procurement landscape.

title: Młodszy księgowy (k/m)
employer: Miejski Ośrodek Pomocy Społecznej w Dzierzgoniu
description:
Zakres obowiązków: Prowadzenie na podstawie dowodów księgowych, ksiąg rachunkowych, ujmujących zapisy w
porządku chronologicznym i systematycznym (program GRAVIS) do:
o rachunku wydatków budżetowych,
o rachunku świadczeń socjalnych,
o rachunków środków pomocowych,
- sprawdzanie dokumentów pod względem formalnym i rachunkowym,
- księgowanie dowodów zakresie kosztów- prowadzenie kart wydatków, comiesięczne ich uzgadnianie (program GRAVIS),
- zamykanie i uzgadnianie co miesiąc wszelkich dowodów księgowych,
- dekretowanie i przygotowywanie dokumentów do księgowania,
- nadzór nad majątkiem i jego ewidencjonowanie,
- naliczanie odpisów na ZFŚS,
- przestrzeganie dyscypliny finansów publicznych oraz tajemnicy służbowej,
- prowadzenie ewidencji syntetycznej i analitycznej wydatków,
- gromadzenie i przechowywanie dowodów księgowych oraz pozostałej dokumentacji przewidzianej ustawą,
- sporządzanie deklaracji do PFRON,  
- zgłaszanie na bieżąco do ubezpieczeń społecznych i zdrowotnych osób zatrudnionych, zwalnianych oraz dokonywania wszelkich zmian w tym zakresie w programie PŁATNIK,  
- zastępowanie głównego księgowego podczas jego nieobecności lub niemożności pełnienia przez niego obowiązków,  
- pomoc przy obsłudze finansowej projektów unijnych,  współpraca z poszczególnymi stanowiskami pracy,  wykonywanie poleceń przełożonych,
- samokształcenie poprzez śledzenie bieżących przepisów prawnych i stosowanie ich w pracy.
Wymagania:
- wykształcenie: wyższe (w tym licencjat) - konieczne
- umiejętności: księgowośc z obsługą komputerowego programu księgowego - konieczne
- pozostałe: WYMAGANIA ZWIĄZANE ZE STANOWISKIEM PRACY:  
- wykształcanie wyższe, staż pracy w administracji samorządowej 5 lat lub wykształcenie wyższe, kierunek finanse i rachunkowość, rachunkowość budżetowa staż pracy w administracji samorządowej 1 rok
-  obywatelstwo polskie,
-  pełna zdolność do czynności prawnych oraz korzystanie z pełni praw publicznych,
-  brak skazania prawomocnym wyrokiem sądu za umyślne przestępstwo ścigane

title: Senior Solution Architect IT/OT Security Platforms (f/m/d) (Ingenieur/in - Systems Engineering)
description:
Siemens IT enables secure, reliable and scalable digital services for Siemens businesses and factories worldwide. Within IT IPS, we develop and operate services that support the transformation of industrial environments towards modern, secure and standardized IT/OT operations.
As a Solution Architect for our IT/OT Security Platforms you will define the technical vision and architecture for strategic service offerings. You will work closely with factories, cybersecurity experts, service managers, product teams, and technology partners to design scalable, secure, and future-ready solutions that support Siemens' Zero Trust and digitalization strategy. Our OT Zero Trust Platform enables secure IT/OT communication through identity-based connectivity concepts, while our OT Patch Management enables centralized endpoint management, patching, hardening and compliance for enterprise and production-related devices.

What we offer you
At Siemens, our Total Rewards approach is designed to inspire innovation, reward impact, and support your well-being at every stage of your career.  From competitive pay and benefits to recognition and development opportunities, we help you thrive both personally and professionally.

You'll make an impact by

- You design and evolve the target architecture for our IT/OT Security Platforms (SINEC Secure Connect and ManageEngine), ensuring alignment with Siemens cybersecurity, operational, and business requirements.- You define secure IT/OT communication concepts based on Zero Trust principles and develop architectures for remote access, machine connectivity, application communication, and future AI-driven use cases.- You support Siemens factories in integrating modern security and management solutions into existing brownfield environments, considering legacy systems, industrial protocols, and operational constraints.- You translate business, security, and operational requirements into scalable platform architectures, governance models, technical standards, and implementation roadmaps.- You collaborate with factories, cybersecurity teams, service owners, vendors, and technology partners to establish architecture standards and drive service adoption across Siemens.- You define integration concepts between connectivity services, endpoint management platforms, monitoring solutions, automation frameworks, and enterprise systems.- You evaluate new technologies and architecture patterns and contribute to the continuous evolution of Siemens' IT/OT security and platform landscape.- You enable data-driven and AI-supported operational use cases by designing architectures that support secure data flows, automation, analytics, and platform interoperability.- You actively shape the journey to AI-native OT security services

This is how you'll win us over

- Education: You have a university degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a comparable qualification.- Experience and Skills:- You possess strong expertise in Zero Trust and OT Security Architecture, including concepts such as identity-centric networking, PKI, certificate lifecycle management, and industry frameworks such as NIST SP 800-207 and IEC 62443.- You have proven experience with OT Infrastructure and Brownfield Integration (of at least 3+ years), including industrial environments, legacy systems, machine-to-machine communication, industrial protocols, network segmentation, and hybrid IT/OT architectures.- You bring solid knowledge of Endpoint, Asset and Service Management Architectures, including endpoint management, asset discovery, software deployment, patch management, CMDB, and IT service management platforms.- You are experienced in Platform and Enterprise Architecture (of at least 3+ years) and can translate business and security requirements into scalable technical solutions, governance models, operating concepts, and technology roadmaps.- You possess strong capabilities in Platform Integration, Automation, AI and Analytics, including API-based integration, monitoring, automation, operational data flows, and AI-ready platform design.
- Ways of Working: - You are able to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders and successfully align diverse stakeholder groups.- You work in a structured and strategic manner and are comfortable operating in international and cross-functional environments.- You provide your support during Central European Time Zone (CET).
- Languages: •    Fluent English skills complete your profile. German language skills are beneficial.

You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!

title: Job i Portugal - Travel Agent for Cruise brand - Med firmabolig i Porto- Opstart den 22. oktober.

Vil du gerne til Portugal og flytte direkte ind i en firmabolig og blive en del af et globalt rejse- og  cruise-selskab?

  • Besvare indgående opkald og assistere kunder med forespørgsler

  • Struktureret med sans for detaljer og problemløsning

  • Evne til at håndtere flere forespørgsler effektivt

  • Kan arbejde i et dynamisk og tempofyldt miljø

  • Fleksibilitet til at arbejde på skift: mandag-fredag 08:00-18:00, lørdag-søndag 08:00-17:00

Vi tilbyder:

  • Mulighed for firmabolig til 280 Euro i Porto

  • Mulighed for at arbejde med et førende globalt rejse- og turismebrand

  • Konkurrencedygtig grundløn plus bonusordning

  • Professionelle udviklingsmuligheder

  • Et samarbejdende og støttende arbejdsmiljø

  • Adgang til eksklusive rejsefordele og rabatter

  • Restaurantkort

  • Privat sundhedsforsikring

  • 14 lønudbetalinger om året

Fordele ved at arbejde i en international virksomhed i Portugal

  • Udvidelse af dine faglige kompetencer gennem globalt samarbejde

  • Forbedring af kommunikation og salgsteknikker i et internationalt miljø

  • Mulighed for karriereudvikling inden for kundeservice, salg og rejsebranchen

  • Adgang til et netværk af internationale kolleger og brancheeksperter

  • Erfaring med moderne digitale værktøjer til kundehåndtering

Dette er en unik mulighed for at kombinere en stærk erhvervserfaring med en fleksibel arbejdsmodel.

Fordele ved at arbejde fra Portugal

  • Mildt klima året rundt – Portugal har et behageligt middelhavsklima med varme somre og milde vintre, hvilket gør det til en attraktiv destination for dem, der ønsker at bo og arbejde i et solrigt land

  • Lavere leveomkostninger – Sammenlignet med mange andre europæiske lande er leveomkostningerne i Portugal relativt lave, hvilket giver mulighed for en høj livskvalitet til en rimelig pris.

Data Quality & Documentation:

NoSQL & Search Expert. Professional experience tuning MongoDB and OpenSearch/Elasticsearch at massive scale (sharding, cluster topology, query optimization).

Strong Python Skills. Proficiency in writing production-grade, highly efficient Python. Experience with asynchronous programming (FastAPI, etc.) for building high-performance Internal APIs is essential.

-
System Design & Architecture. A strong grasp of distributed systems, including eventual consistency, message queues (Kafka/RabbitMQ), and caching strategies to protect production databases.

-
Strategic Storage Thinking. Familiarity with Data Lakehouse concepts (e.g., Parquet, Delta Lake, Iceberg). Proven experience building one.

- Excellent communication skills and attention to documentation.
- Self-managed and comfortable working cross-functionally.
- Fluent in English.

title: TÉCNICO DE ENGENHARIA CIVIL

Topógrafo - É o trabalhador que concebe, prepara, estuda, orienta e executa todos os trabalhos topográficos necessários à elaboração de planos, cartas, mapas, perfis longitudinais e transversais com apoio nas redes geodésicas existentes e ou nas redes de triangulação locais, por meio de figuras geométricas com compensação expedita (triangulação-quadriláteros) ou por interseção inversa (analítica ou gráfica), recorte ou por irradiação
direta ou inversa ou ainda por poligonação (fechada e compensada), como base de todos os demais trabalhos de levantamentos, quer clássicos quer fotogramétricos ou ainda hidrográficos, cadastrais ou de prospeção geológica. Determina rigorosamente a posição relativa de quaisquer pontos notáveis de determinada zona da  superfície terrestre, cujas coordenadas obtém por processos de triangulação, poligonação, trilateração ou outra.
Executa nivelamento de grande precisão. Implanta no terreno linhas gerais de apoio e todos os projetos de engenharia e arquitetura, bem como toda a piquetagem de pormenor. Fiscaliza, orienta e apoia a execução de obras públicas e de engenharia civil, na área da topografia aplicada, procedendo à verificação de implantações ou de montagem, com tolerâncias muito apertadas, a partir desta rede de apoio. Realiza todos os trabalhos
tendentes à avaliação de quantidades de obra efetuadas, a partir de elementos levantados por si ou a partir de desenhos de projeto e sempre também com base em elementos elaborados por si. Pode executar trabalhos cartográficos e de cadastro. Executa os trabalhos referidos e outros ligados às especialidades topográficas, com grande autonomia funcional.
